277.     def _parse_restaurant_card(self, card) -> Optional[dict]:
278.         """음식점 카드 → 딕셔너리."""
279.         name_el = card.select_one(
280.             "[class*='name'], [class*='title'], h3, h4, strong, span"
281.         )
282.         if not name_el:
283.             return None
284. 
285.         name = name_el.get_text(strip=True)
286.         if not name or len(name) < 2:
287.             return None
288. 
289.         card_text = card.get_text(" ", strip=True)
290. 
291.         # 카테고리 추론
292.         category = "기타"
293.         for cat in ["치킨", "피자", "한식", "중식", "일식", "양식", "분식", "카페", "디저트"]:
294.             if cat in card_text:
295.                 category = cat
296.                 break
297. 
298.         # 배달비 추출
299.         delivery_fee = 0
300.         fee_match = re.search(r"배달[\s]*(?:비|료)?[\s:]*(\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})*)", card_text)
301.         if fee_match:
302.             delivery_fee = int(fee_match.group(1).replace(",", ""))
303.         elif "무료배달" in card_text or "배달비 무료" in card_text:
304.             delivery_fee = 0
305. 
306.         # 최소주문금액
307.         min_order = 0
308.         min_match = re.search(r"최소[\s]*주문[\s:]*(\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})*)", card_text)
309.         if min_match:
310.             min_order = int(min_match.group(1).replace(",", ""))
311. 
312.         # 평점
313.         rating = 0.0
314.         rating_match = re.search(r"(\d\.\d)", card_text)
315.         if rating_match:
316.             rating = float(rating_match.group(1))
317. 
318.         img_el = card.select_one("img")
319.         image_url = ""
320.         if img_el:
321.             image_url = img_el.get("src") or img_el.get("data-src", "")
322. 
323.         return {
324.             "restaurant_name": name,
325.             "menu_name": "",
326.             "price": 0,
327.             "category": category,
328.             "delivery_fee": delivery_fee,
329.             "min_order": min_order,
330.             "rating": rating,
331.             "source": "baemin",
332.             "image_url": image_url,
333.             "detail_url": self.BASE_URL,
334.         }
335. 
336.     def _extract_json_from_html(self, html: str) -> list[dict]:
337.         """HTML 내 JSON 데이터 추출."""
338.         # __NEXT_DATA__ 추출
339.         match = re.search(
340.             r'<script id="__NEXT_DATA__"[^>]*>(.*?)</script>',
341.             html, re.DOTALL,
342.         )
343.         if match:
344.             try:
345.                 data = json.loads(match.group(1))
346.                 page_props = data.get("props", {}).get("pageProps", {})
347.                 # 다양한 키에서 상품/음식점 데이터 탐색
348.                 for key in ["products", "items", "restaurants", "stores", "menus", "shops"]:
349.                     val = page_props.get(key)
350.                     if isinstance(val, list) and val:
351.                         return val
352.                     # 중첩 구조 탐색
353.                     for nested_key, nested_val in page_props.items():
354.                         if isinstance(nested_val, dict):
355.                             nested_items = nested_val.get(key)
356.                             if isinstance(nested_items, list) and nested_items:
357.                                 return nested_items
358.             except json.JSONDecodeError:
359.                 pass
360. 
361.         # 기타 embedded JSON 패턴
362.         for pattern in [
363.             r'"restaurants?"\s*:\s*(\[.*?\])',
364.             r'"products?"\s*:\s*(\[.*?\])',
365.             r'"menus?"\s*:\s*(\[.*?\])',
366.         ]:
367.             match = re.search(pattern, html, re.DOTALL)
368.             if match:
369.                 try:
370.                     return json.loads(match.group(1))
371.                 except json.JSONDecodeError:
372.                     continue
373. 
374.         return []
375. 
376.     def _product_to_item(self, product: dict) -> Optional[dict]:
377.         """JSON 상품 데이터 → 배달 아이템 딕셔너리."""
378.         name = (
379.             product.get("name")
380.             or product.get("shopName")
381.             or product.get("restaurantName")
382.             or product.get("storeName", "")
383.         )
384.         if not name or len(name) < 2:
385.             return None
386. 
387.         menu_name = product.get("menuName") or product.get("productName", "")
388.         price = self._to_int(product.get("price") or product.get("salePrice"))
389.         category = product.get("category") or product.get("categoryName", "기타")
390.         delivery_fee = self._to_int(product.get("deliveryFee")) or 0
391.         min_order = self._to_int(product.get("minOrder") or product.get("minimumOrderPrice")) or 0
392.         rating = self._to_float(product.get("rating") or product.get("score")) or 0.0
393. 
394.         return {
395.             "restaurant_name": name,
396.             "menu_name": menu_name,
397.             "price": price or 0,
398.             "category": category,
399.             "delivery_fee": delivery_fee,
400.             "min_order": min_order,
401.             "rating": rating,
402.             "source": "baemin",
403.             "image_url": product.get("imageUrl") or product.get("thumbnailUrl", ""),
404.             "detail_url": product.get("detailUrl") or product.get("url", ""),
405.         }
406. 
407.     def _extract_price(self, text: str) -> Optional[int]:
408.         """텍스트에서 가격 추출."""
409.         if not text:
410.             return None
411.         for pattern in [r"(\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+)", r"(\d{3,})"]:
412.             match = re.search(pattern, text)
413.             if match:
414.                 return int(match.group(1).replace(",", ""))
415.         return None
416. 
417.     async def parse(self, raw_data: str) -> list[dict]:
418.         """원본 데이터에서 음식점/메뉴 정보 파싱."""
419.         items: list[dict] = []
420. 
421.         json_data = self._extract_json_from_html(raw_data)
422.         for product in json_data:
423.             item = self._product_to_item(product)
424.             if item:
425.                 items.append(item)
426. 
427.         if not items:
428.             items.extend(self._parse_store_html(raw_data))
429. 
430.         return items
431. 
432.     async def validate(self, items: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
433.         """유효한 배달 아이템만 필터링."""
434.         valid = []
435.         seen = set()
436. 
437.         for item in items:
438.             restaurant = item.get("restaurant_name", "")
439.             menu = item.get("menu_name", "")
440.             key = f"{restaurant}_{menu}_{item.get('price', 0)}"
441.             if key in seen:
442.                 continue
443.             seen.add(key)
444. 
445.             # 최소 음식점명이 있어야 함
446.             if not restaurant or len(restaurant) < 2:
447.                 continue
448. 
449.             valid.append(item)
450. 
451.         return valid
452. 
453.     def _to_int(self, value) -> Optional[int]:
454.         if value is None:
455.             return None
456.         try:
457.             return int(value)
458.         except (ValueError, TypeError):
459.             return None
460. 
461.     def _to_float(self, value) -> Optional[float]:
462.         if value is None:
463.             return None
464.         try:
465.             return float(value)
466.         except (ValueError, TypeError):
467.             return None
468.

159.             logger.warning(f"[쿠팡이츠] 웹 접근 실패: {e}")
160. 
161.         return items
162. 
163.     def _fetch_with_cloudscraper(self) -> list[dict]:
164.         """cloudscraper로 JS 챌린지 우회하여 데이터 수집."""
165.         items: list[dict] = []
166. 
167.         try:
168.             import cloudscraper
169.             scraper = cloudscraper.create_scraper(
170.                 browser={"browser": "chrome", "platform": "windows", "mobile": False}
171.             )
172. 
173.             resp = scraper.get(
174.                 self.MAIN_PAGE,
175.                 headers={
176.                     "Accept-Language": "ko-KR,ko;q=0.9",
177.                     "Referer": "https://www.coupangeats.com/",
178.                 },
179.                 timeout=20,
180.             )
181. 
182.             if resp.status_code != 200:
183.                 logger.warning(f"[쿠팡이츠] cloudscraper HTTP {resp.status_code}")
184.                 return items
185. 
186.             items.extend(self._extract_from_html(resp.text))
187. 
188.         except ImportError:
189.             logger.warning("[쿠팡이츠] cloudscraper 미설치 — pip install cloudscraper")
190.         except Exception as e:
191.             logger.warning(f"[쿠팡이츠] cloudscraper 실패: {e}")
192. 
193.         return items
194. 
195.     def _extract_from_html(self, html: str) -> list[dict]:
196.         """HTML에서 음식점/메뉴 정보 추출."""
197.         items: list[dict] = []
198. 
199.         # __NEXT_DATA__ JSON 추출
200.         match = re.search(
201.             r'<script id="__NEXT_DATA__"[^>]*>(.*?)</script>',
202.             html, re.DOTALL,
203.         )
204.         if match:
205.             try:
206.                 data = json.loads(match.group(1))
207.                 page_props = data.get("props", {}).get("pageProps", {})
208.                 restaurants = self._find_restaurants_in_json(page_props)
209.                 for restaurant in restaurants:
210.                     item = self._restaurant_to_item(restaurant)
211.                     if item:
212.                         items.append(item)
213.                 if items:
214.                     return items
215.             except json.JSONDecodeError:
216.                 pass
217. 
218.         # embedded JSON 패턴 탐색
219.         for pattern in [
220.             r'"restaurants?"\s*:\s*(\[.*?\])',
221.             r'"stores?"\s*:\s*(\[.*?\])',
222.             r'"shops?"\s*:\s*(\[.*?\])',
223.         ]:
224.             match = re.search(pattern, html, re.DOTALL)
225.             if match:
226.                 try:
227.                     restaurant_list = json.loads(match.group(1))
228.                     for r in restaurant_list:
229.                         item = self._restaurant_to_item(r)
230.                         if item:
231.                             items.append(item)
232.                     if items:
233.                         return items
234.                 except json.JSONDecodeError:
235.                     continue
236. 
237.         # HTML 파싱 fallback
238.         try:
239.             from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
240.             soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
241.             cards = soup.select(
242.                 "[class*='restaurant'], [class*='store'], "
243.                 "[class*='shop'], [class*='merchant']"
244.             )
245.             for card in cards[:30]:
246.                 item = self._parse_card(card)
247.                 if item:
248.                     items.append(item)
249.         except Exception as e:
250.             logger.debug(f"[쿠팡이츠] HTML 파싱 실패: {e}")
251. 
252.         return items
253. 
254.     def _find_restaurants_in_json(self, data: dict, depth: int = 0) -> list[dict]:
255.         """중첩 JSON에서 음식점 리스트 탐색."""
256.         if depth > 5:
257.             return []
258. 
259.         for key in ["restaurants", "stores", "shops", "merchants", "items"]:
260.             val = data.get(key)
261.             if isinstance(val, list) and val and isinstance(val[0], dict):
262.                 return val
263. 
264.         for key, val in data.items():
265.             if isinstance(val, dict):
266.                 result = self._find_restaurants_in_json(val, depth + 1)
267.                 if result:
268.                     return result
269.             elif isinstance(val, list):
270.                 for item in val:
271.                     if isinstance(item, dict):
272.                         result = self._find_restaurants_in_json(item, depth + 1)
273.                         if result:
274.                             return result
275. 
276.         return []
277. 
278.     def _restaurant_to_item(self, restaurant: dict) -> Optional[dict]:
279.         """JSON 음식점 데이터 → 딕셔너리."""
280.         name = (
281.             restaurant.get("name")
282.             or restaurant.get("shopName")
283.             or restaurant.get("restaurantName")
284.             or restaurant.get("storeName", "")
285.         )
286.         if not name or len(name) < 2:
287.             return None
288. 
289.         category = (
290.             restaurant.get("category")
291.             or restaurant.get("categoryName")
292.             or restaurant.get("cuisineType", "기타")
293.         )
294.         rating = self._to_float(
295.             restaurant.get("rating") or restaurant.get("score")
296.         ) or 0.0
297.         delivery_fee = self._to_int(
298.             restaurant.get("deliveryFee") or restaurant.get("delivery_fee")
299.         ) or 0
300. 
301.         return {
302.             "restaurant_name": name,
303.             "menu_name": restaurant.get("representativeMenu", ""),
304.             "price": self._to_int(restaurant.get("price") or restaurant.get("averagePrice")) or 0,
305.             "category": category,
306.             "delivery_fee": delivery_fee,
307.             "min_order": self._to_int(restaurant.get("minOrderPrice")) or 0,
308.             "rating": rating,
309.             "source": "coupangeats",
310.             "image_url": restaurant.get("imageUrl") or restaurant.get("thumbnailUrl", ""),
311.             "detail_url": restaurant.get("detailUrl", ""),
312.         }
313. 
314.     def _parse_card(self, card) -> Optional[dict]:
315.         """HTML 음식점 카드 → 딕셔너리."""
316.         name_el = card.select_one(
317.             "[class*='name'], [class*='title'], h3, h4, strong, span"
318.         )
319.         if not name_el:
320.             return None
321. 
322.         name = name_el.get_text(strip=True)
323.         if not name or len(name) < 2:
324.             return None
325. 
326.         card_text = card.get_text(" ", strip=True)
327. 
328.         # 카테고리 추론
329.         category = "기타"
330.         for cat in ["치킨", "피자", "한식", "중식", "일식", "양식", "분식", "카페", "디저트", "버거"]:
331.             if cat in card_text:
332.                 category = cat
333.                 break
334. 
335.         # 배달비
336.         delivery_fee = 0
337.         fee_match = re.search(r"배달[\s]*(?:비|료)?[\s:]*(\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})*)", card_text)
338.         if fee_match:
339.             delivery_fee = int(fee_match.group(1).replace(",", ""))
340. 
341.         # 평점
342.         rating = 0.0
343.         rating_match = re.search(r"(\d\.\d)", card_text)
344.         if rating_match:
345.             rating = float(rating_match.group(1))
346. 
347.         img_el = card.select_one("img")
348.         image_url = ""
349.         if img_el:
350.             image_url = img_el.get("src") or img_el.get("data-src", "")
351. 
352.         return {
353.             "restaurant_name": name,
354.             "menu_name": "",
355.             "price": 0,
356.             "category": category,
357.             "delivery_fee": delivery_fee,
358.             "min_order": 0,
359.             "rating": rating,
360.             "source": "coupangeats",
361.             "image_url": image_url,
362.             "detail_url": self.BASE_URL,
363.         }
364. 
365.     async def parse(self, raw_data: str) -> list[dict]:
366.         """원본 데이터에서 음식점/메뉴 파싱."""
367.         return self._extract_from_html(raw_data)
368. 
369.     async def validate(self, items: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
370.         """유효한 아이템만 필터링."""
371.         valid = []
372.         seen = set()
373. 
374.         for item in items:
375.             restaurant = item.get("restaurant_name", "")
376.             menu = item.get("menu_name", "")
377.             key = f"{restaurant}_{menu}"
378.             if key in seen:
379.                 continue
380.             seen.add(key)
381. 
382.             if not restaurant or len(restaurant) < 2:
383.                 continue
384. 
385.             valid.append(item)
386. 
387.         return valid
388. 
389.     def _to_int(self, value) -> Optional[int]:
390.         if value is None:
391.             return None
392.         try:
393.             return int(value)
394.         except (ValueError, TypeError):
395.             return None
396. 
397.     def _to_float(self, value) -> Optional[float]:
398.         if value is None:
399.             return None
400.         try:
401.             return float(value)
402.         except (ValueError, TypeError):
403.             return None
404.

317.     def _fetch_via_web(self) -> list[dict]:
318.         """웹 페이지 HTML에서 음식점 정보 추출."""
319.         items: list[dict] = []
320. 
321.         try:
322.             headers = self._get_headers()
323.             headers["Accept"] = "text/html,application/xhtml+xml"
324.             resp = requests.get(self.BASE_URL, headers=headers, timeout=15)
325.             resp.encoding = "utf-8"

327.             if resp.status_code != 200:

329.                 return items

338.     def _fetch_with_cloudscraper(self) -> list[dict]:
339.         """cloudscraper로 JS 챌린지 우회."""
340.         items: list[dict] = []
341. 
342.         try:
343.             import cloudscraper
344.             scraper = cloudscraper.create_scraper(
345.                 browser={"browser": "chrome", "platform": "windows", "mobile": False}
346.             )

348.             resp = scraper.get(

369.     def _extract_from_html(self, html: str) -> list[dict]:
370.         """HTML에서 음식점 정보 추출."""
371.         items: list[dict] = []
372. 
373.         # __NEXT_DATA__ JSON
374.         match = re.search(
375.             r'<script id="__NEXT_DATA__"[^>]*>(.*?)</script>',
376.             html, re.DOTALL,
377.         )
378.         if match:
379.             try:
380.                 data = json.loads(match.group(1))
381.                 page_props = data.get("props", {}).get("pageProps", {})
382.                 restaurants = self._deep_find_restaurants(page_props)
383.                 for r in restaurants:
384.                     item = self._api_restaurant_to_item(r)
385.                     if item:
386.                         items.append(item)
387.                 if items:
388.                     return items
389.             except json.JSONDecodeError:
390.                 pass
391. 
392.         # embedded JSON
393.         for pattern in [
394.             r'"restaurants?"\s*:\s*(\[.*?\])',
395.             r'"stores?"\s*:\s*(\[.*?\])',
396.         ]:
397.             match = re.search(pattern, html, re.DOTALL)
398.             if match:
399.                 try:
400.                     data = json.loads(match.group(1))
401.                     for r in data:
402.                         item = self._api_restaurant_to_item(r)
403.                         if item:
404.                             items.append(item)
405.                     if items:
406.                         return items
407.                 except json.JSONDecodeError:
408.                     continue
409. 
410.         # HTML 파싱
411.         try:
412.             from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
413.             soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
414.             cards = soup.select(
415.                 "[class*='restaurant'], [class*='store'], "
416.                 "[class*='shop'], [class*='list-item']"
417.             )
418.             for card in cards[:30]:
419.                 item = self._parse_html_card(card)
420.                 if item:
421.                     items.append(item)
422.         except Exception as e:
423.             logger.debug(f"[요기요] HTML 파싱 실패: {e}")
424. 
425.         return items
426. 
427.     def _deep_find_restaurants(self, data: dict, depth: int = 0) -> list[dict]:
428.         """중첩 JSON에서 음식점 리스트 탐색."""
429.         if depth > 5:
430.             return []
431. 
432.         for key in ["restaurants", "stores", "shops", "items", "data"]:
433.             val = data.get(key)
434.             if isinstance(val, list) and val and isinstance(val[0], dict):
435.                 if "name" in val[0] or "restaurant_name" in val[0]:
436.                     return val
437. 
438.         for key, val in data.items():
439.             if isinstance(val, dict):
440.                 result = self._deep_find_restaurants(val, depth + 1)
441.                 if result:
442.                     return result
443. 
444.         return []

446.     def _parse_html_card(self, card) -> Optional[dict]:
447.         """HTML 음식점 카드 → 딕셔너리."""
448.         name_el = card.select_one(
449.             "[class*='name'], [class*='title'], h3, h4, strong"
450.         )
451.         if not name_el:
452.             return None
453. 
454.         name = name_el.get_text(strip=True)
455.         if not name or len(name) < 2:
456.             return None
457. 
458.         card_text = card.get_text(" ", strip=True)
459. 
460.         # 카테고리 추론
461.         category = "기타"
462.         for cat in ["치킨", "피자", "한식", "중식", "일식", "양식", "분식", "카페", "디저트", "버거"]:
463.             if cat in card_text:
464.                 category = cat
465.                 break
466. 
467.         # 배달비
468.         delivery_fee = 0
469.         fee_match = re.search(r"배달[\s]*(?:비|료)?[\s:]*(\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})*)", card_text)
470.         if fee_match:
471.             delivery_fee = int(fee_match.group(1).replace(",", ""))
472. 
473.         # 최소주문
474.         min_order = 0
475.         min_match = re.search(r"최소[\s]*주문[\s:]*(\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})*)", card_text)
476.         if min_match:
477.             min_order = int(min_match.group(1).replace(",", ""))
478. 
479.         # 평점
480.         rating = 0.0
481.         rating_match = re.search(r"(\d\.\d)", card_text)
482.         if rating_match:
483.             rating = float(rating_match.group(1))
484. 
485.         img_el = card.select_one("img")
486.         image_url = ""
487.         if img_el:
488.             image_url = img_el.get("src") or img_el.get("data-src", "")
489. 
490.         return {
491.             "restaurant_name": name,
492.             "menu_name": "",
493.             "price": 0,
494.             "category": category,
495.             "delivery_fee": delivery_fee,
496.             "min_order": min_order,
497.             "rating": rating,
498.             "source": "yogiyo",
499.             "image_url": image_url,
500.             "detail_url": self.BASE_URL,
501.         }
502. 
503.     async def parse(self, raw_data: str) -> list[dict]:
504.         """원본 데이터에서 음식점/메뉴 파싱."""
505.         return self._extract_from_html(raw_data)
506. 
507.     async def validate(self, items: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
508.         """유효한 아이템만 필터링."""
509.         valid = []
510.         seen = set()
511. 
512.         for item in items:
513.             restaurant = item.get("restaurant_name", "")
514.             menu = item.get("menu_name", "")
515.             key = f"{restaurant}_{menu}"
516.             if key in seen:
517.                 continue
518.             seen.add(key)
519. 
520.             if not restaurant or len(restaurant) < 2:
521.                 continue
522. 
523.             valid.append(item)
524. 
525.         return valid
526. 
527.     def _to_int(self, value) -> Optional[int]:
528.         if value is None:
529.             return None
530.         try:
531.             return int(value)
532.         except (ValueError, TypeError):
533.             return None
534. 
535.     def _to_float(self, value) -> Optional[float]:
536.         if value is None:
537.             return None
538.         try:
539.             return float(value)
540.         except (ValueError, TypeError):
541.             return None

131.     async def parse(self, raw_data: str) -> list[DiscountItem]:
132.         """HTML/JSON 응답에서 할인 상품을 파싱한다."""
133.         items: list[DiscountItem] = []
134. 
135.         # JSON 데이터 블록 추출 시도

137.         if json_items:
138.             for product in json_items:
139.                 item = self._json_to_discount_item(product)
140.                 if item:
141.                     items.append(item)
142.             return items
143. 
144.         # HTML 파싱 fallback
145.         try:
146.             from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
147.             soup = BeautifulSoup(raw_data, "html.parser")
148.             items = self._parse_html(soup)
149.         except Exception as e:
150.             logger.warning(f"[롯데마트] HTML 파싱 실패: {e}")

152.         return items

154.     def _extract_json_items(self, raw_data: str) -> list[dict]:
155.         """페이지 내 임베디드 JSON 데이터 추출."""
156.         patterns = [
157.             r'var\s+(?:itemList|prodList|goodsList)\s*=\s*(\[.*?\]);',
158.             r'"itemList"\s*:\s*(\[.*?\])',
159.             r'"goodsList"\s*:\s*(\[.*?\])',
160.             r'"products"\s*:\s*(\[.*?\])',
161.         ]
162.         for pattern in patterns:
163.             match = re.search(pattern, raw_data, re.DOTALL)
164.             if match:
165.                 try:
166.                     return json.loads(match.group(1))
167.                 except json.JSONDecodeError:
168.                     continue
169.         return []
170. 
171.     def _json_to_discount_item(self, product: dict) -> Optional[DiscountItem]:
172.         """JSON 상품 데이터 → DiscountItem 변환."""
173.         name = (
174.             product.get("goodsNm")
175.             or product.get("itemNm")
176.             or product.get("prodNm")
177.             or product.get("name", "")
178.         )
179.         if not name or len(name) < 2:
180.             return None
181. 
182.         sale_price = self._to_int(
183.             product.get("salePrice") or product.get("sellprc")
184.             or product.get("sale_price") or product.get("price")
185.         )
186.         original_price = self._to_int(
187.             product.get("originPrice") or product.get("norprc")
188.             or product.get("original_price")
189.         )
190. 
191.         if not sale_price or sale_price <= 0:
192.             return None
193. 
194.         discount_pct = None
195.         if original_price and original_price > sale_price:
196.             discount_pct = round((1 - sale_price / original_price) * 100, 1)
197. 
198.         image_url = product.get("imgUrl") or product.get("goodsImg", "")
199.         category = product.get("categoryNm") or product.get("ctgNm", "")
200.         detail_url = product.get("goodsUrl") or product.get("detail_url", "")
201.         if detail_url and not detail_url.startswith("http"):
202.             detail_url = f"{self.BASE_URL}{detail_url}"
203. 
204.         return DiscountItem(
205.             name=name,
206.             store="롯데마트",
207.             original_price=original_price,
208.             sale_price=sale_price,
209.             discount_percent=discount_pct,
210.             category=category,
211.             event_name=product.get("eventNm", "롯데마트 할인"),
212.             image_url=image_url,
213.             detail_url=detail_url,
214.         )

216.     def _parse_html(self, soup) -> list[DiscountItem]:

222.         )

236.     def _parse_product_card(self, card) -> Optional[DiscountItem]:
237.         """개별 상품 카드 HTML → DiscountItem."""
238.         name_el = card.select_one(
239.             ".product-name, .goods_name, .item_name, .prod_name, a[href*='goods']"
240.         )
241.         if not name_el:
242.             return None
243.         name = name_el.get_text(strip=True)
244.         if not name or len(name) < 2:
245.             return None
246. 
247.         sale_price = self._extract_price_from_element(
248.             card, ".sale_price, .price .num, .discount_price, .spc_price"
249.         )
250.         original_price = self._extract_price_from_element(
251.             card, ".origin_price, .normal_price, .org_price, .before_price"
252.         )
253. 
254.         if not sale_price or sale_price <= 0:
255.             return None
256. 
257.         discount_pct = None
258.         if original_price and original_price > sale_price:
259.             discount_pct = round((1 - sale_price / original_price) * 100, 1)
260. 
261.         img_el = card.select_one("img")
262.         image_url = ""
263.         if img_el:
264.             image_url = img_el.get("src") or img_el.get("data-src", "")
265. 
266.         link_el = card.select_one("a[href]")
267.         detail_url = ""
268.         if link_el:
269.             href = link_el.get("href", "")
270.             detail_url = href if href.startswith("http") else f"{self.BASE_URL}{href}"
271. 
272.         return DiscountItem(
273.             name=name,
274.             store="롯데마트",
275.             original_price=original_price,
276.             sale_price=sale_price,
277.             discount_percent=discount_pct,
278.             image_url=image_url,
279.             detail_url=detail_url,
280.             event_name="롯데마트 할인",
281.         )

283.     def _extract_price_from_element(self, card, selectors: str) -> Optional[int]:
284.         """CSS 셀렉터로 가격 요소를 찾아 정수 변환."""
285.         for selector in selectors.split(","):
286.             el = card.select_one(selector.strip())
287.             if el:
288.                 price = self._extract_price(el.get_text(strip=True))
289.                 if price is not None:
290.                     return price
291.         return None
292. 
293.     def _extract_price(self, text: str) -> Optional[int]:
294.         """텍스트에서 가격(원)을 추출한다."""
295.         if not text:
296.             return None
297.         patterns = [
298.             r"(\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+)",
299.             r"(\d{3,})",
300.         ]
301.         for pattern in patterns:
302.             match = re.search(pattern, text)
303.             if match:
304.                 return int(match.group(1).replace(",", ""))
305.         return None
306. 
307.     def _to_int(self, value) -> Optional[int]:
308.         """안전한 정수 변환."""
309.         if value is None:
310.             return None
311.         try:

135.     async def parse(self, raw_data: str) -> list[DiscountItem]:
136.         """HTML/JSON 응답에서 할인 상품을 파싱한다."""
137.         items: list[DiscountItem] = []
138. 
139.         # JSON 데이터 블록 추출 시도
140.         json_items = self._extract_json_items(raw_data)
141.         if json_items:
142.             for product in json_items:
143.                 item = self._json_to_discount_item(product)
144.                 if item:
145.                     items.append(item)
146.             return items
147. 
148.         # HTML 파싱 fallback
149.         try:
150.             from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
151.             soup = BeautifulSoup(raw_data, "html.parser")
152.             items = self._parse_html(soup)
153.         except Exception as e:
154.             logger.warning(f"[홈플러스] HTML 파싱 실패: {e}")
155. 
156.         return items
157. 
158.     def _extract_json_items(self, raw_data: str) -> list[dict]:
159.         """페이지 내 임베디드 JSON 데이터 추출."""
160.         patterns = [
161.             r'var\s+(?:itemList|prodList|goodsList)\s*=\s*(\[.*?\]);',
162.             r'"itemList"\s*:\s*(\[.*?\])',
163.             r'"goods"\s*:\s*(\[.*?\])',
164.             r'"products"\s*:\s*(\[.*?\])',
165.         ]
166.         for pattern in patterns:
167.             match = re.search(pattern, raw_data, re.DOTALL)
168.             if match:
169.                 try:
170.                     return json.loads(match.group(1))
171.                 except json.JSONDecodeError:
172.                     continue
173.         return []
174. 
175.     def _json_to_discount_item(self, product: dict) -> Optional[DiscountItem]:
176.         """JSON 상품 데이터 → DiscountItem 변환."""
177.         name = (
178.             product.get("goodsNm")
179.             or product.get("itemNm")
180.             or product.get("prodNm")
181.             or product.get("name", "")
182.         )
183.         if not name or len(name) < 2:
184.             return None
185. 
186.         sale_price = self._to_int(
187.             product.get("salePrice") or product.get("sellprc")
188.             or product.get("sale_price") or product.get("price")
189.         )
190.         original_price = self._to_int(
191.             product.get("originPrice") or product.get("norprc")
192.             or product.get("original_price")
193.         )
194. 
195.         if not sale_price or sale_price <= 0:
196.             return None
197. 
198.         discount_pct = None
199.         if original_price and original_price > sale_price:
200.             discount_pct = round((1 - sale_price / original_price) * 100, 1)
201. 
202.         image_url = product.get("imgUrl") or product.get("goodsImg", "")
203.         category = product.get("categoryNm") or product.get("ctgNm", "")
204.         detail_url = product.get("goodsUrl") or product.get("detail_url", "")
205.         if detail_url and not detail_url.startswith("http"):
206.             detail_url = f"{self.BASE_URL}{detail_url}"
207. 
208.         return DiscountItem(
209.             name=name,
210.             store="홈플러스",
211.             original_price=original_price,
212.             sale_price=sale_price,
213.             discount_percent=discount_pct,
214.             category=category,
215.             event_name=product.get("eventNm", "홈플러스 할인"),
216.             image_url=image_url,
217.             detail_url=detail_url,
218.         )
219. 
220.     def _parse_html(self, soup) -> list[DiscountItem]:
221.         """HTML에서 상품 정보를 파싱한다 (fallback)."""
222.         items: list[DiscountItem] = []
223. 
224.         product_cards = soup.select(
225.             ".product-item, .goods_item, .event_item, .item_box, .prod_wrap"
226.         )
227.         logger.info(f"[홈플러스] HTML 상품 카드: {len(product_cards)}개")
228. 
229.         for card in product_cards:
230.             try:
231.                 item = self._parse_product_card(card)
232.                 if item:
233.                     items.append(item)
234.             except Exception as e:
235.                 logger.debug(f"[홈플러스] 카드 파싱 오류: {e}")
236.                 continue
237. 
238.         return items
239. 
240.     def _parse_product_card(self, card) -> Optional[DiscountItem]:
241.         """개별 상품 카드 HTML → DiscountItem."""
242.         name_el = card.select_one(
243.             ".product-name, .goods_name, .item_name, .prod_name, a[href*='goods']"
244.         )
245.         if not name_el:
246.             return None
247.         name = name_el.get_text(strip=True)
248.         if not name or len(name) < 2:
249.             return None
250. 
251.         sale_price = self._extract_price_from_element(
252.             card, ".sale_price, .price .num, .discount_price, .spc_price"
253.         )
254.         original_price = self._extract_price_from_element(
255.             card, ".origin_price, .normal_price, .org_price, .before_price"
256.         )
257. 
258.         if not sale_price or sale_price <= 0:
259.             return None
260. 
261.         discount_pct = None
262.         if original_price and original_price > sale_price:
263.             discount_pct = round((1 - sale_price / original_price) * 100, 1)
264. 
265.         img_el = card.select_one("img")
266.         image_url = ""
267.         if img_el:
268.             image_url = img_el.get("src") or img_el.get("data-src", "")
269. 
270.         link_el = card.select_one("a[href]")
271.         detail_url = ""
272.         if link_el:
273.             href = link_el.get("href", "")
274.             detail_url = href if href.startswith("http") else f"{self.BASE_URL}{href}"
275. 
276.         return DiscountItem(
277.             name=name,
278.             store="홈플러스",
279.             original_price=original_price,
280.             sale_price=sale_price,
281.             discount_percent=discount_pct,
282.             image_url=image_url,
283.             detail_url=detail_url,
284.             event_name="홈플러스 할인",
285.         )
286. 
287.     def _extract_price_from_element(self, card, selectors: str) -> Optional[int]:
288.         """CSS 셀렉터로 가격 요소를 찾아 정수 변환."""
289.         for selector in selectors.split(","):
290.             el = card.select_one(selector.strip())
291.             if el:
292.                 price = self._extract_price(el.get_text(strip=True))
293.                 if price is not None:
294.                     return price
295.         return None
296. 
297.     def _extract_price(self, text: str) -> Optional[int]:
298.         """텍스트에서 가격(원)을 추출한다."""
299.         if not text:
300.             return None
301.         patterns = [
302.             r"(\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+)",
303.             r"(\d{3,})",
304.         ]
305.         for pattern in patterns:
306.             match = re.search(pattern, text)
307.             if match:
308.                 return int(match.group(1).replace(",", ""))
309.         return None
310. 
311.     def _to_int(self, value) -> Optional[int]:
312.         """안전한 정수 변환."""
313.         if value is None:
314.             return None
315.         try:
316.             return int(value)
317.         except (ValueError, TypeError):
318.             return None
319.

321.         """유효한 할인 상품만 필터링."""

324.

330. 
331.             if item.sale_price <= 0:
332.                 continue
333.             if len(item.name) < 2:
334.                 continue
335. 
336.             valid.append(item)
337. 
338.         return valid

35.         self._playwright = None

45.     async def _do_fetch(self, url: str, **options) -> str:
46.         wait_timeout = options.get("wait_timeout", self._wait_timeout)
47. 
48.         try:
49.             from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
50.         except ImportError:
51.             raise CrawlError(
52.                 "playwright가 설치되지 않았습니다. pip install playwright && playwright install",
53.                 error_type=ErrorType.UNKNOWN,
54.                 strategy_name=self.name,
55.             )
56. 
57.         pw = await async_playwright().start()
58.         self._playwright = pw
59. 
60.         ua = self._anti_detect.get_random_user_agent()
61.         proxy = self._anti_detect.get_random_proxy()
62.         proxy_config = {"server": proxy} if proxy else None
63. 
64.         browser = await pw.chromium.launch(
65.             headless=self._headless,
66.             args=[
67.                 "--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled",
68.                 "--no-sandbox",
69.             ],
70.         )
71.         self._browser = browser
72. 
73.         context = await browser.new_context(
74.             user_agent=ua,
75.             locale="ko-KR",
76.             timezone_id="Asia/Seoul",
77.             viewport={"width": 1920, "height": 1080},
78.             proxy=proxy_config,

81.         # playwright-stealth 적용

84.             await stealth_async(context)
85.         except ImportError:

9. from fastapi import APIRouter, Request, Query
10. from api.schemas.common import ApiResponse
11. 
12. router = APIRouter()
13. 
14. 
15. def _haversine(lat1, lng1, lat2, lng2):
16.     """두 좌표 간 거리 (미터)."""
17.     R = 6371000
18.     dlat = math.radians(lat2 - lat1)
19.     dlng = math.radians(lng2 - lng1)
20.     a = math.sin(dlat / 2) ** 2 + math.cos(math.radians(lat1)) * math.cos(math.radians(lat2)) * math.sin(dlng / 2) ** 2
21.     return R * 2 * math.atan2(math.sqrt(a), math.sqrt(1 - a))
22. 
23.

25. async def nearby_gas_stations(
26.     request: Request,

29.     radius: int = Query(5000, ge=100, le=50000, description="반경 (미터)"),

1. """
2. FastAPI 앱 팩토리 — container.py가 의존성을 주입하여 앱을 생성한다.
3. 
4. 왜 팩토리 패턴인가:
5.     테스트 시 mock storage를 주입할 수 있고,
6.     main.py와 container.py가 각각 독립적으로 앱을 생성할 수 있다.
7. 어디서 쓰이는가:
8.     container.py._init_api() → create_app(storage, engine, event_bus)
9.     main.py "server" 명령 → uvicorn으로 이 앱을 서빙.
10. 
11. 라우터 구조:
12.     api/routes/ 디렉토리에 도메인별 라우터 파일을 배치한다.
13.     (routes/products.py, routes/hotdeals.py, routes/marts.py, routes/gas.py, routes/crawlers.py, routes/users.py)
14. """
15. 
16. from fastapi import FastAPI
17. from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
18. 
19. 
20. def create_app(storage=None, engine=None, event_bus=None) -> FastAPI:
21.     """
22.     팩토리 패턴 — container.py가 의존성 주입하여 앱 생성.
23. 
24.     storage가 None이면 각 라우터가 mock 데이터를 반환하므로
25.     DB 없이도 즉시 프론트엔드 개발이 가능하다.
26.     """
27.     app = FastAPI(
28.         title="지갑 지키미 API",
29.         description="물가 비교 서비스 백엔드 — 정부 공공데이터 + 마트 할인 + 커뮤니티 핫딜",
30.         version="0.1.0",
31.     )
32. 
33.     # CORS — 프론트엔드 개발 서버 허용
34.     app.add_middleware(
35.         CORSMiddleware,
36.         allow_origins=[
37.             "http://localhost:5173",   # Vite dev server
38.             "http://localhost:3000",   # CRA / Next.js dev
39.             "http://127.0.0.1:5173",
40.             "http://127.0.0.1:3000",
41.         ],
42.         allow_credentials=True,
43.         allow_methods=["*"],
44.         allow_headers=["*"],
45.     )
46. 
47.     # 의존성을 app.state에 저장 — 라우터에서 request.app.state.storage로 접근
48.     app.state.storage = storage
49.     app.state.engine = engine
50.     app.state.event_bus = event_bus
51. 
52.     # 라우터 등록 — 도메인별 분리
53.     from api.routes.products import router as products_router
54.     from api.routes.hotdeals import router as hotdeals_router
55.     from api.routes.marts import router as marts_router
56.     from api.routes.gas import router as gas_router
57.     from api.routes.crawlers import router as crawlers_router
58.     from api.routes.users import router as users_router
59.     from api.routes.auth import router as auth_router
60.     from api.routes.community import router as community_router
61.     from api.routes.search import router as search_router
62.     from api.routes.restaurants import router as restaurants_router
63. 
64.     app.include_router(products_router, prefix="/api/products", tags=["Products"])
65.     app.include_router(hotdeals_router, prefix="/api/hotdeals", tags=["Hotdeals"])
66.     app.include_router(marts_router, prefix="/api/marts", tags=["Marts"])
67.     app.include_router(gas_router, prefix="/api/gas", tags=["Gas Stations"])
68.     app.include_router(crawlers_router, prefix="/api/crawlers", tags=["Crawlers"])
69.     app.include_router(users_router, prefix="/api/users", tags=["Users"])
70.     app.include_router(auth_router)
71.     app.include_router(community_router, prefix="/api/posts", tags=["Community"])
72.     app.include_router(search_router, prefix="/api/search", tags=["Search"])
73.     app.include_router(restaurants_router, prefix="/api", tags=["Restaurants"])
74. 
75.     @app.get("/api/health")
76.     def health():
77.         """헬스체크 — 로드밸런서·모니터링용."""
78.         return {"status": "ok", "version": "0.1.0"}
79. 
80.     return app
81.
```

119.                         <div className={s.itemDist}>~{(0.5 + i * 0.3).toFixed(1)}km</div>
120.                       </div>

205. function GasDetailContent({ station, avgGas }) {
206.   const isSelf = station.name.includes('셀프');
207.   const dist = (0.5 + station.idx * 0.3).toFixed(1);
208. 
209.   const fuelRows = [
210.     { label: '휘발유', key: 'gasoline', avg: avgGas },
211.     { label: '경유', key: 'diesel', avg: Math.round(avgGas * 0.9) },
212.     { label: 'LPG', key: 'lpg', avg: Math.round(avgGas * 0.62) },
213.   ];
214. 
215.   return (
216.     <div className={s.modalDetail}>
217.       <div className={s.detailHeader}>
218.         <h3 className={s.detailName}>{station.name}</h3>
219.         <span className={s.detailBrand}>{station.brand}</span>
220.         {isSelf && <span className={s.selfTag}>셀프</span>}
221.       </div>
222.       <p className={s.detailAddr}>📍 {station.addr}</p>
223.       <p className={s.detailDist}>📏 현재 위치에서 ~{dist}km</p>
224. 
225.       <div className={s.detailSection}>
226.         <h4>⛽ 유종별 가격</h4>
227.         <div className={s.fuelTable}>
228.           {fuelRows.map(f => {
229.             const price = station[f.key];
230.             if (!price) return (
231.               <div key={f.key} className={s.fuelRow}>
232.                 <span className={s.fuelLabel}>{f.label}</span>
233.                 <span className={s.fuelNA}>취급 안 함</span>
234.               </div>
235.             );
236.             const diff = price - f.avg;
237.             return (
238.               <div key={f.key} className={s.fuelRow}>
239.                 <span className={s.fuelLabel}>{f.label}</span>
240.                 <span className={s.fuelPrice}>{fmt(price)}원/L</span>
241.                 <span className={s.fuelDiff} style={{ color: diff <= 0 ? 'var(--green)' : 'var(--red)' }}>
242.                   지역 평균 대비 {diff <= 0 ? fmt(diff) : `+${fmt(diff)}`}원
243.                 </span>
244.               </div>
245.             );
246.           })}
247.         </div>
248.       </div>
249. 
250.       <div className={s.detailSection}>
251.         <h4>ℹ️ 운영 정보</h4>
252.         <div className={s.infoGrid}>
253.           <div className={s.infoItem}>
254.             <span className={s.infoLabel}>셀프 여부</span>
255.             <span className={s.infoValue}>{isSelf ? '✅ 셀프 주유' : '❌ 일반 주유'}</span>
256.           </div>
257.           <div className={s.infoItem}>
258.             <span className={s.infoLabel}>운영 시간</span>
259.             <span className={s.infoValue}>{isSelf ? '24시간' : '06:00 ~ 23:00'}</span>
260.           </div>
261.           <div className={s.infoItem}>
262.             <span className={s.infoLabel}>브랜드</span>
263.             <span className={s.infoValue}>{station.brand}</span>
264.           </div>
265.         </div>
266.       </div>
267. 
268.       <button className={s.directionBtn} onClick={() => alert('길찾기 기능은 지도 API 연동 후 제공됩니다.')}>
269.         🧭 길찾기
270.       </button>
271.     </div>
272.   );
273. }
274. 
275. function RestDetailContent({ restaurant }) {
276.   const avg = LOCAL_AVGS[restaurant.menu];
277.   const diff = avg ? restaurant.price - avg : null;
278.   const dist = (0.3 + restaurant.idx * 0.25).toFixed(1);
279. 
280.   const matchedRecipe = RECIPES.find(r =>
281.     restaurant.menu.includes(r.name) || r.name.includes(restaurant.menu.replace('(1인분)', '').trim())
282.   );
283.   const recipeCost = matchedRecipe ? calcRecipeCost(matchedRecipe) : null;
284. 
285.   const mockMenuItems = [
286.     { name: restaurant.menu, price: restaurant.price },
287.     { name: restaurant.cat === '카페' ? '카페라떼' : '공기밥', price: restaurant.cat === '카페' ? restaurant.price + 1000 : 1000 },
288.     { name: restaurant.cat === '카페' ? '녹차라떼' : restaurant.cat === '중식' ? '짬뽕' : '된장찌개', price: restaurant.price + (restaurant.cat === '카페' ? 500 : 1500) },
289.   ];
290. 
291.   return (
292.     <div className={s.modalDetail}>
293.       <div className={s.detailHeader}>
294.         <h3 className={s.detailName}>{restaurant.name}</h3>
295.         <span className={s.detailCat}>{restaurant.cat}</span>
296.       </div>
297.       <p className={s.detailAddr}>📍 {restaurant.addr}</p>
298.       <p className={s.detailDist}>📏 현재 위치에서 ~{dist}km</p>
299.       <p className={s.detailRating}>⭐ {restaurant.rating} / 5.0</p>
300. 
301.       <div className={s.detailSection}>
302.         <h4>📋 메뉴 및 가격</h4>
303.         <div className={s.menuTable}>
304.           {mockMenuItems.map((m, i) => {
305.             const menuAvg = LOCAL_AVGS[m.name];
306.             const menuDiff = menuAvg ? m.price - menuAvg : null;
307.             return (
308.               <div key={i} className={s.menuRow}>
309.                 <span className={s.menuName}>{m.name}</span>
310.                 <span className={s.menuPrice}>{fmt(m.price)}원</span>
311.                 {menuDiff !== null && (
312.                   <span className={s.menuDiff} style={{ color: menuDiff <= 0 ? 'var(--green)' : 'var(--red)' }}>
313.                     시세 대비 {menuDiff <= 0 ? fmt(menuDiff) : `+${fmt(menuDiff)}`}원
314.                   </span>
315.                 )}
316.               </div>
317.             );
318.           })}
319.         </div>
320.       </div>
321. 
322.       {recipeCost && (
323.         <div className={s.detailSection}>
324.           <h4>🍳 외식 vs 직접 조리</h4>
325.           <div className={s.cookCompareModal}>
326.             <div className={s.cookCompareItem}>
327.               <span className={s.cookCompareLabel}>🍽️ 외식 (이 식당)</span>
328.               <span className={s.cookComparePrice}>{fmt(restaurant.price)}원</span>
329.             </div>
330.             <span className={s.cookVs}>vs</span>
331.             <div className={s.cookCompareItem}>
332.               <span className={s.cookCompareLabel}>🏠 직접 조리</span>
333.               <span className={s.cookComparePrice} style={{ color: 'var(--green)' }}>{fmt(recipeCost.total)}원</span>
334.             </div>
335.           </div>
336.           <p className={s.cookSavingsModal}>
337.             💰 직접 해먹으면 {fmt(recipeCost.savings)}원 절약 ({recipeCost.pct}%)
338.           </p>
339.         </div>
340.       )}
341. 
342.       <button className={s.directionBtn} onClick={() => alert('길찾기 기능은 지도 API 연동 후 제공됩니다.')}>
343.         🧭 길찾기
344.       </button>
345.     </div>
346.   );
347. }
348.

## Why They Return 0 Items

| Crawler | Primary Issue | Secondary Issue |
|---------|---------------|-----------------|
| **Giordano** | Café24 SPA requires JS rendering | Selector drift (class names change) |
| **Lotte Mart** | Migrated to SPA (lottemartzetta.com) | API interception may return auth errors |
| **Homeplus** | SPA shell detection misses products | Empty API responses from `intercept_api()` |
| **Baemin** | `__NEXT_DATA__` doesn't contain shops | Playwright can't trigger API without address selection |
| **Yogiyo** | Location-based API returns empty results | Hardcoded API secret/coords may be revoked |
| **Coupang Eats** | Address selection required on web | Cloudflare blocks Playwright/requests/cloudscraper |

**Common Root Cause:** All delivery/mart sites have moved to **React/SPA architecture** where content loads client-side via API. Static CSS selectors are fragile because:
1. Classes are dynamically generated (`[class*='foo']` too broad)
2. API responses require auth/location context
3. Playwright selector waits timeout if elements don't render
4. Hardcoded API keys/secrets get revoked

150.         Playwright로 JS를 실행하고 렌더링된 DOM 또는 API 인터셉트로 데이터를 수집한다.

The "가격인하" label just indicates it's been reduced, but we'd need to visit each product page to get the original price.

So for Uniqlo, the sale/feature page items just show ONE price (the sale price), and "가격인하" is a boolean flag. The original prices are only on individual product detail pages.

This means my current approach is correct — we get the sale price but can't determine discount % without visiting each product page individually (too many requests). Let's keep the items as they are (95 items with sale price known, discount=0 since we don't know the original), and update the event_name to "유니클로 가격인하" which accurately reflects what we know.

**Problem:** The error `py -m pip install --quiet fastapi uvicorn 2>&1 | Out-Null` throws `NativeCommandError` in PowerShell

**Verification:**
- ✅ `py --version` → Works: `Python 3.13.2`
- ❌ `python --version` → "term 'python' is not recognized"

- ✅ `py -m pip install fastapi uvicorn` → **Works successfully** (command itself is correct)

**Issue:** The PowerShell script `start-admin.ps1` uses `py` correctly at line 26, but the error comes from running the command through `Out-Null` pipe with error redirection. **The command IS working** — the test confirms this. The error message may be misleading or context-dependent.

**Recommendation:** The script is correctly using `py` (not `python`). No changes needed. If NativeCommandError occurs, it's likely due to:
1. Running PowerShell in a restricted execution policy environment
2. Temporary PATH issues (restart PowerShell/terminal)
3. The `Out-Null` pipe context in certain PowerShell versions

1. const API_BASE = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || 'http://localhost:8000';
2. 
3. class ApiClient {
4.   constructor(baseUrl) {
5.     this.baseUrl = baseUrl;
6.     this.token = localStorage.getItem('access_token');
7.   }
8. 
9.   setToken(token) {
10.     this.token = token;
11.     localStorage.setItem('access_token', token);
12.   }
13. 
14.   clearToken() {
15.     this.token = null;
16.     localStorage.removeItem('access_token');
17.   }
18. 
19.   async request(path, options = {}) {
20.     const headers = {
21.       'Content-Type': 'application/json',
22.       ...options.headers,
23.     };
24.     if (this.token) {
25.       headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${this.token}`;
26.     }
27. 
28.     const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}${path}`, {
29.       ...options,
30.       headers,
31.     });
32. 
33.     if (response.status === 401) {
34.       const refreshed = await this.refreshToken();
35.       if (refreshed) {
36.         headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${this.token}`;
37.         return fetch(`${this.baseUrl}${path}`, { ...options, headers });
38.       }
39.       this.clearToken();
40.       window.location.href = '/login';
41.     }
42. 
43.     return response;
44.   }
45. 
46.   async get(path, params) {
47.     const query = params ? '?' + new URLSearchParams(params).toString() : '';
48.     return this.request(`${path}${query}`);
49.   }
50. 
51.   async post(path, data) {
52.     return this.request(path, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(data) });
53.   }
54. 
55.   async put(path, data) {
56.     return this.request(path, { method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify(data) });
57.   }
58. 
59.   async delete(path) {
60.     return this.request(path, { method: 'DELETE' });
61.   }
62. 
63.   async refreshToken() {
64.     try {
65.       const refreshToken = localStorage.getItem('refresh_token');
66.       if (!refreshToken) return false;
67. 
68.       const response = await fetch(`${this.baseUrl}/api/auth/refresh`, {
69.         method: 'POST',
70.         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
71.         body: JSON.stringify({ refresh_token: refreshToken }),
72.       });
73. 
74.       if (!response.ok) return false;
75. 
76.       const data = await response.json();
77.       this.setToken(data.access_token);
78.       localStorage.setItem('refresh_token', data.refresh_token);
79.       return true;
80.     } catch {
81.       return false;
82.     }
83.   }
84. }
85. 
86. export const api = new ApiClient(API_BASE);
87.

### Step 1: Make website backend share DB Admin's database
The simplest approach: Website backend imports and uses the same DBStorage + models from db-admin.

Edit `packages/website/backend/api/app.py`:
```python
def create_app(storage=None, engine=None, event_bus=None) -> FastAPI:
    # ... existing code ...
    
    # If no storage provided, auto-initialize from shared DB
    if storage is None:
        try:
            import sys, os
            # Add db-admin backend to path so we can import its storage
            db_admin_path = os.path.join(
                os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(__file__)))),
                "db-admin", "backend"
            )
            if db_admin_path not in sys.path:
                sys.path.insert(0, db_admin_path)
            
            from storage.db import DBStorage
            
            # Use the same SQLite file as db-admin
            db_path = os.path.join(db_admin_path, "walletguardian.db")
            storage = DBStorage(f"sqlite:///{db_path}")
            storage.init_db()
        except Exception as e:
            import logging
            logging.warning(f"DB 연결 실패, mock 데이터 사용: {e}")
            storage = None
    
    app.state.storage = storage
```

1. """크롤 파이프라인 — 크롤→파싱→검증→변환→저장 전체 흐름 관리."""

41. class PipelineResult:
42.     """단일 크롤러 파이프라인 실행 결과."""
43. 
44.     def __init__(
45.         self,
46.         crawler_name: str,
47.         status: str = "success",
48.         items_found: int = 0,
49.         items_valid: int = 0,
50.         items_saved: int = 0,
51.         duration: float = 0.0,
52.         errors: list[str] | None = None,
53.     ):
54.         self.crawler_name = crawler_name
55.         self.status = status
56.         self.items_found = items_found
57.         self.items_valid = items_valid
58.         self.items_saved = items_saved
59.         self.duration = duration
60.         self.errors = errors or []
61. 
62.     def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
63.         return {
64.             "crawler_name": self.crawler_name,
65.             "status": self.status,
66.             "items_found": self.items_found,
67.             "items_valid": self.items_valid,
68.             "items_saved": self.items_saved,
69.             "duration": round(self.duration, 2),
70.             "errors": self.errors,
71.         }
72. 
73. 
74. class CrawlPipeline:
75.     """크롤→파싱→검증→변환→저장 전체 파이프라인."""
76. 
77.     def __init__(
78.         self,
79.         registry: CrawlerRegistry | None = None,
80.         event_bus: EventBus | None = None,
81.         db_api_url: str = DB_ADMIN_API_URL,
82.         default_retry_count: int = 3,
83.     ):
84.         self.registry = registry or CrawlerRegistry()
85.         self.event_bus = event_bus or EventBus()
86.         self.db_api_url = db_api_url
87.         self.default_retry_count = default_retry_count
88. 
89.     async def run_crawler(self, crawler_name: str) -> PipelineResult:
90.         """단일 크롤러를 파이프라인 전체 흐름으로 실행."""
91.         start = time.monotonic()
92.         errors: list[str] = []
93. 
94.         await self.event_bus.publish(Event(
95.             event_type=CRAWL_STARTED,
96.             data={"crawler_name": crawler_name},
97.             source="pipeline",
98.         ))
99. 
100.         # 1. Crawl — 크롤러 인스턴스화 및 실행
101.         try:
102.             crawler = self.registry.get_crawler(crawler_name)
103.         except (KeyError, ImportError) as exc:
104.             return self._fail(crawler_name, str(exc), start)
105. 
106.         config = self.registry._registry.get(crawler_name, {}).get("config", {})
107.         retry_count = config.get("schedule", {}).get(
108.             "retry_count", self.default_retry_count
109.         )
110. 
111.         crawl_result: CrawlResult | None = None
112.         for attempt in range(1, retry_count + 1):
113.             try:
114.                 crawl_result = await crawler.crawl()
115.                 if crawl_result.status == CrawlStatus.SUCCESS:
116.                     break
117.                 errors.append(
118.                     f"attempt {attempt}: status={crawl_result.status.value}"
119.                 )
120.             except Exception as exc:
121.                 errors.append(f"attempt {attempt}: {exc}")
122.                 if attempt < retry_count:
123.                     await asyncio.sleep(min(attempt * 2, 10))
124. 
125.         if crawl_result is None or crawl_result.status != CrawlStatus.SUCCESS:
126.             return self._fail(
127.                 crawler_name,
128.                 crawl_result.error_msg if crawl_result else "all retries failed",
129.                 start,
130.                 errors,
131.             )
132. 
133.         raw_items = crawl_result.items or []
134.         items_found = len(raw_items)
135.         if items_found == 0:
136.             return self._fail(crawler_name, "no items collected", start, errors)
137. 
138.         # 2. Parse — 이미 dict 리스트이므로 pass-through
139.         items = list(raw_items)
140. 
141.         # 3. Validate
142.         required = config.get("output", {}).get("required_fields", [])
143.         if required:
144.             items, invalid = validate_items(items, required)
145.             if invalid:
146.                 errors.append(f"validation: {len(invalid)} items missing fields")
147.         items, price_invalid = validate_price_range(items)
148.         if price_invalid:
149.             errors.append(f"price_range: {len(price_invalid)} items out of range")
150.         items = normalize_prices(items)
151.         items = deduplicate(items, key_fields=["name", "price"])
152.         items = enrich_with_category(items)
153. 
154.         items_valid = len(items)
155. 
156.         # 4. Transform
157.         model_type = config.get("output", {}).get("model", "DiscountItem")
158.         if model_type == "HotdealPost":
159.             records = to_hotdeal_prices(items, source="hotdeal")
160.         else:
161.             records = to_discount_history(items, source="mart_discount")
162. 
163.         # 5. Store — 대기열 또는 직접 DB 저장
164.         if SKIP_REVIEW:
165.             items_saved = await self._store(records, errors)
166.         else:
167.             items_saved = await self._store_to_ingestion(
168.                 crawler_name=crawler_name,
169.                 crawl_status="success",
170.                 items=items,
171.                 schema_type=model_type,
172.                 strategy_used=crawl_result.strategy_used,
173.                 duration_seconds=time.monotonic() - start,
174.                 errors=errors,
175.             )
176. 
177.         duration = time.monotonic() - start
178.         result = PipelineResult(
179.             crawler_name=crawler_name,
180.             status="success",
181.             items_found=items_found,
182.             items_valid=items_valid,
183.             items_saved=items_saved,
184.             duration=duration,
185.             errors=errors,
186.         )
187. 
188.         await self.event_bus.publish(Event(
189.             event_type=CRAWL_COMPLETED,
190.             data=result.to_dict(),
191.             source="pipeline",
192.         ))
193. 
194.         logger.info(
195.             f"[Pipeline] {crawler_name}: "
196.             f"found={items_found} valid={items_valid} saved={items_saved} "
197.             f"duration={duration:.2f}s"
198.         )
199.         return result
200. 
201.     async def run_all(
202.         self, category: Optional[str] = None
203.     ) -> list[PipelineResult]:
204.         """등록된 모든(또는 카테고리 필터) 크롤러 동시 실행."""
205.         crawlers = self.registry.list_crawlers()
206.         if category:
207.             crawlers = [c for c in crawlers if c["category"] == category]
208.         names = [c["name"] for c in crawlers]
209.         return await self.run_batch(names)
210. 
211.     async def run_batch(self, crawler_names: list[str]) -> list[PipelineResult]:
212.         """지정된 크롤러들을 동시 실행."""
213.         tasks = [self.run_crawler(name) for name in crawler_names]
214.         return list(await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=False))
215. 
216.     # --- internal helpers ---
217. 
218.     async def _store(
219.         self, records: list[dict[str, Any]], errors: list[str]
220.     ) -> int:
221.         """DB-Admin API 로 레코드 전송. 실패 시 0 반환."""
222.         if not records:
223.             return 0
224.         try:
225.             async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30) as client:
226.                 resp = await client.post(self.db_api_url, json=records)
227.                 resp.raise_for_status()
228.                 return len(records)
229.         except Exception as exc:
230.             errors.append(f"store: {exc}")
231.             logger.warning(f"[Pipeline] store failed: {exc}")
232.             return 0
233. 
234.     async def _store_to_ingestion(
235.         self,
236.         crawler_name: str,
237.         crawl_status: str,
238.         items: list[dict[str, Any]],
239.         schema_type: str,
240.         strategy_used: str | None,
241.         duration_seconds: float,
242.         errors: list[str],
243.     ) -> int:
244.         """대기열(Pending Ingestion)에 크롤 결과 제출."""
245.         if not items:
246.             return 0
247.         payload = {
248.             "crawler_name": crawler_name,
249.             "crawl_status": crawl_status,
250.             "items": items,
251.             "schema_type": schema_type,
252.             "strategy_used": strategy_used,
253.             "duration_seconds": round(duration_seconds, 2),
254.             "errors": [{"message": e} for e in errors],
255.         }
256.         try:
257.             async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30) as client:
258.                 resp = await client.post(INGESTION_API_URL, json=payload)
259.                 resp.raise_for_status()
260.                 return len(items)
261.         except Exception as exc:
262.             errors.append(f"ingestion_submit: {exc}")
263.             logger.warning(f"[Pipeline] ingestion submit failed: {exc}")
264.             return 0
265. 
266.     def _fail(
267.         self,
268.         crawler_name: str,
269.         msg: str,
270.         start: float,
271.         errors: list[str] | None = None,
272.     ) -> PipelineResult:
273.         errs = list(errors or [])
274.         errs.append(msg)
275.         duration = time.monotonic() - start
276. 
277.         asyncio.ensure_future(self.event_bus.publish(Event(
278.             event_type=CRAWL_FAILED,
279.             data={"crawler_name": crawler_name, "error": msg},
280.             source="pipeline",
281.         )))
282. 
283.         return PipelineResult(
284.             crawler_name=crawler_name,
285.             status="failed",
286.             duration=duration,
287.             errors=errs,
288.         )
289.

45.

- `POST /{crawler_id}/run` now creates a background `asyncio.create_task` that runs the crawler through `CrawlPipeline`, which handles crawl → validate → transform → submit to DB Admin's ingestion queue
- Prevents duplicate runs (returns early if already running)
- `GET /{crawler_id}/status` returns real results (items_found/valid/saved, duration, errors)

**2. `registry.py` — Fixed `list_crawlers` crash**
- `schedule` field in plugin.yaml can be a string or dict — now handles both
- `difficulty` and `category` fields resolve from multiple possible locations

**3. 6 hotdeal `plugin.yaml` files — Added `output.model: HotdealPost`**
- Without this, pipeline defaults to `DiscountItem`, causing wrong schema type in the ingestion queue

**4. `walletguardian.db` — Seeded with initial data**
- 74 categories, 16 products, 2480+ baseline prices, keywords

### Verified End-to-End
- 뽐뿌: 26 found → 21 valid → 21 saved to ingestion queue (quality: 0.914)
- 클리앙: 31 found → 12 valid → 12 saved to ingestion queue (quality: 0.85)

**Note:** DB Admin needs `DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///walletguardian.db` env var (defaults to PostgreSQL otherwise). The pipeline reads `INGESTION_API_URL` env var to find DB Admin (default: `http://localhost:8002/api/ingestions`).
```

47. def _calculate_quality(items: list[dict], schema_type: str) -> tuple[float, dict]:
48.     """크롤 데이터의 품질 점수(0.0~1.0)와 상세 내역 반환."""
49.     if not items:
50.         return 0.0, {"error": "항목 없음"}
51. 
52.     # 필수 필드 검사
53.     if schema_type == "HotdealPost":
54.         required = ["title", "url"]
55.     else:
56.         required = ["name", "sale_price"]
57. 
58.     missing_count = 0
59.     for item in items:
60.         for field in required:
61.             if not item.get(field):
62.                 missing_count += 1
63.                 break
64. 
65.     missing_ratio = missing_count / len(items)
66. 
67.     # 가격 이상치 검사
68.     price_field = "price" if schema_type == "HotdealPost" else "sale_price"
69.     prices = [
70.         item[price_field]
71.         for item in items
72.         if isinstance(item.get(price_field), (int, float)) and item[price_field] > 0
73.     ]
74. 
75.     outlier_count = 0
76.     if len(prices) >= 3:
77.         avg = sum(prices) / len(prices)
78.         for p in prices:
79.             if p > avg * 5 or p < avg * 0.05:
80.                 outlier_count += 1
81. 
82.     outlier_ratio = outlier_count / len(items)
83. 
84.     # 중복 검사
85.     name_field = "title" if schema_type == "HotdealPost" else "name"
86.     seen: set[tuple] = set()
87.     dup_count = 0
88.     for item in items:
89.         key = (item.get(name_field, ""), item.get(price_field))
90.         if key in seen:
91.             dup_count += 1
92.         seen.add(key)
93. 
94.     dup_ratio = dup_count / len(items)
95. 
96.     # 점수 계산
97.     score = 1.0 - (missing_ratio * 0.4) - (outlier_ratio * 0.3) - (dup_ratio * 0.3)
98.     score = max(0.0, min(1.0, round(score, 3)))
99. 
100.     details = {
101.         "total_items": len(items),
102.         "missing_fields": missing_count,
103.         "outliers": outlier_count,
104.         "duplicates": dup_count,
105.         "missing_ratio": round(missing_ratio, 3),
106.         "outlier_ratio": round(outlier_ratio, 3),
107.         "duplicate_ratio": round(dup_ratio, 3),
108.     }
109.     return score, details
110.

14.   return ['전체', ...events];
15. }

17. function findCommonProducts(martDeals) {
18.   const productNames = {};
19.   for (const [martKey, items] of Object.entries(martDeals)) {
20.     const martInfo = MARTS.find(m => m.key === martKey);
21.     for (const item of (items || [])) {
22.       const base = item.name.replace(/\s+\d+.*$/, '').replace(/\s+(1kg|100g|1L|5P|2입|24입|30구|12|21포|500g|1통|1포기|2마리|1망|793g|1.5kg|2.3L|600g).*$/i, '').trim();
23.       if (!productNames[base]) productNames[base] = {};
24.       productNames[base][martKey] = { ...item, mart: martInfo?.name, color: martInfo?.color };
25.     }
26.   }
27.   return Object.entries(productNames)
28.     .filter(([, marts]) => Object.keys(marts).length >= 2)
29.     .map(([name, marts]) => ({ name, marts }));
30. }
31.

### **🚨 CRITICAL ISSUE: DOUBLE PREFIX BUG**

**Location:** `packages/db-admin/backend/api/routes/ingestion.py:20`

```python
router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/ingestions", tags=["ingestions"])  # ❌ WRONG
```

**Problem:**
- The ingestion router declares its own `/api/ingestions` prefix
- All other routes use only their resource prefix (`/products`, `/categories`, etc.)
- When included in `app.py`, FastAPI combines prefixes, resulting in:
  - **Expected:** `/api/ingestions`
  - **Actual:** `/api/ingestions/api/ingestions` (DOUBLE PREFIX)

**Why it fails:**
- Frontend calls: `GET /api/ingestions?status=crawler_approved`
- Backend routes: `GET /api/ingestions/api/ingestions?status=crawler_approved` ← Doesn't exist!
- Result: 404 errors on all ingestion endpoints when accessed via frontend proxy

**Fix Required:**
```python
router = APIRouter(prefix="/ingestions", tags=["ingestions"])  # ✅ CORRECT
```

## 🔴 CRITICAL MISMATCHES

### Issue #1: `/api/marts/{key}/deals` → `/api/marts/{store}/promotions` 
**Severity:** HIGH  
**Location:** `MartPage.jsx` line 51, `HomePage.jsx` line 55  
**Frontend Code:**
```javascript
fetch(`/api/marts/${key}/deals`).then(r => r.json())
```
**Backend Route:**
```python
@router.get("/{store}/promotions")  # /api/marts/{store}/promotions
```
**Impact:** Mart deals are currently **404 errors** in frontend  
**Fix:** Frontend should use `/api/marts/{store}/promotions`

---

### Issue #2: `/api/products/{productId}/prices` → `/api/products/{product_id}/price-history`
**Severity:** MEDIUM

**Frontend Code:**
```javascript

```

```
**Impact:** Price history queries fail; chart data won't load  
**Fix:** Frontend should use `/api/products/{product_id}/price-history`

---

### Issue #3: Social Login Endpoint Mismatch
**Severity:** HIGH  
**Location:** `authService.js` line 44

```

**Impact:** Social login completely broken (POST vs GET, wrong flow)  
**Fix:** Backend should support `POST /api/auth/social/{provider}` or frontend should use OAuth redirect flow

34.     ).all()
35.

44.             row.unit,
45.         ])

54.     if category_id:

56. 
57.     products = session.execute(stmt).scalars().all()
58. 
59.     data = [

62.             "name": p.name,

64.             "unit": p.unit,

66.         }
67.         for p in products
68.     ]
69.     return json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

1. """데이터 내보내기 서비스"""
2. from __future__ import annotations
3. 
4. import csv
5. import io
6. import json
7. from datetime import datetime, timedelta
8. 
9. from sqlalchemy import select, func
10. from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
11. 
12. from storage.models import (
13.     Product, BaselinePrice, DiscountHistory, HotdealPrice,
14.     Category, Keyword,
15. )
16. 
17. 
18. def export_prices_csv(
19.     session: Session, product_id: int, days: int = 30
20. ) -> str:
21.     """가격 이력 CSV 내보내기"""
22.     since = datetime.utcnow() - timedelta(days=days)
23. 
24.     rows = session.execute(
25.         select(
26.             BaselinePrice.recorded_at,
27.             BaselinePrice.price,
28.             BaselinePrice.source,
29.             BaselinePrice.unit,
30.         ).where(
31.             BaselinePrice.product_id == product_id,
32.             BaselinePrice.recorded_at >= since,
33.         ).order_by(BaselinePrice.recorded_at)
34.     ).all()
35. 
36.     output = io.StringIO()
37.     writer = csv.writer(output)
38.     writer.writerow(["date", "price", "source", "unit"])
39.     for row in rows:
40.         writer.writerow([
41.             row.recorded_at.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") if row.recorded_at else "",
42.             row.price,
43.             row.source,
44.             row.unit,
45.         ])
46.     return output.getvalue()
47. 
48. 
49. def export_products_json(
50.     session: Session, category_id: str | None = None
51. ) -> str:
52.     """상품 목록 JSON 내보내기"""
53.     stmt = select(Product).where(Product.is_active == True)
54.     if category_id:
55.         stmt = stmt.where(Product.category_id == category_id)
56. 
57.     products = session.execute(stmt).scalars().all()
58. 
59.     data = [
60.         {
61.             "id": p.id,
62.             "name": p.name,
63.             "category_id": p.category_id,
64.             "unit": p.unit,
65.             "description": p.description,
66.         }
67.         for p in products
68.     ]
69.     return json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
70. 
71. 
72. def get_statistics_summary(session: Session) -> dict:
73.     """전체 통계 요약"""
74.     product_count = session.execute(
75.         select(func.count()).select_from(Product)
76.     ).scalar() or 0
77. 
78.     baseline_count = session.execute(
79.         select(func.count()).select_from(BaselinePrice)
80.     ).scalar() or 0
81. 
82.     discount_count = session.execute(
83.         select(func.count()).select_from(DiscountHistory)
84.     ).scalar() or 0
85. 
86.     hotdeal_count = session.execute(
87.         select(func.count()).select_from(HotdealPrice)
88.     ).scalar() or 0
89. 
90.     category_count = session.execute(
91.         select(func.count()).select_from(Category)
92.     ).scalar() or 0
93. 
94.     keyword_count = session.execute(
95.         select(func.count()).select_from(Keyword)
96.     ).scalar() or 0
97. 
98.     avg_baseline = session.execute(
99.         select(func.avg(BaselinePrice.price)).select_from(BaselinePrice)
100.     ).scalar()
101. 
102.     return {
103.         "products": product_count,
104.         "baseline_prices": baseline_count,
105.         "discount_records": discount_count,
106.         "hotdeal_records": hotdeal_count,
107.         "categories": category_count,
108.         "keywords": keyword_count,
109.         "avg_baseline_price": round(avg_baseline, 1) if avg_baseline else 0,
110.         "generated_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
111.     }

399.                 </span>
400.               )}
401.             </div>
402.           ))}
