```
1. """대기열(Pending Ingestion) API — 크롤 결과 수신, 검토, 승인/거부"""
2. 
3. import json
4. from datetime import datetime
5. from typing import Optional
6. 
7. from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query
8. from pydantic import BaseModel
9. from sqlalchemy import func
10. 
11. from services.base import get_session
12. from storage.models import (
13.     PendingIngestion,
14.     IngestionStatus,
15.     BaselinePrice,
16.     DiscountHistory,
17.     HotdealPrice,
18. )
19. 
20. router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/ingestions", tags=["ingestions"])
21. 
22. 
23. # --- Request 모델 ---
24. 
25. 
26. class IngestionSubmit(BaseModel):
27.     crawler_name: str
28.     crawl_status: str = "success"
29.     items: list[dict] = []
30.     schema_type: str = "DiscountItem"
31.     strategy_used: Optional[str] = None
32.     duration_seconds: Optional[float] = None
33.     errors: list[dict] = []
34.     source_url: Optional[str] = None
35. 
36. 
37. class ReviewRequest(BaseModel):
38.     action: str  # "approve", "reject", "partial"
39.     notes: Optional[str] = None
40.     approved_item_indices: Optional[list[int]] = None
41.     rejected_reason: Optional[str] = None
42. 
43. 
44. # --- 품질 점수 계산 ---
45. 
46. 
47. def _calculate_quality(items: list[dict], schema_type: str) -> tuple[float, dict]:
48.     """크롤 데이터의 품질 점수(0.0~1.0)와 상세 내역 반환."""
49.     if not items:
50.         return 0.0, {"error": "항목 없음"}
51. 
52.     # 필수 필드 검사
53.     if schema_type == "HotdealPost":
54.         required = ["title", "url"]
55.     else:
56.         required = ["name", "sale_price"]
57. 
58.     missing_count = 0
59.     for item in items:
60.         for field in required:
61.             if not item.get(field):
62.                 missing_count += 1
63.                 break
64. 
65.     missing_ratio = missing_count / len(items)
66. 
67.     # 가격 이상치 검사
68.     price_field = "price" if schema_type == "HotdealPost" else "sale_price"
69.     prices = [
70.         item[price_field]
71.         for item in items
72.         if isinstance(item.get(price_field), (int, float)) and item[price_field] > 0
73.     ]
74. 
75.     outlier_count = 0
76.     if len(prices) >= 3:
77.         avg = sum(prices) / len(prices)
78.         for p in prices:
79.             if p > avg * 5 or p < avg * 0.05:
80.                 outlier_count += 1
81. 
82.     outlier_ratio = outlier_count / len(items)
83. 
84.     # 중복 검사
85.     name_field = "title" if schema_type == "HotdealPost" else "name"
86.     seen: set[tuple] = set()
87.     dup_count = 0
88.     for item in items:
89.         key = (item.get(name_field, ""), item.get(price_field))
90.         if key in seen:
91.             dup_count += 1
92.         seen.add(key)
93. 
94.     dup_ratio = dup_count / len(items)
95. 
96.     # 점수 계산
97.     score = 1.0 - (missing_ratio * 0.4) - (outlier_ratio * 0.3) - (dup_ratio * 0.3)
98.     score = max(0.0, min(1.0, round(score, 3)))
99. 
100.     details = {
101.         "total_items": len(items),
102.         "missing_fields": missing_count,
103.         "outliers": outlier_count,
104.         "duplicates": dup_count,
105.         "missing_ratio": round(missing_ratio, 3),
106.         "outlier_ratio": round(outlier_ratio, 3),
107.         "duplicate_ratio": round(dup_ratio, 3),
108.     }
109.     return score, details
110. 
111. 
112. # --- 엔드포인트 ---
113. 
114. 
115. @router.get("/stats")
116. def ingestion_stats():
117.     """대기열 통계 — 상태별 건수, 크롤러별 건수."""
118.     session = get_session()
119.     try:
120.         status_rows = (
121.             session.query(PendingIngestion.status, func.count())
122.             .group_by(PendingIngestion.status)
123.             .all()
124.         )
125.         status_counts: dict[str, int] = {s.value: 0 for s in IngestionStatus}
126.         for status_val, cnt in status_rows:
127.             key = status_val.value if hasattr(status_val, "value") else status_val
128.             status_counts[key] = cnt
129. 
130.         crawler_rows = (
131.             session.query(PendingIngestion.crawler_name, func.count())
132.             .group_by(PendingIngestion.crawler_name)
133.             .all()
134.         )
135.         by_crawler = {name: cnt for name, cnt in crawler_rows}
136. 
137.         return {
138.             "total_pending": status_counts.get("pending", 0),
139.             "total_approved": status_counts.get("approved", 0),
140.             "total_rejected": status_counts.get("rejected", 0),
141.             "total_crawler_approved": status_counts.get("crawler_approved", 0),
142.             "total_partial": status_counts.get("partial", 0),
143.             "by_crawler": by_crawler,
144.         }
145.     finally:
146.         session.close()
147. 
148. 
149. @router.post("", status_code=201)
150. def submit_ingestion(body: IngestionSubmit):
151.     """크롤러가 데이터를 대기열에 제출."""
152.     session = get_session()
153.     try:
154.         quality_score, quality_details = _calculate_quality(
155.             body.items, body.schema_type
156.         )
157.         row = PendingIngestion(
158.             crawler_name=body.crawler_name,
159.             crawl_status=body.crawl_status,
160.             strategy_used=body.strategy_used,
161.             items_count=len(body.items),
162.             items_json=json.dumps(body.items, ensure_ascii=False, default=str),
163.             schema_type=body.schema_type,
164.             quality_score=quality_score,
165.             quality_details=quality_details,
166.             errors_json=(
167.                 json.dumps(body.errors, ensure_ascii=False, default=str)
168.                 if body.errors
169.                 else None
170.             ),
171.             status=IngestionStatus.PENDING,
172.             crawled_at=datetime.utcnow(),
173.             duration_seconds=body.duration_seconds,
174.             source_url=body.source_url,
175.         )
176.         session.add(row)
177.         session.commit()
178.         session.refresh(row)
179.         return {"id": row.id, "status": "pending", "quality_score": quality_score}
180.     finally:
181.         session.close()
182. 
183. 
184. @router.get("")
185. def list_ingestions(
186.     status: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="상태 필터"),
187.     crawler_name: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="크롤러 필터"),
188.     limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=500),
189.     offset: int = Query(0, ge=0),
190. ):
191.     """대기열 목록 조회 (summary)."""
192.     session = get_session()
193.     try:
194.         q = session.query(PendingIngestion)
195.         if status:
196.             q = q.filter(PendingIngestion.status == status)
197.         if crawler_name:
198.             q = q.filter(PendingIngestion.crawler_name == crawler_name)
199.         q = q.order_by(PendingIngestion.crawled_at.desc())
200.         total = q.count()
201.         rows = q.offset(offset).limit(limit).all()
202.         return {
203.             "total": total,
204.             "items": [
205.                 {
206.                     "id": r.id,
207.                     "crawler_name": r.crawler_name,
208.                     "crawl_status": r.crawl_status,
209.                     "items_count": r.items_count,
210.                     "schema_type": r.schema_type,
211.                     "quality_score": r.quality_score,
212.                     "status": r.status.value
213.                     if hasattr(r.status, "value")
214.                     else r.status,
215.                     "crawled_at": r.crawled_at.isoformat()
216.                     if r.crawled_at
217.                     else None,
218.                     "duration_seconds": r.duration_seconds,
219.                 }
220.                 for r in rows
221.             ],
222.         }
223.     finally:
224.         session.close()

273. @router.post("/{ingestion_id}/crawler-review")
274. def crawler_review(ingestion_id: int, body: ReviewRequest):
275.     """크롤러 관리자 1차 검토 — 승인/거부."""
276.     session = get_session()
277.     try:
278.         row = session.get(PendingIngestion, ingestion_id)
279.         if not row:
280.             raise HTTPException(404, "대기열 항목을 찾을 수 없습니다")
281.         if row.status != IngestionStatus.PENDING:
282.             raise HTTPException(
283.                 400,
284.                 f"현재 상태({row.status.value})에서는 크롤러 검토가 불가합니다",
285.             )
286. 
287.         if body.action == "approve":
288.             row.status = IngestionStatus.CRAWLER_APPROVED
289.         elif body.action == "reject":
290.             row.status = IngestionStatus.REJECTED
291.             row.rejected_reason = body.rejected_reason or body.notes
292.         else:
293.             raise HTTPException(
294.                 400, f"잘못된 액션: {body.action} (approve 또는 reject)"
295.             )
296. 
297.         row.crawler_reviewer_notes = body.notes
298.         row.crawler_reviewed_at = datetime.utcnow()
299.         session.commit()
300.         return {"id": row.id, "status": row.status.value}
301.     finally:
302.         session.close()
303.

305. @router.post("/{ingestion_id}/db-review")
306. def db_review(ingestion_id: int, body: ReviewRequest):
307.     """DB 관리자 최종 검토 — 승인 시 실제 DB 테이블에 삽입."""
308.     session = get_session()
309.     try:
310.         row = session.get(PendingIngestion, ingestion_id)
311.         if not row:
312.             raise HTTPException(404, "대기열 항목을 찾을 수 없습니다")
313.         if row.status != IngestionStatus.CRAWLER_APPROVED:
314.             raise HTTPException(
315.                 400,
316.                 "크롤러 관리자 승인(crawler_approved) 상태에서만 DB 검토가 가능합니다",
317.             )
318. 
319.         items = json.loads(row.items_json) if row.items_json else []
320. 
321.         if body.action == "approve":
322.             saved = _insert_items(session, items, row.schema_type)
323.             row.status = IngestionStatus.APPROVED
324.             row.db_reviewer_notes = body.notes
325.             row.db_reviewed_at = datetime.utcnow()
326.             session.commit()
327.             return {"id": row.id, "status": "approved", "saved": saved}
328. 
329.         elif body.action == "reject":
330.             row.status = IngestionStatus.REJECTED
331.             row.rejected_reason = body.rejected_reason or body.notes
332.             row.db_reviewer_notes = body.notes
333.             row.db_reviewed_at = datetime.utcnow()
334.             session.commit()
335.             return {"id": row.id, "status": "rejected"}
336. 
337.         elif body.action == "partial":
338.             if not body.approved_item_indices:
339.                 raise HTTPException(
340.                     400, "partial 승인 시 approved_item_indices가 필요합니다"
341.                 )
342.             approved = [
343.                 items[i]
344.                 for i in body.approved_item_indices
345.                 if i < len(items)
346.             ]
347.             saved = _insert_items(session, approved, row.schema_type)
348.             row.status = IngestionStatus.PARTIAL
349.             row.approved_items_json = json.dumps(
350.                 approved, ensure_ascii=False, default=str
351.             )
352.             row.db_reviewer_notes = body.notes
353.             row.db_reviewed_at = datetime.utcnow()
354.             session.commit()
355.             return {"id": row.id, "status": "partial", "saved": saved}
356. 
357.         else:
358.             raise HTTPException(400, f"잘못된 액션: {body.action}")
359.     finally:
360.         session.close()
361.

380. 
381. def _insert_items(session, items: list[dict], schema_type: str) -> int:
382.     """승인된 항목을 최종 DB 테이블에 삽입."""
383.     saved = 0
384.     for item in items:
385.         try:
386.             if schema_type == "HotdealPost":
387.                 row = HotdealPrice(
388.                     product_id=item.get("product_id", 1),
389.                     price=float(item.get("price", 0)),
390.                     source=item.get("source_community", "hotdeal"),
391.                     source_url=item.get("url", ""),
392.                     title=item.get("title", ""),
393.                     crawled_at=datetime.utcnow(),
394.                 )
395.             else:
396.                 source = item.get("source", "mart_discount")
397.                 if source in ("government", "mart_regular"):
398.                     row = BaselinePrice(
399.                         product_id=item.get("product_id", 1),
400.                         price=float(
401.                             item.get("sale_price") or item.get("price", 0)
402.                         ),
403.                         source=source,
404.                         unit=item.get("unit", ""),
405.                         recorded_at=datetime.utcnow(),
406.                         region=item.get("region"),
407.                     )
408.                 else:
409.                     row = DiscountHistory(
410.                         product_id=item.get("product_id", 1),
411.                         price=float(
412.                             item.get("sale_price") or item.get("price", 0)
413.                         ),
414.                         original_price=item.get("original_price"),
415.                         discount_rate=item.get("discount_percent"),
416.                         source=source,
417.                         source_url=item.get("detail_url", ""),
418.                         crawled_at=datetime.utcnow(),
419.                     )
420.             session.add(row)
421.             saved += 1
422.         except Exception:
423.             continue
424.     return saved
425.
```

### 💭 Reasoning

*Now I see the issues clearly:

1. **`start-all.ps1` uses `api.app:create_app --factory`** — This calls `create_app()` directly, bypassing `main.py`. So the factory pattern works fine with `--factory` flag. This means the backends ARE starting correctly because `api.app:create_app --factory` is equivalent to `main:app`.

2. **MartPage.jsx line 54**: `(res.data || []).map(d =\> ...)` — The backend `get_mart_promotions` returns `ApiResponse(data=mart_data[db_store])`. 

The problem is that `mart_data[db_store]` is an object with properties like `name`, `color`, and `items`, not an array. So when the frontend tries to call `.map()` on `res.data`, it fails because you can't map over an object. The fix is to access the `items` property instead: `(res.data?.items || []).map(...)`.

3. **HomePage.jsx line 57**: Same issue — `(res.data || []).map(d =\> ...)` needs to be `(res.data?.items || []).map(...)`.

4. **DB-Admin `/api/products` 404**: `start-all.ps1` uses `api.app:create_app --factory`, which should register all the routers with the `/api` prefix. The startup logs show all three services are running, but the frontend is still getting 404s. I need to check the Vite proxy configuration for db-admin to see if it's routing correctly.

5. **DB-Admin `/api/ingestions/stats` 500**: The ingestion route depends on `get_session()`, which reads `settings.DATABASE_URL`. I updated `config.py` to use SQLite as the default, but `start-all.ps1` might be setting an environment variable that overrides it.

6. **Crawler-Admin `/api/crawlers` 500**: This endpoint worked fine when I tested it on port 8011, so it's likely a PYTHONPATH issue with how `start-all.ps1` launches the service.

Now I need to examine the Vite proxy configurations for both admin frontends and verify that `start-all.ps1` is setting the PYTHONPATH correctly.*

```
9. from sqlalchemy import func
10.

13.     PendingIngestion,
14.     IngestionStatus,
15.     BaselinePrice,
16.     DiscountHistory,
17.     HotdealPrice,
18. )

21. 
22. 
23. # --- Request 모델 ---
24. 
25. 
26. class IngestionSubmit(BaseModel):
27.     crawler_name: str
28.     crawl_status: str = "success"
29.     items: list[dict] = []
30.     schema_type: str = "DiscountItem"
31.     strategy_used: Optional[str] = None
32.     duration_seconds: Optional[float] = None
33.     errors: list[dict] = []
34.     source_url: Optional[str] = None
35. 
36. 
37. class ReviewRequest(BaseModel):
38.     action: str  # "approve", "reject", "partial"
39.     notes: Optional[str] = None
40.     approved_item_indices: Optional[list[int]] = None
41.     rejected_reason: Optional[str] = None
42. 
43. 
44. # --- 품질 점수 계산 ---
45. 
46. 
47. def _calculate_quality(items: list[dict], schema_type: str) -> tuple[float, dict]:
48.     """크롤 데이터의 품질 점수(0.0~1.0)와 상세 내역 반환."""
49.     if not items:
50.         return 0.0, {"error": "항목 없음"}
51. 
52.     # 필수 필드 검사
53.     if schema_type == "HotdealPost":
54.         required = ["title", "url"]
55.     else:
56.         required = ["name", "sale_price"]
57. 
58.     missing_count = 0
59.     for item in items:
60.         for field in required:
61.             if not item.get(field):
62.                 missing_count += 1
63.                 break
64. 
65.     missing_ratio = missing_count / len(items)
66. 
67.     # 가격 이상치 검사
68.     price_field = "price" if schema_type == "HotdealPost" else "sale_price"
69.     prices = [
70.         item[price_field]
71.         for item in items
72.         if isinstance(item.get(price_field), (int, float)) and item[price_field] > 0
73.     ]
74. 
75.     outlier_count = 0
76.     if len(prices) >= 3:
77.         avg = sum(prices) / len(prices)
78.         for p in prices:
79.             if p > avg * 5 or p < avg * 0.05:
80.                 outlier_count += 1
81. 
82.     outlier_ratio = outlier_count / len(items)
83. 
84.     # 중복 검사
85.     name_field = "title" if schema_type == "HotdealPost" else "name"
86.     seen: set[tuple] = set()
87.     dup_count = 0
88.     for item in items:
89.         key = (item.get(name_field, ""), item.get(price_field))
90.         if key in seen:
91.             dup_count += 1
92.         seen.add(key)
93. 
94.     dup_ratio = dup_count / len(items)
95. 
96.     # 점수 계산
97.     score = 1.0 - (missing_ratio * 0.4) - (outlier_ratio * 0.3) - (dup_ratio * 0.3)
98.     score = max(0.0, min(1.0, round(score, 3)))
99. 
100.     details = {
101.         "total_items": len(items),
102.         "missing_fields": missing_count,
103.         "outliers": outlier_count,
104.         "duplicates": dup_count,
105.         "missing_ratio": round(missing_ratio, 3),
106.         "outlier_ratio": round(outlier_ratio, 3),
107.         "duplicate_ratio": round(dup_ratio, 3),
108.     }
109.     return score, details
110. 
111. 
112. # --- 엔드포인트 ---
113. 
114.

274. def crawler_review(ingestion_id: int, body: ReviewRequest):
275.     """크롤러 관리자 1차 검토 — 승인/거부."""
276.     session = get_session()
277.     try:
278.         row = session.get(PendingIngestion, ingestion_id)
279.         if not row:
280.             raise HTTPException(404, "대기열 항목을 찾을 수 없습니다")
281.         if row.status != IngestionStatus.PENDING:
282.             raise HTTPException(
283.                 400,
284.                 f"현재 상태({row.status.value})에서는 크롤러 검토가 불가합니다",
285.             )
286. 
287.         if body.action == "approve":
288.             row.status = IngestionStatus.CRAWLER_APPROVED
289.         elif body.action == "reject":
290.             row.status = IngestionStatus.REJECTED
291.             row.rejected_reason = body.rejected_reason or body.notes
292.         else:
293.             raise HTTPException(
294.                 400, f"잘못된 액션: {body.action} (approve 또는 reject)"
295.             )
296. 
297.         row.crawler_reviewer_notes = body.notes
298.         row.crawler_reviewed_at = datetime.utcnow()
299.         session.commit()
300.         return {"id": row.id, "status": row.status.value}
301.     finally:
302.         session.close()
303. 
304. 
305. @router.post("/{ingestion_id}/db-review")
306. def db_review(ingestion_id: int, body: ReviewRequest):
307.     """DB 관리자 최종 검토 — 승인 시 실제 DB 테이블에 삽입."""
308.     session = get_session()
309.     try:
310.         row = session.get(PendingIngestion, ingestion_id)
311.         if not row:
312.             raise HTTPException(404, "대기열 항목을 찾을 수 없습니다")
313.         if row.status != IngestionStatus.CRAWLER_APPROVED:
314.             raise HTTPException(
315.                 400,
316.                 "크롤러 관리자 승인(crawler_approved) 상태에서만 DB 검토가 가능합니다",
317.             )
318. 
319.         items = json.loads(row.items_json) if row.items_json else []
320. 
321.         if body.action == "approve":
322.             saved = _insert_items(session, items, row.schema_type)
323.             row.status = IngestionStatus.APPROVED
324.             row.db_reviewer_notes = body.notes
325.             row.db_reviewed_at = datetime.utcnow()
326.             session.commit()
327.             return {"id": row.id, "status": "approved", "saved": saved}
328. 
329.         elif body.action == "reject":
330.             row.status = IngestionStatus.REJECTED
331.             row.rejected_reason = body.rejected_reason or body.notes
332.             row.db_reviewer_notes = body.notes
333.             row.db_reviewed_at = datetime.utcnow()
334.             session.commit()
335.             return {"id": row.id, "status": "rejected"}
336. 
337.         elif body.action == "partial":
338.             if not body.approved_item_indices:
339.                 raise HTTPException(
340.                     400, "partial 승인 시 approved_item_indices가 필요합니다"
341.                 )
342.             approved = [
343.                 items[i]
344.                 for i in body.approved_item_indices
345.                 if i < len(items)
346.             ]
347.             saved = _insert_items(session, approved, row.schema_type)
348.             row.status = IngestionStatus.PARTIAL
349.             row.approved_items_json = json.dumps(
350.                 approved, ensure_ascii=False, default=str
351.             )
352.             row.db_reviewer_notes = body.notes
353.             row.db_reviewed_at = datetime.utcnow()
354.             session.commit()
355.             return {"id": row.id, "status": "partial", "saved": saved}
356. 
357.         else:
358.             raise HTTPException(400, f"잘못된 액션: {body.action}")
359.     finally:
360.         session.close()
361. 
362. 
363. @router.delete("/{ingestion_id}")
364. def delete_ingestion(ingestion_id: int):
365.     """대기열 항목 삭제."""
366.     session = get_session()
367.     try:
368.         row = session.get(PendingIngestion, ingestion_id)
369.         if not row:
370.             raise HTTPException(404, "대기열 항목을 찾을 수 없습니다")
371.         session.delete(row)
372.         session.commit()
373.         return {"status": "deleted", "id": ingestion_id}
374.     finally:
375.         session.close()
376. 
377. 
378. # --- 내부 헬퍼 ---
379. 
380. 
381. def _insert_items(session, items: list[dict], schema_type: str) -> int:
382.     """승인된 항목을 최종 DB 테이블에 삽입."""
383.     saved = 0
384.     for item in items:
385.         try:
386.             if schema_type == "HotdealPost":
387.                 row = HotdealPrice(
388.                     product_id=item.get("product_id", 1),
389.                     price=float(item.get("price", 0)),
390.                     source=item.get("source_community", "hotdeal"),
391.                     source_url=item.get("url", ""),
392.                     title=item.get("title", ""),
393.                     crawled_at=datetime.utcnow(),
394.                 )
395.             else:
396.                 source = item.get("source", "mart_discount")
397.                 if source in ("government", "mart_regular"):
398.                     row = BaselinePrice(
399.                         product_id=item.get("product_id", 1),
400.                         price=float(
401.                             item.get("sale_price") or item.get("price", 0)
402.                         ),
403.                         source=source,
404.                         unit=item.get("unit", ""),
405.                         recorded_at=datetime.utcnow(),
406.                         region=item.get("region"),
407.                     )
408.                 else:
409.                     row = DiscountHistory(
410.                         product_id=item.get("product_id", 1),
411.                         price=float(
412.                             item.get("sale_price") or item.get("price", 0)
413.                         ),
414.                         original_price=item.get("original_price"),
415.                         discount_rate=item.get("discount_percent"),
416.                         source=source,
417.                         source_url=item.get("detail_url", ""),
418.                         crawled_at=datetime.utcnow(),
419.                     )
420.             session.add(row)
421.             saved += 1
422.         except Exception:
423.             continue
424.     return saved
425.
```

```
1. """크롤러 관리 라우트."""
2. 
3. from __future__ import annotations
4. 
5. import asyncio
6. import logging
7. from datetime import datetime
8. from typing import Any
9. 
10. from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException
11. from pathlib import Path
12. 
13. from crawlers.registry.registry import CrawlerRegistry
14. from pipeline.pipeline import CrawlPipeline
15. 
16. logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
17. 
18. router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/crawlers", tags=["crawlers"])
19. 
20. _registry: CrawlerRegistry | None = None
21. _pipeline: CrawlPipeline | None = None
22. _crawl_results: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
23. 
24. 
25. def _get_registry() -> CrawlerRegistry:
26.     global _registry
27.     if _registry is None:
28.         crawlers_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent / "crawlers"
29.         _registry = CrawlerRegistry(crawlers_dir=crawlers_dir)
30.         _registry.discover()
31.     return _registry
32. 
33. 
34. def _get_pipeline() -> CrawlPipeline:
35.     global _pipeline
36.     if _pipeline is None:
37.         _pipeline = CrawlPipeline(registry=_get_registry())
38.     return _pipeline
39. 
40. 
41. @router.get("")
42. async def list_crawlers():
43.     """등록된 크롤러 목록."""
44.     reg = _get_registry()
45.     return {"crawlers": reg.list_crawlers()}
46. 
47. 
48. @router.get("/{crawler_id}/status")
49. async def get_crawler_status(crawler_id: str):
50.     """크롤러 상태 조회."""
51.     reg = _get_registry()
52.     try:
53.         reg.get_crawler(crawler_id)
54.     except KeyError:
55.         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Crawler '{crawler_id}' not found")
56. 
57.     result = _crawl_results.get(crawler_id)
58.     if result:
59.         return result
60.     return {
61.         "crawler_id": crawler_id,
62.         "status": "idle",
63.         "last_run": None,
64.     }
65. 
66. 
67. @router.post("/{crawler_id}/run")
68. async def run_crawler(crawler_id: str):
69.     """크롤러 즉시 실행 — 백그라운드에서 파이프라인 실행 후 DB Admin 대기열에 제출."""
70.     reg = _get_registry()
71.     try:
72.         reg.get_crawler(crawler_id)
73.     except KeyError:
74.         raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Crawler '{crawler_id}' not found")
75. 
76.     current = _crawl_results.get(crawler_id)
77.     if current and current.get("status") == "running":
78.         return {
79.             "crawler_id": crawler_id,
80.             "status": "running",
81.             "message": f"Crawler '{crawler_id}' is already running",
82.         }
83. 
84.     _crawl_results[crawler_id] = {
85.         "crawler_id": crawler_id,
86.         "status": "running",
87.         "started_at": datetime.now().isoformat(),
88.         "items_found": 0,
89.         "items_valid": 0,
90.         "items_saved": 0,
91.         "errors": [],
92.     }
93. 
94.     pipeline = _get_pipeline()
95.     asyncio.create_task(_run_and_store(crawler_id, pipeline))
96. 
97.     return {
98.         "crawler_id": crawler_id,
99.         "status": "running",
100.         "message": f"Crawler '{crawler_id}' started",
101.     }
102. 
103. 
104. async def _run_and_store(crawler_id: str, pipeline: CrawlPipeline):
105.     """백그라운드: 크롤러 실행 → 파이프라인 → DB Admin 대기열 제출."""
106.     try:
107.         result = await pipeline.run_crawler(crawler_id)
108.         _crawl_results[crawler_id] = {
109.             "crawler_id": crawler_id,
110.             "status": result.status,
111.             "items_found": result.items_found,
112.             "items_valid": result.items_valid,
113.             "items_saved": result.items_saved,
114.             "duration": result.duration,
115.             "errors": result.errors,
116.             "finished_at": datetime.now().isoformat(),
117.         }
118.         logger.info(
119.             f"Crawler '{crawler_id}' completed: {result.status} "
120.             f"(found={result.items_found}, saved={result.items_saved})"
121.         )
122.     except Exception as e:
123.         _crawl_results[crawler_id] = {
124.             "crawler_id": crawler_id,
125.             "status": "failed",
126.             "error": str(e),
127.             "finished_at": datetime.now().isoformat(),
128.             "errors": [str(e)],
129.         }
130.         logger.error(f"Crawler '{crawler_id}' failed: {e}", exc_info=True)
131.
```

```
1. """대기열(Pending Ingestion) 프록시 API — DB 관리 API로 요청을 전달."""
2. 
3. from __future__ import annotations
4. 
5. import os
6. from typing import Optional
7. 
8. import httpx
9. from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query
10. from pydantic import BaseModel
11. 
12. router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/ingestions", tags=["ingestions"])
13. 
14. DB_ADMIN_URL = os.getenv(
15.     "DB_ADMIN_INGESTION_URL", "http://localhost:8002/api/ingestions"
16. )
17. 
18. 
19. class ReviewRequest(BaseModel):
20.     action: str  # "approve", "reject"
21.     notes: Optional[str] = None
22.     approved_item_indices: Optional[list[int]] = None
23.     rejected_reason: Optional[str] = None
24. 
25. 
26. @router.get("")
27. async def list_ingestions(
28.     status: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="상태 필터"),
29.     crawler_name: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="크롤러 필터"),
30.     limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=500),
31.     offset: int = Query(0, ge=0),
32. ):
33.     """대기열 목록 — DB 관리 API 프록시."""
34.     params: dict = {"limit": limit, "offset": offset}
35.     if status:
36.         params["status"] = status
37.     if crawler_name:
38.         params["crawler_name"] = crawler_name
39.     try:
40.         async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15) as client:
41.             resp = await client.get(DB_ADMIN_URL, params=params)
42.             resp.raise_for_status()
43.             return resp.json()
44.     except httpx.HTTPStatusError as exc:
45.         raise HTTPException(exc.response.status_code, exc.response.text)
46.     except Exception as exc:
47.         raise HTTPException(502, f"DB 관리 API 연결 실패: {exc}")
48. 
49. 
50. @router.get("/{ingestion_id}")
51. async def get_ingestion(ingestion_id: int):
52.     """대기열 상세 — DB 관리 API 프록시."""
53.     try:
```

```python
def get_engine(url=None):
    if url is None:
        from config import settings
        url = settings.DATABASE_URL
    connect_args = {}
    if url.startswith("sqlite"):
        connect_args["check_same_thread"] = False
```

Now for the user's issue — the crawler-admin 500 on `/api/crawlers`. When testing on port 8011, it returned 200. So the crawler-admin code is correct. The issue was that the old server on port 8001 had orphaned sockets.

Similarly, the crawler-admin `/api/ingestions` 500 was because it proxied to `http://localhost:8002/api/ingestions` but the db-admin server on 8002 was either:


- Not running because the old process was killed but left an orphaned socket, or
- Running with outdated code that had routes at `/ingestions` instead of `/api/ingestions`

So the real problem across all these issues is orphaned sockets on Windows blocking servers from restarting with fresh code. When we kill the old processes, the sockets don't fully release, preventing the new servers from binding to those ports properly.

Actually, wait—the user showed all three servers did start successfully with "Application startup complete", which means they did bind to the ports. But the routes are missing the `/api` prefix, so the servers must have started with the old code before our latest commit. I think the user ran `start-all.ps1` before we pushed the fix. The real improvement here would be making the startup script more robust by killing existing processes on those ports first, waiting for them to fully release, and then verifying the routes came up correctly.

Now, the key issues remaining are:
1. ✅ MartPage/HomePage response shape — FIXED
2. The user's `start-all.ps1` needs to properly kill old processes before starting new ones
3. The `start-all.ps1` should handle orphaned sockets

But the most critical fix is making sure `start-all.ps1` kills stale processes. 

Without this, every time the user runs it, the old orphaned sockets prevent the new servers from starting on the correct ports, or the new servers bind but use old code. The servers are binding successfully on 8000, 8001, 8002 with "Application startup complete", but the routes are showing old code — which suggests the user ran an old `start-all.bat` with the original code, then made our changes and committed them, but the old processes are still running and serving requests.

Looking at the startup output more carefully, the reloader process started on port 8000, and if the port was already occupied, the child process would fail to bind silently while the reloader continues showing "Running on http://127.0.0.1:8000", making it appear like everything started correctly when actually the old processes are still handling requests.

````
    if engine is None:
        engine = get_engine()
    SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
    return SessionLocal()
```

**⚠️ POTENTIAL ISSUE**: Each call to `get_session()` creates a **NEW** `sessionmaker` and new session. This is inefficient but should still work.

### **🚨 POSSIBLE ROOT CAUSES**

Based on the code review, here are the most likely causes:

| Issue | Evidence | Impact |
|-------|----------|--------|
| **Database file not initialized** | No `Base.metadata.create_all()` call in startup | Tables may not exist → INSERT fails silently |
| **Database URL misconfigured** | config.py uses `walletguardian.db` but wrong location | Writes to different DB than reads from |
| **Session isolation problem** | Multiple `sessionmaker` instances in `get_session()` | Sessions may not share same DB connection |
| **Autocommit disabled** | SQLAlchemy default is autocommit=False | Changes not persisted without explicit commit |
| **No error handling** | Routes don't catch/log SQLAlchemy errors | Failures silent, user gets 500 error |
````

```
209. function addToTree(tree, parentId, node) {
210.   if (!parentId) return [...tree, node];
211.   return tree.map((item) => {
212.     if (item.id === parentId) {
213.       return { ...item, children: [...(item.children || []), node] };
214.     }
215.     if (item.children) {
216.       return { ...item, children: addToTree(item.children, parentId, node) };
217.     }
218.     return item;
219.   });
220. }
221. 
222. function updateInTree(tree, id, data) {
223.   return tree.map((item) => {
224.     if (item.id === id) return { ...item, ...data };
225.     if (item.children) return { ...item, children: updateInTree(item.children, id, data) };
226.     return item;
227.   });
228. }
229. 
230. function removeFromTree(tree, id) {
231.   return tree
232.     .filter((item) => item.id !== id)
233.     .map((item) => {
234.       if (item.children) return { ...item, children: removeFromTree(item.children, id) };
235.       return item;
236.     });
237. }
```

*Now I have a clear picture of all the issues. Let me analyze:

### Issue 1: Crawler-Admin — `crawler.id` is undefined
The API returns crawlers with `name` as identifier (no `id` field). The crawler API response is:
```json
{"crawlers": [{"name": "giordano", "display_name": "지오다노", "category": "shopping", ...}]}
```

The store fetches these and sets them, but the Crawlers.jsx uses `crawler.id` for key, handleRun, and toggleCrawlerStatus. Since there's no `id` field, it's `undefined`.


I can fix this by either mapping the API response in `adminStore.js` to use `name` as the `id`, or updating Crawlers.jsx to reference `crawler.name` instead.

### Issue 2: DB-Admin Products.jsx — `toLocaleString` on undefined
The API returns products with only `id`, `name`, `category_id`, and `unit` fields, but Products.jsx expects `basePrice`, `currentAvg`, and `tier`. The mock data has these fields, so when the API data overwrites it, those properties disappear and cause the formatting error.

I need to either transform the API response to include default values for the missing fields, or update the API to return them.

### Issue 3: Categories/Keywords not persisting
The store actions like `addCategory`, `addKeyword`, `updateProduct`, and `deleteProduct` are only updating local state without making any API calls. They're all pure state mutations with no backend synchronization.

I need to add actual API calls to all the CRUD operations in the store so changes persist to the database.

````
## **CRAWLER-ADMIN BACKEND** (packages/crawler-admin/backend)

### **1. LINE 107 CRASH — Config Type Error**

**File:** pipeline/pipeline.py (line 106-109)

**The Bug:**
```python
config = self.registry._registry.get(crawler_name, {}).get("config", {})
retry_count = config.get("schedule", {}).get(
    "retry_count", self.default_retry_count
)
```

**Root Cause:** 
- `config` is loaded from `plugin.yaml` files (registry.py line 25: `config = yaml.safe_load(f)`)
- The YAML config dict is correctly structured as `{"name": "...", "schedule": {...}, ...}`
- **However**, if `plugin.yaml` is malformed or `schedule` key contains a string instead of dict, `.get("retry_count")` fails
- Line 107 should be safe if yaml is well-formed

**Full run_crawler Method (lines 89-199):**
```python
async def run_crawler(self, crawler_name: str) -> PipelineResult:
    """단일 크롤러를 파이프라인 전체 흐름으로 실행."""
    start = time.monotonic()
    errors: list[str] = []

    # 1. CRAWL — 크롤러 인스턴스화 및 실행
    try:
        crawler = self.registry.get_crawler(crawler_name)
    except (KeyError, ImportError) as exc:
        return self._fail(crawler_name, str(exc), start)

    config = self.registry._registry.get(crawler_name, {}).get("config", {})
    retry_count = config.get("schedule", {}).get(
        "retry_count", self.default_retry_count
    )
    
    # Retry loop with exponential backoff
    crawl_result: CrawlResult | None = None
    for attempt in range(1, retry_count + 1):
        try:
            crawl_result = await crawler.crawl()
            if crawl_result.status == CrawlStatus.SUCCESS:
                break
            errors.append(f"attempt {attempt}: status={crawl_result.status.value}")
        except Exception as exc:
            errors.append(f"attempt {attempt}: {exc}")
            if attempt < retry_count:
                await asyncio.sleep(min(attempt * 2, 10))

    if crawl_result is None or crawl_result.status != CrawlStatus.SUCCESS:
        return self._fail(
            crawler_name,
            crawl_result.error_msg if crawl_result else "all retries failed",
            start,
            errors,
        )

    # 2. PARSE — 이미 dict 리스트이므로 pass-through
    raw_items = crawl_result.items or []
    items_found = len(raw_items)
    
    # 3. VALIDATE
    required = config.get("output", {}).get("required_fields", [])
    items, invalid = validate_items(items, required) if required else (items, [])
    items, price_invalid = validate_price_range(items)
    items = normalize_prices(items)
    items = deduplicate(items, key_fields=["name", "price"])
    items = enrich_with_category(items)
    items_valid = len(items)

    # 4. TRANSFORM
    model_type = config.get("output", {}).get("model", "DiscountItem")
    if model_type == "HotdealPost":
        records = to_hotdeal_prices(items, source="hotdeal")
    else:
        records = to_discount_history(items, source="mart_discount")

    # 5. STORE
    if SKIP_REVIEW:
        items_saved = await self._store(records, errors)
    else:
        items_saved = await self._store_to_ingestion(
            crawler_name=crawler_name,
            crawl_status="success",
            items=items,
            schema_type=model_type,
            strategy_used=crawl_result.strategy_used,
            duration_seconds=time.monotonic() - start,
            errors=errors,
        )

    duration = time.monotonic() - start
    result = PipelineResult(...)
    return result
```

**Quality Score Calculation (lines 47-109):**
- Formula: `1.0 - (missing_ratio * 0.4) - (outlier_ratio * 0.3) - (dup_ratio * 0.3)`
- Missing ratio: % of items with missing required fields
- Outlier ratio: % of prices > 5x avg or < 0.05x avg
- Duplicate ratio: % of items with same (name, price)
- Clamped to [0.0, 1.0], rounded to 3 decimals

| **Quality scoring** | Good | Transparent calculation; 0-1.0 score helps filter low-quality crawls |
````

133. function getTimeSince(dateStr) {
134.   const diff = Date.now() - new Date(dateStr).getTime();
135.   const hours = Math.floor(diff / 3600000);

137.   if (hours > 24) return { hours, text: `${Math.floor(hours / 24)}일 전` };
138.   if (hours > 0) return { hours, text: `${hours}시간 ${minutes}분 전` };

277. function addToTree(tree, parentId, node) {
278.   if (!parentId) return [...tree, node];
279.   return tree.map((item) => {
280.     if (item.id === parentId) {
281.       return { ...item, children: [...(item.children || []), node] };
282.     }
283.     if (item.children) {
284.       return { ...item, children: addToTree(item.children, parentId, node) };
285.     }
286.     return item;
287.   });
288. }
289. 
290. function updateInTree(tree, id, data) {
291.   return tree.map((item) => {
292.     if (item.id === id) return { ...item, ...data };
293.     if (item.children) return { ...item, children: updateInTree(item.children, id, data) };
294.     return item;
295.   });
296. }
297. 
298. function removeFromTree(tree, id) {
299.   return tree
300.     .filter((item) => item.id !== id)
301.     .map((item) => {
302.       if (item.children) return { ...item, children: removeFromTree(item.children, id) };
303.       return item;
304.     });
305. }

1. """인증 미들웨어 — JWT 토큰 검증 및 사용자 추출"""
2. from fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, status
3. from fastapi.security import HTTPBearer, HTTPAuthorizationCredentials
4. from typing import Optional
5. from services.auth_service import decode_token
6. 
7. security = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False)
8. 
9. 
10. async def get_current_user(
11.     credentials: Optional[HTTPAuthorizationCredentials] = Depends(security),
12. ) -> Optional[dict]:
13.     """현재 인증된 사용자 정보 추출 (선택적 인증)"""
14.     if not credentials:
15.         return None
16. 
17.     payload = decode_token(credentials.credentials)
18.     if not payload:
19.         return None
20. 
21.     if payload.get("type") != "access":
22.         return None
23. 
24.     return {
25.         "id": int(payload["sub"]),
26.         "email": payload["email"],
27.         "role": payload["role"],
28.     }
29. 
30. 
31. async def require_auth(
32.     user: Optional[dict] = Depends(get_current_user),
33. ) -> dict:
34.     """인증 필수 — 미인증 시 401"""
35.     if not user:
36.         raise HTTPException(
37.             status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED,
38.             detail="인증이 필요합니다",
39.             headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"},
40.         )
41.     return user
42. 
43. 
44. async def require_admin(
45.     user: dict = Depends(require_auth),
46. ) -> dict:
47.     """관리자 권한 필수 — 비관리자 시 403"""
48.     if user["role"] not in ("admin", "moderator"):
49.         raise HTTPException(
50.             status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
51.             detail="관리자 권한이 필요합니다",
52.         )
53.     return user
54.

## Fix List

### 1. Keywords.jsx - toLocaleString crash + synonyms.map crash

- Line 17: `k.synonyms.some()` → `(k.synonyms || []).some()`
- Line 20: `k.searchCount` → `k.searchCount ?? 0`
- Line 118: `kw.searchCount.toLocaleString()` → `(kw.searchCount ?? 0).toLocaleString()`


- Line 121: `kw.synonyms.map()` → `(kw.synonyms ?? []).map()`

### 2. Keywords data flow - field name mismatch
- Backend returns: `{id, word, synonyms, category_id, search_count, is_active}`
- Frontend expects: `{id, keyword, searchCount, synonyms, categoryId}`
- Fix in dbAdminStore.js: transform keyword data in fetch, and transform back before sending to API

### 3. Keywords POST 422 - field name mismatch
- Frontend sends: `{keyword, searchCount, synonyms, categoryId}`
- Backend expects: `{word, search_count, synonyms, category_id}` — need to transform the payload before posting

### 4. Prices.jsx - multiple toLocaleString crashes
- Adding null checks to all price and stats fields that call toLocaleString() to prevent crashes when values are undefined
- Also need to fix the stats calculation that's computing currentAvg values

, since undefined values will break arithmetic operations

### 5. Dashboard.jsx - toLocaleString crash

### 6. Analytics.jsx - toLocaleString crashes

### 7. Pipeline.py - config... I need to verify that the `_store_to_ingestion` method actually connects to the db-admin ingestion API, and then check how the crawler admin store handles the runCrawler function.*

````
### 2. **validate_items function**
Location: `E:\pdf\capston01\walletSavior\packages\crawler-admin\backend\pipeline\validator.py` (lines 10-23)

```python
def validate_items(
    items: list[dict[str, Any]],
    required_fields: list[str],
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    """필수 필드 존재 확인. (valid, invalid) 튜플 반환."""
    valid, invalid = [], []
    for item in items:
        missing = [f for f in required_fields if not item.get(f)]
        if missing:
            item["_validation_error"] = f"missing fields: {missing}"
            invalid.append(item)
        else:
            valid.append(item)
    return valid, invalid
```

This function validates that all required fields exist in each item dict and returns a tuple of (valid_items, invalid_items).
````

```
6.     Pydantic을 쓰는 이유는 (1) 타입 검증으로 잘못된 데이터가 파이프라인에 흘러들어가는 것을
7.     막고 (2) JSON 직렬화가 API 응답·이벤트 발행에 바로 쓸 수 있기 때문이다.

11. """

13. from __future__ import annotations

16. from enum import Enum

22. # --- 열거형 (Enum) ---
23. 
24. class CrawlStatus(str, Enum):
25.     """크롤링 작업의 생명주기 상태 — executor가 이벤트 발행·결과 판정에 사용."""
26.     PENDING = "pending"
27.     RUNNING = "running"
28.     SUCCESS = "success"
29.     FAILED = "failed"
30.     PARTIAL = "partial"      # 일부 성공
31.     CANCELLED = "cancelled"

34. class ErrorType(str, Enum):
35.     """
36.     크롤링 실패의 원인 분류 — DiagnosticsEngine이 자동 진단·추천 대응을 결정하는 핵심 키.
37. 
38.     왜 세분화하는가: "실패했다"만으로는 대응이 불가능하다.
39.     IP_BANNED이면 프록시를 교체하고, DOM_CHANGED이면 셀렉터를 업데이트해야 한다.
40.     이 enum 값 하나로 진단 엔진이 원인 파악 → 심각도 산정 → 대응 추천까지 자동화한다.
41.     """
42.     HTTP_ERROR = "http_error"
43.     CAPTCHA_DETECTED = "captcha_detected"
44.     IP_BANNED = "ip_banned"
45.     JS_CHALLENGE = "js_challenge"
46.     DOM_CHANGED = "dom_changed"
47.     TIMEOUT = "timeout"
48.     LOGIN_REQUIRED = "login_required"
49.     EMPTY_RESPONSE = "empty_response"
50.     PARSE_ERROR = "parse_error"
51.     NETWORK_ERROR = "network_error"
52.     UNKNOWN = "unknown"
53. 
54. 
55. class CrawlerGroup(str, Enum):
56.     """크롤러를 데이터 성격별로 묶는 그룹 — 스케줄링 주기·신뢰도 정책이 그룹별로 다르다."""
57.     PUBLIC_API = "public"       # 공공 API
58.     MART = "marts"              # 대형마트
59.     HOTDEAL = "hotdeals"        # 핫딜 게시판
60.     FOOD = "food"               # 배달/식당
61.     SHOPPING = "shopping"       # 패션/쇼핑
62.     LOCAL = "local"             # 위치 기반 (네이버 플레이스, 주유소 등)
63. 
64.

66. 
67. class CrawlerInfo(BaseModel):
68.     """크롤러 플러그인의 자기소개서 — registry가 플러그인을 자동 발견·분류할 때 읽는 메타 정보."""
69.     name: str                                   # "이마트"
70.     version: str = "1.0.0"

75.     schedule: Optional[str] = None              # cron 표현식
76. 
77. 
78. # --- 크롤링 요청/결과 ---
79. 
80. class CrawlRequest(BaseModel):
81.     """API 또는 스케줄러가 엔진에 보내는 크롤링 실행 요청 — executor.execute()의 입력."""
82.     crawler_name: str
83.     url: Optional[str] = None                   # None이면 크롤러 기본 URL 사용
84.     options: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
85.     force_strategy: Optional[str] = None        # 강제로 특정 전략 사용
86. 
87. 
88. class CrawlResult(BaseModel):
89.     """
90.     모든 크롤링 작업의 통일된 출력 — 성공·실패 관계없이 동일 구조.
91. 
92.     왜 통일하는가: 후속 파이프라인(저장소 저장, 진단, 이벤트 발행)이 성공/실패를
93.     분기 없이 처리할 수 있어야 한다. 실패 시에도 errors 필드에 각 전략의 실패 상세가 담겨
94.     DiagnosticsEngine이 자동 분석할 수 있다.
95.     어디서 쓰이나: executor → 이 모델 → storage / diagnostics / event_bus
96.     """
97.     status: CrawlStatus
98.     crawler_name: str
99.     strategy_used: Optional[str] = None         # 성공한 전략
100.     items_count: int = 0
101.     items: list[dict[str, Any]] = Field(default_factory=list)
102.     raw_data: Optional[str] = None
103.     started_at: datetime = Field(default_factory=datetime.now)
104.     finished_at: Optional[datetime] = None
105.     duration_seconds: float = 0.0
106.     errors: list[StrategyFailure] = Field(default_factory=list)
107.     error_msg: Optional[str] = None
108.

112. class StrategyFailure(BaseModel):

114.     strategy_name: str
115.     error_type: ErrorType

124. 
125.     DiagnosticsEngine.analyze() → 이 모델 → 대시보드 표시 / 자동 복구 트리거.
126.     """
127.     crawler_name: str

137. class Event(BaseModel):
138.     """이벤트 버스를 통해 모듈 간 전달되는 메시지 봉투 — 발행자와 구독자가 서로를 몰라도 소통할 수 있게 한다."""
139.     event_type: str

147. class DataSource(str, Enum):
148.     """
149.     데이터 원본의 신뢰도 계층 — "이 가격을 평균 산출에 넣어도 되는가?"를 결정한다.
150. 
151.     GOVERNMENT/MART_REGULAR → baseline(평균 산출 대상),
152.     MART_DISCOUNT → 할인 이력 기록용,
153.     HOTDEAL → 참고만(1원 이벤트 같은 이상치가 평균을 오염시키므로 평균에 불포함).
154.     statistics.compute_stats()와 verification이 이 분류에 의존한다.
155.     """
156.     GOVERNMENT = "government"       # 정부 공식 (KAMIS, KOSIS) — baseline
157.     MART_REGULAR = "mart_regular"   # 마트 정가 — baseline
158.     MART_DISCOUNT = "mart_discount" # 마트 전단 할인가 — discount_history
159.     HOTDEAL = "hotdeal"             # 핫딜 게시판 — 참고만, 평균에 불포함
160.     DELIVERY = "delivery"           # 배달앱 — 외식 참고
161.     GAS_STATION = "gas_station"     # 주유소 — 연료 baseline
162.

164. class ProductPrice(BaseModel):
165.     """
166.     DB에 저장되는 정규화된 가격 레코드 — 모든 가격 비교의 기본 단위.
167. 
168.     왜 필요한가:
169.         크롤러마다 다른 형식(DiscountItem, HotdealPost 등)의 데이터를 생산하지만,
170.         통계·비교·등급 판정은 하나의 통일된 형태가 필요하다.
171.     어디서 쓰이나:
172.         크롤러 → DiscountItem.to_product_price() → 이 모델 → DB(baseline_prices, discount_history)
173.         → statistics.compute_stats() → 평균·중간·최저가 산출
174.     """
175.     product_name: str                           # "양파", "삼겹살" (표준화된 명칭)
176.     category: str = ""                          # "채소류 > 근채류"
177.     store: str = ""                             # "이마트", "코스트코" 또는 "KAMIS"
178.     source: DataSource                          # 데이터 원본 신뢰도 분류
179.     price: int                                  # 가격 (원)
180.     unit: str = ""                              # "1kg", "100g", "1L"
181.     original_price: Optional[int] = None        # 할인 전 정가 (할인 아닐 때 None)
182.     discount_rate: Optional[float] = None       # 할인율 (0.0 ~ 1.0)
183.     recorded_date: datetime = Field(default_factory=datetime.now)
184.     valid_from: Optional[datetime] = None       # 할인 시작일
185.     valid_until: Optional[datetime] = None      # 할인 종료일
186.     source_url: str = ""                        # 수집 원본 URL
187.     crawled_at: datetime = Field(default_factory=datetime.now)
188.     raw_text: str = ""                          # 원본 텍스트 (디버깅/검증용)
189. 
190. 
191. class DiscountItem(BaseModel):
192.     """
193.     마트 크롤러가 생산하는 할인 상품 원시 데이터 — ProductPrice로 정규화되기 전 단계.
194. 
195.     왜 별도 모델인가:
196.         크롤러가 수집한 원본 정보(행사명, 이미지 URL 등)를 보존해야 대시보드 표시와
197.         디버깅이 가능하다. to_product_price()로 정규화하면 이런 부가 정보가 소실된다.
198.     흐름: 마트 크롤러 → DiscountItem → to_product_price() → ProductPrice → DB
199.     """
200.     name: str                                   # 상품명 (원본)
201.     normalized_name: str = ""                   # 표준화된 품목명 (양파, 삼겹살 등)
202.     store: str                                  # 매장명
203.     original_price: Optional[int] = None        # 정가 (원)
204.     sale_price: int                             # 할인가 (원)
205.     discount_percent: Optional[float] = None    # 할인율 (%)
206.     unit: str = ""                              # 단위
207.     category: str = ""                          # 카테고리
208.     event_name: str = ""                        # 행사명 ("1+1", "반값", "주간특가")
209.     valid_from: Optional[datetime] = None       # 행사 시작일
210.     valid_until: Optional[datetime] = None      # 행사 종료일
211.     image_url: str = ""                         # 상품 이미지 URL
212.     detail_url: str = ""                        # 상세 페이지 URL
213.     crawled_at: datetime = Field(default_factory=datetime.now)
214. 
215.     def to_product_price(self) -> ProductPrice:
216.         """DiscountItem → ProductPrice 변환."""
217.         return ProductPrice(
218.             product_name=self.normalized_name or self.name,
219.             store=self.store,
220.             source=DataSource.MART_DISCOUNT,
221.             price=self.sale_price,
222.             unit=self.unit,
223.             category=self.category,
224.             original_price=self.original_price,
225.             discount_rate=self.discount_percent / 100 if self.discount_percent else None,
226.             valid_from=self.valid_from,
227.             valid_until=self.valid_until,
228.             source_url=self.detail_url,
229.             crawled_at=self.crawled_at,
230.             raw_text=self.name,
231.         )

234. class HotdealPost(BaseModel):
235.     """
236.     핫딜 커뮤니티(뽐뿌·어미새 등) 게시글 — 평균 산출에 절대 포함하지 않는다.
237. 
238.     왜 ProductPrice와 분리하는가:
239.         핫딜은 "1원 이벤트", "한정 수량 특가" 등 정상 시장가와 동떨어진 가격이 많다.
240.         이걸 평균에 넣으면 baseline이 왜곡되어 "지금 사도 괜찮아요" 판정이 엉망이 된다.
241.         별도 모델로 격리하고 price_vs_avg 필드로 참고 비교만 제공한다.
242.     """

244.     url: str
245.     source_community: str = ""                  # "뽐뿌", "어미새", "루리웹"
246.     price: Optional[int] = None
247.     original_price: Optional[int] = None
248.     category: str = ""
249.     crawled_at: datetime = Field(default_factory=datetime.now)
250.     matched_product: str = ""                   # DB 매칭된 품목명
251.     price_vs_avg: Optional[float] = None        # 평균 대비 비율 (0.7 = 30% 저렴)
```

```
1. """
2. 알구몬 핫딜 크롤러.
3. 
4. https://www.algumon.com/n/deal 에서 핫딜 게시글을 수집한다.
5. 알구몬은 Svelte SPA이지만 SSR 렌더링하므로 requests로 HTML 파싱 가능.
6. 
7. 데이터 구조 (2026-03 기준):
8.   <div class="deal-card-content">
9.     <div class="flex gap-0">
10.       <div class="avatar">...</div>     ← 아바타 (링크 있음)
11.       <div class="flex-1 min-w-0 ml-3">
12.         <소스> | <커뮤니티>                ← 구매처/커뮤니티
13.         <h3><a href="/l/d/...">제목</a></h3>
14.         <p class="deal-price-text">가격</p>
15.         <배송> | <시간> | <작성자>
16.       </div>
17.     </div>
18.   </div>
19. 
20. 용도: 핫딜 참고 데이터 (baseline 오염 방지 — HotdealPost로 저장)
21. 의존: core/ 만
22. """
23. 
24. from __future__ import annotations
25. 
26. import logging
27. import re
28. from datetime import datetime
29. from typing import Optional
30. 
31. import requests
32. from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
33. 
34. from core.contracts.crawler import CrawlerContract
35. from core.models import CrawlerInfo, CrawlerGroup, CrawlResult, CrawlStatus, HotdealPost
36. from engine.anti_detect import AntiDetect
37. 
38. logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
39. 
40. 
41. class AlgumonCrawler(CrawlerContract):
42.     """알구몬 핫딜 크롤러 — 여러 커뮤니티의 핫딜 통합."""
43. 
44.     BASE_URL = "https://www.algumon.com"
45.     DEAL_URL = "https://www.algumon.com/n/deal"
46.     # 알구몬은 SPA(Svelte)이지만 SSR로 JSON-LD가 포함된다
47.     # JSON-LD schema에서 데이터 추출이 더 안정적
48. 
49.     def __init__(self, anti_detect: Optional[AntiDetect] = None):
50.         self._anti_detect = anti_detect or AntiDetect(delay_min=0.5, delay_max=1.5)
51. 
52.     @property
53.     def info(self) -> CrawlerInfo:
54.         return CrawlerInfo(
55.             name="알구몬",
56.             version="2.0.0",
57.             group=CrawlerGroup.HOTDEAL,
58.             description="여러 커뮤니티의 핫딜 정보 통합 (뽐뿌, 어미새, 루리웹 등)",
59.             target_url=self.DEAL_URL,
60.             strategies=["requests"],
61.         )
62. 
63.     async def crawl(self) -> CrawlResult:
64.         """알구몬 핫딜 목록을 크롤링한다."""
65.         started_at = datetime.now()
66.         logger.info(f"[알구몬] 크롤링 시작: {self.DEAL_URL}")
67. 
68.         try:
69.             headers = self._anti_detect.get_random_headers()
70.             response = requests.get(self.DEAL_URL, headers=headers, timeout=15)
71.             response.encoding = "utf-8"
72. 
73.             if response.status_code != 200:
74.                 logger.error(f"[알구몬] HTTP {response.status_code}")
75.                 return CrawlResult(
76.                     status=CrawlStatus.FAILED,
77.                     crawler_name=self.info.name,
78.                     error_msg=f"HTTP {response.status_code}",
79.                     started_at=started_at,
80.                     finished_at=datetime.now(),
81.                 )
82. 
83.             raw_data = response.text
84.             items = await self.parse(raw_data)
85.             valid_items = await self.validate(items)
86. 
87.             items_as_dict = [item.model_dump(mode="json") for item in valid_items]
88. 
89.             finished_at = datetime.now()
90.             logger.info(f"[알구몬] 크롤링 완료: {len(valid_items)}개, {(finished_at - started_at).total_seconds():.2f}초")
91. 
92.             return CrawlResult(
93.                 status=CrawlStatus.SUCCESS,
94.                 crawler_name=self.info.name,
95.                 strategy_used="requests",
96.                 items_count=len(valid_items),
97.                 items=items_as_dict,
98.                 started_at=started_at,
99.                 finished_at=finished_at,
100.                 duration_seconds=(finished_at - started_at).total_seconds(),
101.             )
102. 
103.         except Exception as e:
104.             logger.error(f"[알구몬] 크롤링 실패: {e}", exc_info=True)
105.             return CrawlResult(
106.                 status=CrawlStatus.FAILED,
107.                 crawler_name=self.info.name,
108.                 error_msg=str(e),
109.                 started_at=started_at,
110.                 finished_at=datetime.now(),
111.             )
112. 
113.     async def parse(self, raw_data: str) -> list[HotdealPost]:
114.         """HTML에서 핫딜 게시글을 파싱한다.
115. 
116.         알구몬은 SPA이지만 SSR 렌더링으로 JSON-LD가 포함된다.
117.         1차: JSON-LD schema에서 추출 (안정적)
118.         2차: HTML DOM에서 추출 (폴백)
119.         """
120.         soup = BeautifulSoup(raw_data, "html.parser")
121.         items: list[HotdealPost] = []
122. 
123.         # 1차: JSON-LD에서 추출 시도
124.         import json
125.         for script in soup.select('script[type="application/ld+json"]'):
126.             try:
127.                 data = json.loads(script.string)
128.                 if data.get("@type") == "CollectionPage" and "mainEntity" in data:
129.                     item_list = data["mainEntity"].get("itemListElement", [])
130.                     for entry in item_list:
131.                         item_data = entry.get("item", {})
132.                         title = item_data.get("name", "")
133.                         url = item_data.get("url", "")
134.                         if title and url:
135.                             price = self._extract_price(title)
136.                             items.append(HotdealPost(
137.                                 title=title,
138.                                 url=url,
139.                                 source_community="알구몬",
140.                                 price=price,
141.                             ))
142.             except (json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError):
143.                 continue
144. 
145.         if items:
146.             logger.info(f"[알구몬] JSON-LD에서 {len(items)}개 추출")
147.             return items
148. 
149.         # 2차: HTML DOM 기반 파싱
150.         cards = soup.select(".deal-card-content")
151.         logger.info(f"[알구몬] deal-card-content 카드: {len(cards)}개")
152. 
153.         for card in cards:
154.             try:
155.                 item = self._parse_card(card)
156.                 if item:
157.                     items.append(item)
158.             except Exception as e:
159.                 logger.debug(f"[알구몬] 카드 파싱 오류: {e}")
160.                 continue
161. 
162.         return items
163. 
164.     def _parse_card(self, card) -> Optional[HotdealPost]:
165.         """개별 핫딜 카드를 파싱한다."""
166. 
167.         # 1) 제목 + URL 추출
168.         title_el = card.select_one("h3 a[href*='/l/d/']")
169.         if not title_el:
170.             # fallback: 카드 내 모든 a 태그에서 href 포함하는 것
171.             title_el = card.select_one("a[href*='/l/d/']")
172. 
173.         if not title_el:
174.             return None
175. 
176.         title = title_el.get_text(strip=True)
177.         if not title or len(title) < 3:
178.             return None
179. 
180.         href = title_el.get("href", "")
181.         url = href if href.startswith("http") else f"{self.BASE_URL}{href}"
182. 
183.         # 2) 가격 추출 — deal-price-text 클래스 또는 가격 패턴
184.         price = None
185.         price_el = card.select_one(".deal-price-text, [class*='price']")
186.         if price_el:
187.             price_text = price_el.get_text(strip=True)
188.             price = self._extract_price(price_text)
189. 
190.         # fallback: 카드 전체 텍스트에서 가격 추출
191.         if price is None:
192.             card_text = card.get_text(" ", strip=True)
193.             price = self._extract_price(card_text)
194. 
195.         # 3) 소스 커뮤니티 추출
196.         source = self._extract_source(card)
197. 
198.         return HotdealPost(
199.             title=title,
200.             url=url,
201.             source_community=source,
202.             price=price,
203.         )
204. 
205.     def _extract_price(self, text: str) -> Optional[int]:
206.         """텍스트에서 최초 가격(원)을 추출한다."""
207.         if not text:
208.             return None
209. 
210.         # "무료" 처리
211.         if text.strip() == "무료":
212.             return 0
213. 
214.         # "15,470원", "50000원" 패턴
215.         patterns = [
216.             r"(\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+)\s*원",  # 1,000원 이상
217.             r"(\d{3,})\s*원",                # 100원 이상
218.         ]
219.         for pattern in patterns:
220.             match = re.search(pattern, text)
221.             if match:
222.                 return int(match.group(1).replace(",", ""))
223.         return None
224. 
225.     def _extract_source(self, card) -> str:
226.         """카드에서 소스 커뮤니티를 추출한다."""
227.         # deal-card-content의 텍스트에서 첫 "|" 전후로 소스 추출
228.         # 패턴: "G마켓 | 뽐뿌 | 제목" → 소스 = "뽐뿌"
229.         known_communities = [
230.             "뽐뿌", "어미새", "루리웹", "에펨코리아", "퀘이사존",
231.             "클리앙", "딜바다", "쿨엔조이", "보배드림",
232.         ]
233.         card_text = card.get_text(" ", strip=True)
234. 
235.         for community in known_communities:
236.             if community in card_text:
237.                 return community
238. 
239.         return ""
240. 
241.     async def validate(self, items: list[HotdealPost]) -> list[HotdealPost]:
242.         """유효한 핫딜만 필터링한다."""
243.         valid = []
244.         seen_urls = set()
245. 
246.         for item in items:
247.             # URL 기반 중복 제거
248.             if item.url in seen_urls:
249.                 continue
250.             seen_urls.add(item.url)
251. 
252.             # 너무 짧은 제목
253.             if len(item.title) < 3:
254.                 continue
255. 
256.             valid.append(item)
257. 
258.         return valid
259.
```

```
53.             name="알구몬",
54.             version="2.0.0",
55.             group=CrawlerGroup.HOTDEAL,
56.             description="여러 커뮤니티의 핫딜 정보 통합 (뽐뿌, 어미새, 루리웹 등)",
57.             target_url=self.DEAL_URL,
58.             strategies=["requests"],
59.         )
60. 
61.     async def crawl(self) -> CrawlResult:
62.         """알구몬 핫딜 목록을 크롤링한다."""
63.         started_at = datetime.now()
64.         logger.info(f"[알구몬] 크롤링 시작: {self.DEAL_URL}")
65. 
66.         try:
67.             headers = self._anti_detect.get_random_headers()
68.             response = requests.get(self.DEAL_URL, headers=headers, timeout=15)
69.             response.encoding = "utf-8"
70. 
71.             if response.status_code != 200:
72.                 logger.error(f"[알구몬] HTTP {response.status_code}")
73.                 return CrawlResult(
74.                     status=CrawlStatus.FAILED,
75.                     crawler_name=self.info.name,
76.                     error_msg=f"HTTP {response.status_code}",
77.                     started_at=started_at,
78.                     finished_at=datetime.now(),
79.                 )
80. 
81.             raw_data = response.text
82.             items = await self.parse(raw_data)
83.             valid_items = await self.validate(items)
84. 
85.             items_as_dict = [item.model_dump(mode="json") for item in valid_items]
86. 
87.             finished_at = datetime.now()
88.             logger.info(f"[알구몬] 크롤링 완료: {len(valid_items)}개, {(finished_at - started_at).total_seconds():.2f}초")
89. 
90.             return CrawlResult(
91.                 status=CrawlStatus.SUCCESS,
92.                 crawler_name=self.info.name,
93.                 strategy_used="requests",
94.                 items_count=len(valid_items),
95.                 items=items_as_dict,
96.                 started_at=started_at,
97.                 finished_at=finished_at,
98.                 duration_seconds=(finished_at - started_at).total_seconds(),
99.             )
100. 
101.         except Exception as e:
102.             logger.error(f"[알구몬] 크롤링 실패: {e}", exc_info=True)
103.             return CrawlResult(
104.                 status=CrawlStatus.FAILED,
105.                 crawler_name=self.info.name,
106.                 error_msg=str(e),
107.                 started_at=started_at,
108.                 finished_at=datetime.now(),
109.             )
110. 
111.     async def parse(self, raw_data: str) -> list[HotdealPost]:
112.         """HTML에서 핫딜 게시글을 파싱한다."""
113.         soup = BeautifulSoup(raw_data, "html.parser")
114.         items: list[HotdealPost] = []
115. 
116.         # deal-card-content 기반 파싱
117.         cards = soup.select(".deal-card-content")
118.         logger.info(f"[알구몬] deal-card-content 카드: {len(cards)}개")
119. 
120.         for card in cards:
121.             try:
122.                 item = self._parse_card(card)
123.                 if item:
124.                     items.append(item)
125.             except Exception as e:
126.                 logger.debug(f"[알구몬] 카드 파싱 오류: {e}")
127.                 continue
128. 
129.         return items
130. 
131.     def _parse_card(self, card) -> Optional[HotdealPost]:
132.         """개별 핫딜 카드를 파싱한다."""
133. 
134.         # 1) 제목 + URL 추출
135.         title_el = card.select_one("h3 a[href*='/l/d/']")
136.         if not title_el:
137.             # fallback: 카드 내 모든 a 태그에서 href 포함하는 것
138.             title_el = card.select_one("a[href*='/l/d/']")
139. 
140.         if not title_el:
141.             return None
142. 
143.         title = title_el.get_text(strip=True)
144.         if not title or len(title) < 3:
145.             return None
146. 
147.         href = title_el.get("href", "")
148.         url = href if href.startswith("http") else f"{self.BASE_URL}{href}"
149. 
150.         # 2) 가격 추출 — deal-price-text 클래스 또는 가격 패턴
151.         price = None
152.         price_el = card.select_one(".deal-price-text, [class*='price']")
153.         if price_el:
154.             price_text = price_el.get_text(strip=True)
155.             price = self._extract_price(price_text)
156. 
157.         # fallback: 카드 전체 텍스트에서 가격 추출
158.         if price is None:
159.             card_text = card.get_text(" ", strip=True)
160.             price = self._extract_price(card_text)
161. 
162.         # 3) 소스 커뮤니티 추출
163.         source = self._extract_source(card)
164. 
165.         return HotdealPost(
166.             title=title,
167.             url=url,
168.             source_community=source,
169.             price=price,
170.         )
171. 
172.     def _extract_price(self, text: str) -> Optional[int]:
173.         """텍스트에서 최초 가격(원)을 추출한다."""
174.         if not text:
175.             return None
176. 
177.         # "무료" 처리
178.         if text.strip() == "무료":
179.             return 0
180. 
181.         # "15,470원", "50000원" 패턴
182.         patterns = [
183.             r"(\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+)\s*원",  # 1,000원 이상
184.             r"(\d{3,})\s*원",                # 100원 이상
185.         ]
186.         for pattern in patterns:
187.             match = re.search(pattern, text)
188.             if match:
189.                 return int(match.group(1).replace(",", ""))
190.         return None
191. 
192.     def _extract_source(self, card) -> str:
193.         """카드에서 소스 커뮤니티를 추출한다."""
194.         # deal-card-content의 텍스트에서 첫 "|" 전후로 소스 추출
195.         # 패턴: "G마켓 | 뽐뿌 | 제목" → 소스 = "뽐뿌"
196.         known_communities = [
197.             "뽐뿌", "어미새", "루리웹", "에펨코리아", "퀘이사존",
198.             "클리앙", "딜바다", "쿨엔조이", "보배드림",
199.         ]
200.         card_text = card.get_text(" ", strip=True)
201. 
202.         for community in known_communities:
203.             if community in card_text:
204.                 return community
205. 
206.         return ""
207. 
208.     async def validate(self, items: list[HotdealPost]) -> list[HotdealPost]:
209.         """유효한 핫딜만 필터링한다."""
210.         valid = []
211.         seen_urls = set()
212. 
213.         for item in items:
214.             # URL 기반 중복 제거
215.             if item.url in seen_urls:
216.                 continue
217.             seen_urls.add(item.url)
218. 
219.             # 너무 짧은 제목
220.             if len(item.title) < 3:
221.                 continue
222. 
223.             valid.append(item)
224. 
225.         return valid
226.
```

```
309. }));

311. /* 트리 유틸리티 */
312. function addToTree(tree, parentId, node) {
313.   if (!parentId) return [...tree, node];
314.   return tree.map((item) => {
315.     if (item.id === parentId) {
316.       return { ...item, children: [...(item.children || []), node] };
317.     }
318.     if (item.children) {
319.       return { ...item, children: addToTree(item.children, parentId, node) };
320.     }
321.     return item;
322.   });
323. }
324. 
325. function updateInTree(tree, id, data) {
326.   return tree.map((item) => {
327.     if (item.id === id) return { ...item, ...data };
328.     if (item.children) return { ...item, children: updateInTree(item.children, id, data) };
329.     return item;
330.   });
331. }
332. 
333. function removeFromTree(tree, id) {
334.   return tree
335.     .filter((item) => item.id !== id)
336.     .map((item) => {
337.       if (item.children) return { ...item, children: removeFromTree(item.children, id) };
338.       return item;
339.     });
340. }

343.
```

```
1. """
2. 이마트 크롤러 — 전단지 및 할인 행사 상품 정보 수집.

6. 
7. 데이터 흐름: SSG 검색 → __NEXT_DATA__ JSON → DiscountItem → ProductPrice → DB

33. class EmartCrawler(CrawlerContract):
34.     """이마트 크롤러 — SSG __NEXT_DATA__ 기반 할인 상품 수집."""
35. 
36.     BASE_URL = "https://emart.ssg.com"
37.     # SSG 검색 페이지 — __NEXT_DATA__에 상품 JSON이 포함됨
38.     SEARCH_URL = "https://emart.ssg.com/search.ssg"
39.     # 할인 상품이 많은 기본 검색어 목록
40.     SEARCH_QUERIES = ["행사", "할인", "특가"]
41. 
42.     def __init__(self, anti_detect: Optional[AntiDetect] = None):
43.         self._anti_detect = anti_detect or AntiDetect(delay_min=1.0, delay_max=3.0)
44. 
45.     @property
46.     def info(self) -> CrawlerInfo:
47.         return CrawlerInfo(
48.             name="이마트",
49.             version="2.0.0",
50.             group=CrawlerGroup.MART,
51.             description="이마트 할인 상품 정보 수집 (SSG __NEXT_DATA__ 기반)",
52.             target_url=self.BASE_URL,
53.             strategies=["requests"],
54.         )
55. 
56.     async def crawl(self) -> CrawlResult:
57.         """이마트 할인 상품을 크롤링한다."""
58.         started_at = datetime.now()
59.         logger.info("[이마트] 크롤링 시작")
60. 
61.         all_items: list[DiscountItem] = []
62.         errors: list[str] = []
63. 
64.         try:
65.             for query in self.SEARCH_QUERIES:
66.                 try:
67.                     url = f"{self.SEARCH_URL}?target=all&query={quote(query)}"
68.                     headers = self._anti_detect.get_random_headers()
69.                     headers.update({
70.                         "Referer": "https://emart.ssg.com/",
71.                     })
72. 
73.                     response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=20)
74.                     response.encoding = "utf-8"
75. 
76.                     if response.status_code != 200:
77.                         logger.warning(f"[이마트] 검색 '{query}' HTTP {response.status_code}")
78.                         errors.append(f"검색 '{query}' HTTP {response.status_code}")
79.                         continue
80. 
81.                     items = await self.parse(response.text)
82.                     logger.info(f"[이마트] 검색 '{query}': {len(items)}개 수집")
83.                     all_items.extend(items)
84. 
85.                 except Exception as e:
86.                     logger.warning(f"[이마트] 검색 '{query}' 실패: {e}")
87.                     errors.append(f"검색 '{query}': {e}")
88.                     continue
89. 
90.                 # 첫 검색어에서 충분히 수집되면 중단 (사이트 부하 방지)
91.                 if len(all_items) >= 30:
92.                     break
93. 
94.             valid_items = await self.validate(all_items)
95.             items_as_dict = [item.model_dump(mode="json") for item in valid_items]
96. 
97.             finished_at = datetime.now()
98.             duration = (finished_at - started_at).total_seconds()
99.             status = CrawlStatus.SUCCESS if valid_items else CrawlStatus.FAILED
100.             logger.info(f"[이마트] 크롤링 완료: {len(valid_items)}개, {duration:.2f}초")
101. 
102.             return CrawlResult(
103.                 status=status,
104.                 crawler_name=self.info.name,
105.                 strategy_used="requests",
106.                 items_count=len(valid_items),
107.                 items=items_as_dict,
108.                 started_at=started_at,
109.                 finished_at=finished_at,
110.                 duration_seconds=duration,
111.                 error_msg="; ".join(errors) if errors and not valid_items else None,
112.             )
113. 
114.         except Exception as e:
115.             logger.error(f"[이마트] 크롤링 실패: {e}", exc_info=True)
116.             return CrawlResult(
117.                 status=CrawlStatus.FAILED,
118.                 crawler_name=self.info.name,
119.                 error_msg=str(e),
120.                 started_at=started_at,
121.                 finished_at=datetime.now(),
122.             )
```
