```
124.     async def parse(self, raw_data: str) -> list[DiscountItem]:
125.         """SSG __NEXT_DATA__ JSON에서 상품을 추출한다."""
126.         items: list[DiscountItem] = []
127. 
128.         # 1) __NEXT_DATA__ JSON 추출
129.         next_data_items = self._extract_next_data_items(raw_data)
130.         if next_data_items:
131.             for product in next_data_items:
132.                 item = self._next_data_to_discount_item(product)
133.                 if item:
134.                     items.append(item)
135.             if items:
136.                 return items
137. 
138.         # 2) Fallback: 기존 임베디드 JSON 패턴
139.         json_items = self._extract_json_items(raw_data)
140.         if json_items:
141.             for product in json_items:
142.                 item = self._json_to_discount_item(product)
143.                 if item:
144.                     items.append(item)
145.             if items:
146.                 return items
147. 
148.         # 3) Fallback: HTML 파싱
149.         try:
150.             from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
151.             soup = BeautifulSoup(raw_data, "html.parser")
152.             items = self._parse_html(soup)
153.         except Exception as e:
154.             logger.warning(f"[이마트] HTML 파싱 실패: {e}")
155. 
156.         return items
157. 
158.     def _extract_next_data_items(self, raw_data: str) -> list[dict]:
159.         """__NEXT_DATA__ 스크립트에서 상품 목록을 추출한다.
160. 
161.         SSG는 Next.js 기반이며, 상품 데이터가
162.         props.pageProps.dehydratedState.queries[N].state.data.areaList[M].dataList
163.         경로에 위치한다. state.data가 리스트인 경우도 있다.
164.         """
165.         match = re.search(
166.             r'<script id="__NEXT_DATA__"[^>]*>(.*?)</script>',
167.             raw_data, re.DOTALL,
168.         )
169.         if not match:
170.             return []
171. 
172.         try:
173.             data = json.loads(match.group(1))
174.         except json.JSONDecodeError:
175.             return []
176. 
177.         # queries 배열에서 상품 목록 탐색
178.         queries = (
179.             data.get("props", {})
180.             .get("pageProps", {})
181.             .get("dehydratedState", {})
182.             .get("queries", [])
183.         )
184. 
185.         for query in queries:
186.             state_data = query.get("state", {}).get("data", {})
187. 
188.             # state.data가 dict인 경우
189.             area_lists = []
190.             if isinstance(state_data, dict):
191.                 area_lists = state_data.get("areaList", [])
192.             elif isinstance(state_data, list):
193.                 # state.data가 list인 경우 — 각 항목에서 areaList 탐색
194.                 for sd_item in state_data:
195.                     if isinstance(sd_item, dict) and "areaList" in sd_item:
196.                         area_lists.extend(sd_item.get("areaList", []))
197.                     elif isinstance(sd_item, dict) and "unitList" in sd_item:
198.                         # unitList 내부에도 상품이 있을 수 있음
199.                         for unit in sd_item.get("unitList", []):
200.                             if isinstance(unit, dict) and "dataList" in unit:
201.                                 area_lists.append(unit)
202. 
203.             for area in area_lists:
204.                 if not isinstance(area, dict):
205.                     continue
206.                 data_list = area.get("dataList", [])
207.                 if not data_list or not isinstance(data_list, list):
208.                     continue
209.                 if not isinstance(data_list[0], dict):
210.                     continue
211. 
212.                 # 상품 데이터인지 확인: itemId + itemName 필드 존재 여부
213.                 if "itemId" in data_list[0] and "itemName" in data_list[0]:
214.                     logger.info(f"[이마트] __NEXT_DATA__ 상품 {len(data_list)}개 발견")
215.                     return data_list
216. 
217.         return []
218. 
219.     def _next_data_to_discount_item(self, product: dict) -> Optional[DiscountItem]:
220.         """SSG __NEXT_DATA__ 상품 → DiscountItem 변환.
221. 
222.         주요 필드:
223.           itemName, finalPrice, strikeOutPrice, priceInfo.primaryPrice,
224.           priceInfo.strikeOutPrice, priceInfo.discountRate,
225.           brandName, itemImgUrl, itemUrl, siteName
226.         """
227.         name = product.get("itemName", "")
228.         if not name or len(name) < 2:
229.             return None
230. 
231.         # 가격 추출 — finalPrice (쉼표 포함 문자열) 또는 priceInfo
232.         sale_price = self._parse_price_str(product.get("finalPrice"))
233. 
234.         # priceInfo에서도 시도
235.         if not sale_price:
236.             price_info = product.get("priceInfo", {})
237.             if price_info:
238.                 sale_price = self._parse_price_str(price_info.get("primaryPrice"))
239. 
240.         if not sale_price or sale_price <= 0:
241.             return None
242. 
243.         # 원가
244.         original_price = self._parse_price_str(product.get("strikeOutPrice"))
245.         if not original_price:
246.             price_info = product.get("priceInfo", {})
247.             if price_info:
248.                 original_price = self._parse_price_str(price_info.get("strikeOutPrice"))
249. 
250.         # 할인율
251.         discount_pct = None
252.         if original_price and original_price > sale_price:
253.             discount_pct = round((1 - sale_price / original_price) * 100, 1)
254.         else:
255.             # priceInfo.discountRate 에서 추출 (예: "2%")
256.             rate_str = product.get("priceInfo", {}).get("discountRate", "")
257.             if rate_str:
258.                 rate_match = re.search(r"(\d+)", str(rate_str))
259.                 if rate_match:
260.                     discount_pct = float(rate_match.group(1))
261. 
262.         image_url = product.get("itemImgUrl", "")
263.         detail_url = product.get("itemUrl", "")
264.         brand = product.get("brandName", "")
265.         site = product.get("siteName", "이마트")
266.         unit = product.get("sellUnitCapacity", "")
267. 
268.         return DiscountItem(
269.             name=name,
270.             store=site or "이마트",
271.             original_price=original_price,
272.             sale_price=sale_price,
273.             discount_percent=discount_pct,
274.             unit=unit,
275.             category=brand,
276.             event_name="이마트 할인",
277.             image_url=image_url,
278.             detail_url=detail_url,
279.         )
280. 
281.     def _extract_json_items(self, raw_data: str) -> list[dict]:
282.         """페이지 내 임베디드 JSON 데이터 추출 (레거시 fallback)."""
283.         patterns = [
284.             r'var\s+(?:itemList|prodList|items)\s*=\s*(\[.*?\]);',
285.             r'"itemList"\s*:\s*(\[.*?\])',
286.             r'"products"\s*:\s*(\[.*?\])',
287.         ]
288.         for pattern in patterns:
289.             match = re.search(pattern, raw_data, re.DOTALL)
290.             if match:
291.                 try:
292.                     return json.loads(match.group(1))
293.                 except json.JSONDecodeError:
294.                     continue
295.         return []
296. 
297.     def _json_to_discount_item(self, product: dict) -> Optional[DiscountItem]:
298.         """레거시 JSON 상품 데이터 → DiscountItem 변환."""
299.         name = (
300.             product.get("itemNm")
301.             or product.get("prodNm")
302.             or product.get("item_nm")
303.             or product.get("name", "")
304.         )
305.         if not name or len(name) < 2:
306.             return None
307. 
308.         sale_price = self._to_int(
309.             product.get("sellprc") or product.get("salePrice")
310.             or product.get("sale_price") or product.get("price")
311.         )
312.         original_price = self._to_int(
313.             product.get("norprc") or product.get("originPrice")
314.             or product.get("original_price")
315.         )
316. 
317.         if not sale_price or sale_price <= 0:
318.             return None
319. 
320.         discount_pct = None
321.         if original_price and original_price > sale_price:
322.             discount_pct = round((1 - sale_price / original_price) * 100, 1)
323. 
324.         image_url = product.get("imgUrl") or product.get("img_url", "")
325.         category = product.get("ctgNm") or product.get("category", "")
326.         detail_url = product.get("itemUrl") or product.get("detail_url", "")
327.         if detail_url and not detail_url.startswith("http"):
328.             detail_url = f"{self.BASE_URL}{detail_url}"
329. 
330.         return DiscountItem(
331.             name=name,
332.             store="이마트",
333.             original_price=original_price,
334.             sale_price=sale_price,
335.             discount_percent=discount_pct,
336.             category=category,
337.             event_name=product.get("eventNm", "이마트 할인"),
338.             image_url=image_url,
339.             detail_url=detail_url,
340.         )
341. 
342.     def _parse_html(self, soup) -> list[DiscountItem]:
343.         """HTML에서 상품 정보를 파싱한다 (fallback)."""
344.         items: list[DiscountItem] = []
345.         product_cards = soup.select(

360.     def _parse_product_card(self, card) -> Optional[DiscountItem]:
361.         """개별 상품 카드 HTML → DiscountItem."""
362.         name_el = card.select_one(
363.             ".cunit_info .cunit_md, .title, .item_name, .prod_name, a[href*='item']"
364.         )
365.         if not name_el:
366.             return None
367.         name = name_el.get_text(strip=True)
368.         if not name or len(name) < 2:
369.             return None
370. 
371.         sale_price = self._extract_price_from_element(
372.             card, ".new_price .ssg_price, .sale_price, .price .num, .opt_price"
373.         )
374.         original_price = self._extract_price_from_element(
375.             card, ".old_price .ssg_price, .origin_price, .normal_price"
376.         )
377. 
378.         if not sale_price or sale_price <= 0:
379.             return None
380.

384.

386.         image_url = ""

389. 
390.         link_el = card.select_one("a[href]")

394.             detail_url = href if href.startswith("http") else f"{self.BASE_URL}{href}"
395. 
396.         return DiscountItem(
397.             name=name,

399.             original_price=original_price,
400.             sale_price=sale_price,

403.             detail_url=detail_url,
404.             event_name="이마트 할인",

407.     def _extract_price_from_element(self, card, selectors: str) -> Optional[int]:
408.         """CSS 셀렉터로 가격 요소를 찾아 정수 변환."""
409.         for selector in selectors.split(","):
410.             el = card.select_one(selector.strip())
411.             if el:
412.                 price = self._extract_price(el.get_text(strip=True))
413.                 if price is not None:
414.                     return price
415.         return None
416. 
417.     def _parse_price_str(self, value) -> Optional[int]:
418.         """'29,780원' 또는 '29780' 형태의 가격 문자열을 정수로 변환."""
419.         if value is None:
420.             return None
421.         text = str(value).replace(",", "").replace("원", "").strip()
422.         match = re.search(r"(\d+)", text)
423.         if match:
424.             return int(match.group(1))
425.         return None
426. 
427.     def _extract_price(self, text: str) -> Optional[int]:
428.         """텍스트에서 가격(원)을 추출한다."""
429.         if not text:
430.             return None
431.         patterns = [
432.             r"(\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+)",
433.             r"(\d{3,})",
434.         ]
435.         for pattern in patterns:
436.             match = re.search(pattern, text)
437.             if match:
438.                 return int(match.group(1).replace(",", ""))
439.         return None
440. 
441.     def _to_int(self, value) -> Optional[int]:
442.         """안전한 정수 변환."""
443.         if value is None:
444.             return None
445.         try:
446.             return int(value)
447.         except (ValueError, TypeError):
448.             return None
449. 
450.     async def validate(self, items: list[DiscountItem]) -> list[DiscountItem]:
451.         """유효한 할인 상품만 필터링."""

453.         seen = set()
454. 
455.         for item in items:
456.             key = f"{item.name}_{item.sale_price}"
457.             if key in seen:
458.                 continue
459.             seen.add(key)
460. 
461.             if item.sale_price <= 0:
462.                 continue
463.             if len(item.name) < 2:
464.                 continue
465. 
466.             valid.append(item)
467. 
468.         return valid
469.
```

So when `model_dump(mode="json")` is called, it produces dictionaries with `sale_price` as a key, and the new required_fields in plugin.yaml specifies `[name, sale_price]` — both fields need to exist and be non-empty. But there's something off here.

*So when we call `run_crawler("emart")`, it calls `pipeline.run_crawler("emart")`. In the pipeline, line 106: `config = self.registry._registry.get(crawler_name, {}).get("config", {})` — the `crawler_name` parameter is "emart" (from `crawler_id`). 

But wait — at line 89 in the pipeline code, the pipeline does `run_crawler(self, crawler_name)`. Then at line 102: `crawler = self.registry.get_crawler(crawler_name)`. Let me check: does `get_crawler("emart")` work? The registry key is "emart" (from plugin.yaml `name: emart`), so yes.


Now I'm verifying that the crawler_id from the API route matches the registry key — both are "emart" — so the config lookup should work correctly. I've already confirmed that the registry contains the required_fields at the right path, and the pipeline's config retrieval should access it the same way.

But validation is still failing on all 44 items, which suggests the server might be running with stale cached data even though I restarted it and cleared __pycache__. Let me reconsider: the registry is a module-level global that initializes once, and since the server started fresh and called discover(), it should have loaded the correct yaml. The real question is whether the pipeline is actually receiving the same crawler_name that matches the registry key.

Now I'm checking what crawler_id gets passed to `run_crawler()` — it comes from the URL path, so when the user runs "emart", the crawler_id should be "emart". Looking at the pipeline code, both the crawler lookup at line 102 and the config lookup at line 106 use this same `crawler_name`, so they should both resolve correctly and pull the required_fields from the config.

The validator then checks each item against those required fields — for "name" and "sale_price", the DiscountItem should have both since the crawler filters out items missing them. But all 44 items are failing validation, which doesn't make sense. I'm realizing I never actually confirmed the live server reloaded my updated pipeline.py with the debug logging — if that logging didn't appear in the output, the server might not have picked up the changes yet.

### 💭 Reasoning

*OK, I understand the startup script. It uses `Start-Process` with `-NoNewWindow` and `--reload` for all backend processes. The PYTHONPATH is set correctly.

Now, here's the issue with `--reload`: When WatchFiles detects changes, it kills the old worker and starts a new one. But the `_pipeline` and `_registry` globals in `crawlers.py` are lazily initialized. When the worker restarts, these globals are re-initialized fresh. So any code changes SHOULD take effect.

But the issue is that the WatchFiles reloader might be crashing silently (the NotImplementedError from Playwright suggests event loop issues). 

I'm wondering if the reloader isn't detecting changes at all, or if it's restarting from cached bytecode instead of picking up the actual file modifications. The working directory is set to `packages\crawler-admin\backend`, so WatchFiles should be monitoring all files there, but maybe the Python process is crashing during reload and the parent reloader is respawning it with stale imports.

Let me just disable `--reload` entirely and test the code directly to see if it actually works.*

````
## **WALLET SAVIOR AUDIT REPORT — ALL BROKEN FEATURES**

Based on comprehensive code analysis, I've identified **6 critical bugs** affecting all reported issues:

---

### **ISSUE #1: Community Posting Returns 401 ❌**

**Location:** `packages/website/backend/api/routes/community.py` — **Line 286**

**Current Code:**
```python
@router.post("")
async def create_post(body: PostCreate, user: dict = Depends(get_current_user)):
    """게시글 작성 — 로그인 시 사용자 정보 사용, 비로그인 시 게스트로 작성."""
    if not user:
        user = {"id": 0, "email": "guest@wallet.local", "nickname": "게스트", "role": "guest"}
    # ... rest of code tries to access body.post_type.value on line 294
```

**Problem:** 
- Line 286 uses `Depends(get_current_user)` which returns `None` on missing auth (not an error)
- BUT the middleware auth.py line 7 sets `auto_error=False`, meaning unauthenticated requests should work
- **HOWEVER**, the frontend is sending the request **WITHOUT Authorization header when NOT logged in** (line 145-146 in CommunityPage.jsx only adds header if token exists)
- The issue is that `body.post_type` is a **Pydantic Enum**, but line 294 does `body.post_type.value` — this should work fine
- **REAL ISSUE**: The endpoint is using `require_auth` in the DOCSTRING (line 6) but actually uses `get_current_user` (which is optional). The 401 likely comes from the **frontend sending malformed data** or **the router prefix not being registered**

**Check router prefix:**
- File registers `router = APIRouter()` with no prefix on line 26
- But the endpoint is POST `/api/posts`
- **ACTUAL BUG**: The router is missing the `/api/posts` prefix and is never mounted in the main app!

**Fix Required:**
```python
# Line 26 — CHANGE:
router = APIRouter()
# TO:
router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/posts", tags=["posts"])
```

**Also fix Enum handling (line 294):**
```python
# CHANGE:
pt = DBPostType(body.post_type.value)
# TO:
pt = DBPostType(body.post_type)  # body.post_type is already the value from Enum
```

---

### **ISSUE #2: Crawler Data Review Page Shows Nothing ❌**

**Location:** `packages/crawler-admin/frontend/src/pages/DataReview/DataReviewPage.jsx` — **Line 35-37**

**Current Code:**
```javascript
useEffect(() => {
  fetchIngestions();
}, [fetchIngestions]);
```

**Problem:** The page calls `fetchIngestions()` but the ingestion list is empty because:
1. Line 22: `const ingestions = useAdminStore((s) => s.ingestions);` — starts as empty array (adminStore.js line 183)
2. The store's `fetchIngestions` tries to call `/api/ingestions` but:
   - **adminStore.js line 190**: calls `api.getIngestions(params)` 
   - But **crawler-admin/backend only has proxy routes**, not the actual data endpoint!
   - The proxy at line 41 in ingestion.py tries to call `DB_ADMIN_URL` (`http://localhost:8002/api/ingestions`)
   - **BUT** the data endpoint is never called on first load

**Root Cause:** The fetch returns empty because:
- adminStore.js line 191: `const list = Array.isArray(data) ? data : data.items ?? data.ingestions ?? data.data ?? [];`
- The API response doesn't match any of these keys

**Check the actual API response format in ingestion.py line 202:**
```python
return {
    "total": total,
    "items": [...]  # ← The key is "items", not "ingestions"
}
```

**Fix Required (adminStore.js line 191):**
```javascript
// CHANGE:
const list = Array.isArray(data) ? data : data.items ?? data.ingestions ?? data.data ?? [];
// TO:
const list = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data?.items ?? data?.data ?? []);
```

---

### **ISSUE #3: Crawler Status NOT Visible After Running ❌**

**Location:** `packages/crawler-admin/frontend/src/pages/Crawlers/Crawlers.jsx` — **Line 43-75**

**Current Code:**
```javascript
const poll = setInterval(async () => {
  pollCount++;
  try {
    const statusResp = await fetch(`/api/crawlers/${id}/status`);
    if (statusResp.ok) {
      const statusData = await statusResp.json();
      if (statusData.status === 'success') {
        // ... update
      }
    }
  } catch { /* 폴링 실패 무시 */ }
}, 2000);
```

**Problem:** The polling works, BUT:
1. Line 46: `const statusResp = await fetch(`/api/crawlers/${id}/status`);` calls the status endpoint
2. The endpoint is registered in crawlers.py line 48, but **returns wrong data structure**
3. Line 86 in crawlers.py returns `{"crawler_id": crawler_id, "status": "idle", ...}` with `items_found`, `items_saved` keys
4. **But the frontend checks `statusData.status === 'success'` (line 49)** — the actual status is "idle" or "running"
5. Line 53 tries to access `statusData.items_found` which might not exist in mock responses

**Also:** The polling might timeout because the crawler execution is async but frontend polling might not persist long enough.

**Fix Required (crawlers.py line 49-65):**
```python
# Ensure consistent response format:
@router.get("/{crawler_id}/status")
async def get_crawler_status(crawler_id: str):
    """크롤러 상태 조회."""
    reg = _get_registry()
    try:
        reg.get_crawler(crawler_id)

### **ISSUE #5: Giordano Crawler Crash — 'str' has no attribute 'get' ❌**

**Location:** `packages/crawler-admin/backend/crawlers/shopping/giordano/crawler.py` — **Line 375-377**

**Current Code:**
```python
image_url = (
    img_el.get("src")
    or img_el.get("data-src")
    or img_el.get("data-original", "")
)
```

**Problem:** `img_el` is a BeautifulSoup tag object. When `.get()` returns `None`, the **next `.get()` is called on `None`**, not on `img_el`.

**Actual Crash Location:** The chain evaluation fails because:
- `img_el.get("src")` returns `None`
- `None or img_el.get(...)` evaluates the second part: `None.get("data-src")` → **AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'get'**

Wait, that's not right. Let me trace again... Actually the code uses `or`, so it should short-circuit. **UNLESS** there's a case where one of the `.get()` calls returns a different falsy value.

**The REAL bug is likely on line 388 (similar pattern):**
```python
href = link_el.get("href", "")
if href and href != "#":
    detail_url = (
        href if href.startswith("http")
        else urljoin(self.BASE_URL, href)
    )
```

If `href` is not a string but some other type, calling `.startswith()` will fail.

**But the error message says `'str' has no attribute 'get'`** — this means somewhere a string is being treated as an object with `.get()` method.

**FOUND IT! Line 354 in _parse_price_text:**
```python
original_price, discount_pct, sale_price = self._parse_price_text(price_text)
```

Then line 424 in fallback:
```python
price_text = price_el.get_text("\n", strip=True)
original_price, discount_pct, sale_price = self._parse_price_text(price_text)
```

The function `_parse_price_text` receives a **string** (`price_text`), but somewhere in the parsing, it might be trying to call `.get()` on it.

**ACTUAL BUG IS HERE (Line 353-356):**
```python
if not sale_price:
    price_text = price_div.get_text("\n", strip=True)  # This is a STRING
    original_price, discount_pct, sale_price = self._parse_price_text(
        price_text  # Passing string to function expecting price_div element
    )
```

The function is designed to parse a string, but the error suggests somewhere the code tries `.get()` on the `price_text` string.

**Fix Required (Line 406-445):**
```python
def _parse_info_price_fallback(self, soup) -> list[DiscountItem]:
    """범용 .info + .price fallback: 컨테이너 기반 or 인덱스 매칭."""
    items: list[DiscountItem] = []

    # 방법 1: 컨테이너 안에서 p.name + .price 찾기
    containers = soup.select("li, div.box, div.item")
    for container in containers:
        name_el = container.select_one("p.name, .name, [class*='name']")
        price_el = container.select_one(".price")
        if not name_el or not price_el:
            continue

        name = name_el.get_text(strip=True)
        if not name or len(name) < 2:
            continue

        # FIX: Check that price_el is a tag object before calling get_text
        if not hasattr(price_el, 'get_text'):
            continue
            
        price_text = price_el.get_text("\n", strip=True)
        original_price, discount_pct, sale_price = self._parse_price_text(
            price_text
        )
        if not sale_price or sale_price <= 0:
            continue

        image_url = ""
        img_el = container.select_one("img")
        if img_el and hasattr(img_el, 'get'):  # FIX: Check img_el is a tag
            src = img_el.get("src")
            data_src = img_el.get("data-src", "")
            data_original = img_el.get("data-original", "")
            image_url = src or data_src or data_original or ""
            if image_url and not image_url.startswith("http"):
                image_url = urljoin(self.BASE_URL, image_url)
```

### **ISSUE #6: Map/Location Features Don't Work ❌**

**Location 1:** `packages/website/frontend/src/pages/Local/LocalPage.jsx` — **Line 45**

**Current Code:**
```javascript
const res = await fetch(
  `/api/local/naver-search?query=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&lat=${mapLat}&lng=${mapLng}&max_items=20`
);
```

**Problem:** The frontend expects the endpoint `/api/local/naver-search` but:
1. Backend registers route with prefix `/api/local` in naver_local.py line 17 (implicitly, router path is appended)
2. But the actual endpoint in line 20 is just `@router.get("/naver-search")` 
3. **So the full path should be `/api/local/naver-search`** — this looks correct!

**HOWEVER, there's an issue on line 50 in LocalPage.jsx:**
```javascript
if (data.success && data.data?.items) {
    setNaverResults(data.data.items);
```

**But in naver_local.py line 49-58, the response is:**
```python
return ApiResponse(
    success=result.status.value in ("success", "partial"),
    data={
        "items": result.items,
        "count": result.items_count,
        "query": query,
        "lat": lat,
        "lng": lng,
    },
    message=...
)
```

**This looks correct** — `data.data.items` should exist.

**ACTUAL ISSUE: Playwright error on Windows**

The crawler is trying to import NaverPlaceCrawler on line 43-44, which likely uses Playwright. **On Windows, Playwright requires special handling.**

**Check naver_local.py line 43:**
```python
from crawlers.location.naver_place.crawler import NaverPlaceCrawler
```

This import will fail if:
1. Playwright is not installed
2. Playwright browsers are not installed (`playwright install chromium`)
3. On Windows, there can be path issues with browser executable

**Additional potential issue:** Line 46 calls:
```python
result = await crawler.crawl(
    query=query, lat=lat, lng=lng, max_items=max_items
)
```

But `NaverPlaceCrawler` might not accept these parameters, or the implementation might be incomplete.

**Fix Required:**

1. **Install Playwright on Windows:**
```bash
pip install playwright
playwright install chromium
```

2. **Add error handling (naver_local.py line 45-47):**
```python
try:
    crawler = NaverPlaceCrawler()
    result = await crawler.crawl(
        query=query, lat=lat, lng=lng, max_items=max_items
    )
except TypeError as e:
    logger.error(f"[네이버 검색] Crawler 호출 실패: {e}")
    return ApiResponse(
        success=False,
        data={"items": [], "count": 0},
        message="검색 함수 호출 실패",
    )
```

3. **Check NaverPlaceCrawler exists at:**
```
packages/crawler-admin/backend/crawlers/location/naver_place/crawler.py
```
If it doesn't exist, this is the root cause.
````

```
28.     }
```

### 💭 Reasoning

*The naver_place crawler relies entirely on Playwright which fails on Windows due to asyncio subprocess issues. The error was `NotImplementedError` from `asyncio.create_subprocess_exec`.

On Windows, `asyncio.create_subprocess_exec` requires `ProactorEventLoop`, but uvicorn uses `SelectorEventLoop`. This is a fundamental issue.

The fix should be to add an httpx-based fallback in the naver search endpoint. Instead of using Playwright, we can use httpx to hit the Naver map's API directly (if there's an API endpoint) or use a lighter approach.

Actually, looking at the search URL pattern: `https://map.naver.com/p/search/{query}?c={lng},{lat},15,0,0,0,dh` — this is a web URL, not an API. But Naver has an API for searching places that we could use with httpx instead.


I'll implement a fallback strategy where the endpoint tries Playwright first, and if it fails on Windows, switches to hitting Naver's internal search API directly with httpx instead.*

```
47. def _calculate_quality(items: list[dict], schema_type: str) -> tuple[float, dict]:
48.     """크롤 데이터의 품질 점수(0.0~1.0)와 상세 내역 반환."""
49.     if not items:
50.         return 0.0, {"error": "항목 없음"}
51. 
52.     # 필수 필드 검사
53.     if schema_type == "HotdealPost":
54.         required = ["title", "url"]
55.     else:
56.         required = ["name", "sale_price"]
57. 
58.     missing_count = 0
59.     for item in items:
60.         for field in required:
61.             if not item.get(field):
62.                 missing_count += 1
63.                 break
64. 
65.     missing_ratio = missing_count / len(items)
66. 
67.     # 가격 이상치 검사
68.     price_field = "price" if schema_type == "HotdealPost" else "sale_price"
69.     prices = [
70.         item[price_field]
71.         for item in items
72.         if isinstance(item.get(price_field), (int, float)) and item[price_field] > 0
73.     ]
74. 
75.     outlier_count = 0
76.     if len(prices) >= 3:
77.         avg = sum(prices) / len(prices)
78.         for p in prices:
79.             if p > avg * 5 or p < avg * 0.05:
80.                 outlier_count += 1
81. 
82.     outlier_ratio = outlier_count / len(items)
83. 
84.     # 중복 검사
85.     name_field = "title" if schema_type == "HotdealPost" else "name"
86.     seen: set[tuple] = set()
87.     dup_count = 0
88.     for item in items:
89.         key = (item.get(name_field, ""), item.get(price_field))
90.         if key in seen:
91.             dup_count += 1
92.         seen.add(key)
93. 
94.     dup_ratio = dup_count / len(items)
95. 
96.     # 점수 계산
97.     score = 1.0 - (missing_ratio * 0.4) - (outlier_ratio * 0.3) - (dup_ratio * 0.3)
98.     score = max(0.0, min(1.0, round(score, 3)))
99. 
100.     details = {
101.         "total_items": len(items),
102.         "missing_fields": missing_count,
103.         "outliers": outlier_count,
104.         "duplicates": dup_count,
105.         "missing_ratio": round(missing_ratio, 3),
106.         "outlier_ratio": round(outlier_ratio, 3),
107.         "duplicate_ratio": round(dup_ratio, 3),
108.     }
109.     return score, details
110. 
111.
```

<sub>⏱️ 513m 55s</sub>

### 💭 Reasoning

*OK, I now see the full ingestion flow:

1. Crawler runs → pipeline submits to `http://localhost:8002/api/ingestions` (POST)
2. DB-admin stores it in `PendingIngestion` table
3. Crawler-admin frontend fetches from `http://localhost:8001/api/ingestions` which proxies to `http://localhost:8002/api/ingestions`
4. DB-admin returns `{"total": N, "items": [...]}`
5. adminStore.js extracts: `data.items ?? data.ingestions ?? data.data ?? []`

This looks correct. 

The data review is empty because either the crawlers had zero valid items to submit, or the submission itself is failing—likely because db-admin isn't running or the ingestion URL is misconfigured. Let me trace through the pipeline's submission logic to see where it's actually sending the data.*

<sub>⏱️ 514m 25s</sub>

### 💭 Reasoning

*The ingestion URL is correct: `http://localhost:8002/api/ingestions`. When the emart crawler runs and produces 44 valid items, it should submit them to the db-admin ingestion queue. The error we saw was "ingestion_submit: All connection attempts failed" because the db-admin backend wasn't running at the time.

So the data review page shows nothing because:
1. Previously, zombie server had 0 valid items → nothing to submit
2. When I started a fresh server (without --reload), only port 8001 was up, not 8002 → ingestion submission fails

When ALL services are running via start-all.bat, the flow should work: crawler runs → 44 valid items → submits to 8002 → db-admin stores in PendingIngestion table → crawler-admin frontend fetches via proxy → data review page shows items.


Now I need to run everything together with start-all.bat and verify the full pipeline works end-to-end, then check how the LocalPage frontend processes the response to make sure it's displaying the data correctly.*

### 💭 Reasoning

*The "Terminate batch job (Y/N)?" prompt killed everything again! When WatchFiles detected the naver_local.py change, it tried to restart, but the `cmd.exe` subprocess handling caused a "Terminate batch job" prompt for all the cmd.exe processes running the frontends.

This is the fundamental issue with start-all.bat + WatchFiles. The start-all.ps1 script uses `cmd.exe` to run the frontend processes, and when any child process receives a Ctrl+C signal (which WatchFiles sends when restarting), ALL `cmd.exe` instances get the "Terminate batch job" prompt.


I need to rewrite start-all.ps1 to launch frontends without `cmd.exe` to prevent this cascade termination, but first I should restart everything and avoid editing any Python files while it's running since the naver_local.py change triggered the reload before my fix was applied.

Modifying the PowerShell script... The simplest approach is to launch npm directly for frontends instead of wrapping it in cmd.exe, and ensure the backend processes don't propagate termination signals when the reloader restarts them. I'm going to modify the PowerShell script to use `Start-Process` directly for npm and handle signal propagation properly.

Modifying start-all.ps1...*

```
30. Write-Host "============================================" -ForegroundColor Cyan
31. Write-Host ""
32. 
33. # === Python 감지 ===
34. $PyExe = $null
35. foreach ($candidate in @("py", "python", "python3")) {
36.     try {
37.         $null = & $candidate --version 2>&1
38.         if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $PyExe = $candidate; break }
39.     } catch {}
40. }
41. if (-not $PyExe) {
42.     Write-Host "❌ Python을 찾을 수 없습니다." -ForegroundColor Red
43.     exit 1
44. }
45. Write-Host "  🐍 Python: $PyExe ($( & $PyExe --version 2>&1 ))" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
46. 
47. # === npm 감지 ===
48. $npmCmd = Get-Command npm -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
49. if (-not $npmCmd) {
50.     Write-Host "❌ npm을 찾을 수 없습니다." -ForegroundColor Red
51.     exit 1
52. }
53. Write-Host "  📦 npm: $($npmCmd.Source)" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
54. Write-Host ""
55. 
56. # === 경로 설정 ===
57. $WebFrontend       = Join-Path $Root "packages\website\frontend"
58. $WebBackend        = Join-Path $Root "packages\website\backend"
59. $CrawlerFrontend   = Join-Path $Root "packages\crawler-admin\frontend"
60. $CrawlerBackend    = Join-Path $Root "packages\crawler-admin\backend"
61. $DbFrontend        = Join-Path $Root "packages\db-admin\frontend"
62. $DbBackend         = Join-Path $Root "packages\db-admin\backend"
63. $SharedDir         = Join-Path $Root "packages\shared"
64. 
65. # PYTHONPATH — shared 모듈 참조용
66. $env:PYTHONPATH = "$SharedDir;$CrawlerBackend;$DbBackend;$WebBackend"
67. 
68. # === 의존성 설치 ===
69. Write-Host "[의존성] Python 패키지 확인..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
70. & $PyExe -m pip install --quiet fastapi uvicorn httpx requests beautifulsoup4 lxml sqlalchemy pyyaml 2>$null | Out-Null
71. Write-Host "         ✅ Python 패키지 완료" -ForegroundColor Green
72. 
73. $frontendDirs = @()
74. if ($Web)   { $frontendDirs += $WebFrontend }
75. if ($Admin) { $frontendDirs += $CrawlerFrontend; $frontendDirs += $DbFrontend }
76. 
77. foreach ($dir in $frontendDirs) {
78.     $name = (Split-Path (Split-Path $dir -Parent) -Leaf) + "/frontend"
79.     if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $dir "node_modules"))) {
80.         Write-Host "[의존성] $name npm install..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
81.         Push-Location $dir
82.         & cmd.exe /c "npm install --silent" 2>&1 | Out-Null
83.         Pop-Location
84.         Write-Host "         ✅ $name 완료" -ForegroundColor Green
85.     } else {
86.         Write-Host "[의존성] $name ✅" -ForegroundColor Green
87.     }
88. }
89. Write-Host ""
90. 
91. # === 기존 서버 정리 (포트 충돌 방지) ===
92. Write-Host "[정리] 기존 서버 프로세스 정리 중..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
93. $portsToClean = @()
94. if ($Web)   { $portsToClean += @(8000, 5173) }
95. if ($Admin) { $portsToClean += @(8001, 5174, 8002, 5175) }
96. 
97. foreach ($port in $portsToClean) {
98.     $conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
99.              Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -eq $port }
100.     foreach ($c in $conns) {
101.         $targetPid = $c.OwningProcess
102.         if ($targetPid -le 4 -or $targetPid -eq $PID) { continue }
103.         $proc = Get-Process -Id $targetPid -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
104.         if ($proc) {
105.             Write-Host "         포트 $port → PID $targetPid ($($proc.ProcessName)) 종료" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
106.             Stop-Process -Id $targetPid -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
107.         }
108.     }
109. }
110. Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
111. Write-Host "         ✅ 정리 완료" -ForegroundColor Green
112. Write-Host ""
113. 
114. # === 서버 시작 ===
115. $processes = @()
116. 
117. if ($Web) {
118.     Write-Host "🚀 [웹] 백엔드 시작 (port 8000)..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
119.     $p = Start-Process -PassThru -NoNewWindow -FilePath $PyExe `
120.         -ArgumentList "-m uvicorn api.app:create_app --factory --reload --port 8000 --host 127.0.0.1" `
121.         -WorkingDirectory $WebBackend
122.     $processes += $p
123. 
124.     Write-Host "🚀 [웹] 프론트엔드 시작 (port 5173)..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
125.     $p = Start-Process -PassThru -NoNewWindow -FilePath "cmd.exe" `
126.         -ArgumentList "/c cd /d `"$WebFrontend`" && npm run dev" `
127.         -WorkingDirectory $WebFrontend
128.     $processes += $p
129. }
130. 
131. if ($Admin) {
132.     Write-Host "🚀 [크롤러] 백엔드 시작 (port 8001)..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
133.     $p = Start-Process -PassThru -NoNewWindow -FilePath $PyExe `
134.         -ArgumentList "-m uvicorn api.app:create_app --factory --reload --port 8001 --host 127.0.0.1" `
135.         -WorkingDirectory $CrawlerBackend
136.     $processes += $p
137. 
138.     Write-Host "🚀 [크롤러] 프론트엔드 시작 (port 5174)..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
139.     $p = Start-Process -PassThru -NoNewWindow -FilePath "cmd.exe" `
140.         -ArgumentList "/c cd /d `"$CrawlerFrontend`" && npm run dev" `
141.         -WorkingDirectory $CrawlerFrontend
142.     $processes += $p
143. 
144.     Write-Host "🚀 [DB관리] 백엔드 시작 (port 8002)..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
145.     $p = Start-Process -PassThru -NoNewWindow -FilePath $PyExe `
146.         -ArgumentList "-m uvicorn api.app:create_app --factory --reload --port 8002 --host 127.0.0.1" `
147.         -WorkingDirectory $DbBackend
148.     $processes += $p
149. 
150.     Write-Host "🚀 [DB관리] 프론트엔드 시작 (port 5175)..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
151.     $p = Start-Process -PassThru -NoNewWindow -FilePath "cmd.exe" `
152.         -ArgumentList "/c cd /d `"$DbFrontend`" && npm run dev" `
153.         -WorkingDirectory $DbFrontend
154.     $processes += $p
155. }
156. 
157. # === 헬스체크 ===
158. Write-Host ""
159. Write-Host "⏳ 서버 준비 대기 중..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
160. 
161. $checks = @()
162. if ($Web)   { $checks += @{ Name = "웹"; Url = "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/health"; Ready = $false } }
163. if ($Admin) {
164.     $checks += @{ Name = "크롤러"; Url = "http://127.0.0.1:8001/health"; Ready = $false }
165.     $checks += @{ Name = "DB관리"; Url = "http://127.0.0.1:8002/health"; Ready = $false }
166. }
167. 
168. for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
169.     Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
170.     $allReady = $true
171.     foreach ($c in $checks) {
172.         if (-not $c.Ready) {
173.             try {
174.                 $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $c.Url -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
175.                 if ($r.StatusCode -eq 200) { $c.Ready = $true }
176.             } catch {}
177.         }
178.         if (-not $c.Ready) { $allReady = $false }
179.     }
180.     if ($allReady) { break }
181. }
182. 
183. # === 결과 출력 ===
184. Write-Host ""
185. Write-Host "============================================" -ForegroundColor Green
186. Write-Host "  ✅ 시스템이 시작되었습니다!" -ForegroundColor Green
187. Write-Host "============================================" -ForegroundColor Green
188. Write-Host ""
189. 
190. if ($Web) {
191.     $stat = if ($checks[0].Ready) { "✅" } else { "⏳" }
192.     Write-Host "  🌐 웹사이트" -ForegroundColor White
193.     Write-Host "     프론트엔드: http://localhost:5173" -ForegroundColor White
194.     Write-Host "     백엔드 API: http://localhost:8000/docs  $stat" -ForegroundColor White
195.     Write-Host ""
196. }
197. if ($Admin) {
198.     $idx = if ($Web) { 1 } else { 0 }
199.     $cStat = if ($checks[$idx].Ready) { "✅" } else { "⏳" }
200.     $dStat = if ($checks[$idx+1].Ready) { "✅" } else { "⏳" }
201.     Write-Host "  🕷️ 크롤러 관리" -ForegroundColor White
202.     Write-Host "     프론트엔드: http://localhost:5174" -ForegroundColor White
203.     Write-Host "     백엔드 API: http://localhost:8001/docs  $cStat" -ForegroundColor White
204.     Write-Host ""
205.     Write-Host "  🗄️ DB 관리" -ForegroundColor White
206.     Write-Host "     프론트엔드: http://localhost:5175" -ForegroundColor White
207.     Write-Host "     백엔드 API: http://localhost:8002/docs  $dStat" -ForegroundColor White
208.     Write-Host ""
209. }
210. 
211. # 브라우저 열기 — 웹사이트 우선
212. if ($Web) {
213.     Start-Process "http://localhost:5173"
214. }
215. 
216. Write-Host "  Ctrl+C를 누르면 모든 서버가 종료됩니다." -ForegroundColor DarkGray
217. Write-Host ""
218. 
219. # === 종료 대기 ===
220. try {
221.     while ($true) {
222.         $allExited = $true
223.         foreach ($p in $processes) {
224.             if (-not $p.HasExited) { $allExited = $false; break }
225.         }
226.         if ($allExited) {
227.             Write-Host "모든 서버가 종료되었습니다." -ForegroundColor Yellow
228.             break
229.         }
230.         Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
231.     }
232. } finally {
233.     Write-Host ""
234.     Write-Host "🛑 서버 종료 중..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
235.     foreach ($p in $processes) {
236.         if ($p -and -not $p.HasExited) { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
237.     }
238.     Write-Host "✅ 모든 서버가 종료되었습니다." -ForegroundColor Green
239. }
240.
```

### 💭 Reasoning

*The issue is that when WatchFiles (uvicorn --reload) detects file changes, it sends signals that propagate through the process tree. The `cmd.exe` processes for frontends receive these signals and prompt "Terminate batch job?", which kills everything.

Two fixes:
1. Remove `--reload` from uvicorn - simplest, most reliable
2. Use `npx.cmd` or `node` directly instead of `cmd.exe /c npm run dev`

Actually the real issue is that `start-all.bat` calls powershell, and when any subprocess triggers a signal, cmd.exe prompts "Terminate batch job?". The fix should be:


The WatchFiles reload mechanism kills and respawns child workers, but the real problem is that when processes run through `cmd.exe` batch with `-NoNewWindow`, they all share the same console group, so signals propagate to everything at once. The solution is to remove `--reload` from uvicorn to prevent the signal cascade, and for frontends, call `npx.cmd vite` directly instead of wrapping it in `cmd.exe /c npm run dev` to avoid the batch termination prompt.*

```
1. """크롤 파이프라인 — 크롤→파싱→검증→변환→저장 전체 흐름 관리."""
2. 
3. from __future__ import annotations
4. 
5. import asyncio
6. import logging
7. import os
8. import time
9. from datetime import datetime
10. from typing import Any, Optional
11. 
12. import httpx
13. 
14. from core.events import EventBus, CRAWL_STARTED, CRAWL_COMPLETED, CRAWL_FAILED
15. from core.models import CrawlResult, CrawlStatus, Event
16. from crawlers.registry.registry import CrawlerRegistry
17. from pipeline.validator import (
18.     validate_items,
19.     validate_price_range,
20.     deduplicate,
21.     normalize_prices,
22. )
23. from pipeline.transformer import (
24.     to_discount_history,
25.     to_hotdeal_prices,
26.     enrich_with_category,
27. )
28. 
29. logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
30. 
31. # DB-Admin API endpoint (configurable)
32. DB_ADMIN_API_URL = "http://localhost:8001/api/prices/bulk"
33. 
34. # 대기열(Pending Ingestion) 설정
35. INGESTION_API_URL = os.getenv(
36.     "INGESTION_API_URL", "http://localhost:8002/api/ingestions"
37. )
38. SKIP_REVIEW = os.getenv("SKIP_REVIEW", "").lower() == "true"
39. 
40. 
41. class PipelineResult:
42.     """단일 크롤러 파이프라인 실행 결과."""
43. 
44.     def __init__(
45.         self,
46.         crawler_name: str,
47.         status: str = "success",
48.         items_found: int = 0,
49.         items_valid: int = 0,
50.         items_saved: int = 0,
51.         duration: float = 0.0,
52.         errors: list[str] | None = None,
53.     ):
54.         self.crawler_name = crawler_name
55.         self.status = status
56.         self.items_found = items_found
57.         self.items_valid = items_valid
58.         self.items_saved = items_saved
59.         self.duration = duration
60.         self.errors = errors or []
61. 
62.     def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
63.         return {
64.             "crawler_name": self.crawler_name,
65.             "status": self.status,
66.             "items_found": self.items_found,
67.             "items_valid": self.items_valid,
68.             "items_saved": self.items_saved,
69.             "duration": round(self.duration, 2),
70.             "errors": self.errors,
71.         }
72. 
73. 
74. class CrawlPipeline:
75.     """크롤→파싱→검증→변환→저장 전체 파이프라인."""
76. 
77.     def __init__(
78.         self,
79.         registry: CrawlerRegistry | None = None,
80.         event_bus: EventBus | None = None,
81.         db_api_url: str = DB_ADMIN_API_URL,
82.         default_retry_count: int = 3,
83.     ):
84.         self.registry = registry or CrawlerRegistry()
85.         self.event_bus = event_bus or EventBus()
86.         self.db_api_url = db_api_url
87.         self.default_retry_count = default_retry_count
88. 
89.     async def run_crawler(self, crawler_name: str) -> PipelineResult:
90.         """단일 크롤러를 파이프라인 전체 흐름으로 실행."""
91.         start = time.monotonic()
92.         errors: list[str] = []
93. 
94.         await self.event_bus.publish(Event(
95.             event_type=CRAWL_STARTED,
96.             data={"crawler_name": crawler_name},
97.             source="pipeline",
98.         ))
99. 
100.         # 1. Crawl — 크롤러 인스턴스화 및 실행
101.         try:
102.             crawler = self.registry.get_crawler(crawler_name)
103.         except (KeyError, ImportError) as exc:
104.             return self._fail(crawler_name, str(exc), start)
105. 
106.         config = self.registry._registry.get(crawler_name, {}).get("config", {})
107.         # schedule은 cron 문자열일 수 있으므로 dict인 경우만 .get() 사용
108.         schedule_conf = config.get("schedule", {})
109.         if isinstance(schedule_conf, dict):
110.             retry_count = schedule_conf.get(
111.                 "retry_count", self.default_retry_count
112.             )
113.         else:
114.             retry_count = self.default_retry_count
115. 
116.         crawl_result: CrawlResult | None = None
117.         for attempt in range(1, retry_count + 1):
118.             try:
119.                 crawl_result = await crawler.crawl()
120.                 if crawl_result.status == CrawlStatus.SUCCESS:
121.                     break
122.                 errors.append(
123.                     f"attempt {attempt}: status={crawl_result.status.value}"
124.                 )
125.             except Exception as exc:
126.                 errors.append(f"attempt {attempt}: {exc}")
127.                 if attempt < retry_count:
128.                     await asyncio.sleep(min(attempt * 2, 10))
129. 
130.         if crawl_result is None or crawl_result.status != CrawlStatus.SUCCESS:
131.             return self._fail(
132.                 crawler_name,
133.                 crawl_result.error_msg if crawl_result else "all retries failed",
134.                 start,
135.                 errors,
136.             )
137. 
138.         raw_items = crawl_result.items or []
139.         items_found = len(raw_items)
140.         if items_found == 0:
141.             return self._fail(crawler_name, "no items collected", start, errors)
142. 
143.         # 2. Parse — 이미 dict 리스트이므로 pass-through
144.         items = list(raw_items)
145. 
146.         # 3. Validate
147.         required = config.get("output", {}).get("required_fields", [])
148.         if required:
149.             items, invalid = validate_items(items, required)
150.             if invalid:
151.                 errors.append(f"validation: {len(invalid)} items missing fields")
152.         items, price_invalid = validate_price_range(items)
153.         if price_invalid:
154.             errors.append(f"price_range: {len(price_invalid)} items out of range")
155.         items = normalize_prices(items)
156.         items = deduplicate(items, key_fields=["name", "price"])
157.         items = enrich_with_category(items)
158. 
159.         items_valid = len(items)
160. 
161.         # 4. Transform
162.         model_type = config.get("output", {}).get("model", "DiscountItem")
163.         if model_type == "HotdealPost":
164.             records = to_hotdeal_prices(items, source="hotdeal")
165.         else:
166.             records = to_discount_history(items, source="mart_discount")
167. 
168.         # 5. Store — 대기열 또는 직접 DB 저장
169.         if SKIP_REVIEW:
170.             items_saved = await self._store(records, errors)
171.         else:
172.             items_saved = await self._store_to_ingestion(
173.                 crawler_name=crawler_name,
174.                 crawl_status="success",
175.                 items=items,
176.                 schema_type=model_type,
177.                 strategy_used=crawl_result.strategy_used,
178.                 duration_seconds=time.monotonic() - start,
179.                 errors=errors,
180.             )
181. 
182.         duration = time.monotonic() - start
183.         result = PipelineResult(
184.             crawler_name=crawler_name,
185.             status="success",
186.             items_found=items_found,
187.             items_valid=items_valid,
188.             items_saved=items_saved,
189.             duration=duration,
190.             errors=errors,
191.         )
192. 
193.         await self.event_bus.publish(Event(
194.             event_type=CRAWL_COMPLETED,
195.             data=result.to_dict(),
196.             source="pipeline",
197.         ))
198. 
199.         logger.info(
200.             f"[Pipeline] {crawler_name}: "
201.             f"found={items_found} valid={items_valid} saved={items_saved} "
202.             f"duration={duration:.2f}s"
203.         )
204.         return result
205. 
206.     async def run_all(
207.         self, category: Optional[str] = None
208.     ) -> list[PipelineResult]:
209.         """등록된 모든(또는 카테고리 필터) 크롤러 동시 실행."""
210.         crawlers = self.registry.list_crawlers()
211.         if category:
212.             crawlers = [c for c in crawlers if c["category"] == category]
213.         names = [c["name"] for c in crawlers]
214.         return await self.run_batch(names)
215. 
216.     async def run_batch(self, crawler_names: list[str]) -> list[PipelineResult]:
217.         """지정된 크롤러들을 동시 실행."""
218.         tasks = [self.run_crawler(name) for name in crawler_names]
219.         return list(await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=False))
220. 
221.     # --- internal helpers ---
222. 
223.     async def _store(
224.         self, records: list[dict[str, Any]], errors: list[str]
225.     ) -> int:
226.         """DB-Admin API 로 레코드 전송. 실패 시 0 반환."""
227.         if not records:
228.             return 0
229.         try:
230.             async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30) as client:
231.                 resp = await client.post(self.db_api_url, json=records)
232.                 resp.raise_for_status()
233.                 return len(records)
234.         except Exception as exc:
235.             errors.append(f"store: {exc}")
236.             logger.warning(f"[Pipeline] store failed: {exc}")
237.             return 0
238. 
239.     async def _store_to_ingestion(
240.         self,
241.         crawler_name: str,
242.         crawl_status: str,
243.         items: list[dict[str, Any]],
244.         schema_type: str,
245.         strategy_used: str | None,
246.         duration_seconds: float,
247.         errors: list[str],
248.     ) -> int:
249.         """대기열(Pending Ingestion)에 크롤 결과 제출."""
250.         if not items:
251.             return 0
252.         payload = {
253.             "crawler_name": crawler_name,
254.             "crawl_status": crawl_status,
255.             "items": items,
256.             "schema_type": schema_type,
257.             "strategy_used": strategy_used,
258.             "duration_seconds": round(duration_seconds, 2),
259.             "errors": [{"message": e} for e in errors],
260.         }
261.         try:
262.             async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30) as client:
263.                 resp = await client.post(INGESTION_API_URL, json=payload)
264.                 resp.raise_for_status()
265.                 return len(items)
266.         except Exception as exc:
267.             errors.append(f"ingestion_submit: {exc}")
268.             logger.warning(f"[Pipeline] ingestion submit failed: {exc}")
269.             return 0
270. 
271.     def _fail(
272.         self,
273.         crawler_name: str,
274.         msg: str,
275.         start: float,
276.         errors: list[str] | None = None,
277.     ) -> PipelineResult:
278.         errs = list(errors or [])
279.         errs.append(msg)
280.         duration = time.monotonic() - start
281. 
282.         asyncio.ensure_future(self.event_bus.publish(Event(
283.             event_type=CRAWL_FAILED,
284.             data={"crawler_name": crawler_name, "error": msg},
285.             source="pipeline",
286.         )))
287. 
288.         return PipelineResult(
289.             crawler_name=crawler_name,
290.             status="failed",
291.             duration=duration,
292.             errors=errs,
293.         )
294.
```

```
21. async def _search_via_httpx(query: str, lat: float, lng: float, max_items: int) -> list[dict]:
22.     """httpx로 네이버 지도 검색 API를 직접 호출하여 가게 목록을 가져온다.
23. 
24.     Playwright가 작동하지 않는 Windows 환경 등에서 사용되는 대체 방식이다.
25.     네이버 지도의 내부 검색 API를 직접 호출하여 JSON 결과를 파싱한다.
26.     """
27.     import httpx
28. 
29.     headers = {
30.         "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36",
31.         "Referer": "https://map.naver.com/",
32.         "Accept": "application/json, text/plain, */*",

34.     }
35.     encoded_query = quote(query)
36.     # 네이버 지도 내부 검색 API
37.     url = (
38.         f"https://map.naver.com/p/api/search/allSearch"
39.         f"?query={encoded_query}&type=all"
40.         f"&searchCoord={lng};{lat}"
41.         f"&page=1&displayCount={max_items}"
42.     )
43. 
44.     items = []
45.     try:
46.         async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15, follow_redirects=True) as client:
47.             resp = await client.get(url, headers=headers)
48.             resp.raise_for_status()
49.             data = resp.json()
50. 
51.             # 네이버 API 응답에서 장소 목록 추출 (None 안전 체크)
52.             result = data.get("result") or {}
53.             place_data = result.get("place") or {}
54.             place_list = place_data.get("list") or []
55. 
56.             for place in place_list[:max_items]:
57.                 cat = place.get("category", "")
58.                 if isinstance(cat, list):
59.                     cat = cat[0] if cat else ""
60.                 item = {
61.                     "name": place.get("name", ""),
62.                     "category": cat,
63.                     "address": place.get("roadAddress") or place.get("address", ""),
64.                     "tel": place.get("tel", ""),
65.                     "x": place.get("x", ""),
66.                     "y": place.get("y", ""),
67.                     "distance": place.get("distance", ""),
68.                     "url": f"https://map.naver.com/p/entry/place/{place.get('id', '')}" if place.get("id") else "",
69.                     "image_url": place.get("thumUrl", ""),
70.                     "rating": place.get("reviewCount", 0),
71.                     "menu_info": place.get("menuInfo", ""),
72.                 }
73.                 if item["name"]:
74.                     items.append(item)
75.     except httpx.HTTPStatusError as exc:
76.         logger.warning(f"[네이버 검색] API HTTP 오류: {exc.response.status_code}")
77.     except Exception as exc:
78.         logger.warning(f"[네이버 검색] API 호출 실패: {exc}")
79. 
80.     return items
81. 
82. 
83. @router.get("/naver-search")
84. async def naver_place_search(
85.     query: str = Query("맛집", description="검색어 (예: 주유소, 한식, 카페)"),
86.     lat: float = Query(37.4979, description="위도"),
87.     lng: float = Query(127.0276, description="경도"),
88.     max_items: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=50, description="최대 결과 수"),
89. ):
90.     """네이버 플레이스 실시간 검색.
91. 
92.     Playwright → httpx 폴백 순서로 시도한다.
93.     Windows에서는 Playwright asyncio 호환 문제로 httpx 방식을 사용한다.
94.     """
95.     items = []
96.     source = "unknown"
97. 
98.     # 1차: Playwright 크롤러 시도
99.     try:
100.         import sys
101.         import os
102.         crawler_path = os.path.abspath(
103.             os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "..", "..", "..",
104.                          "crawler-admin", "backend")
105.         )
106.         if crawler_path not in sys.path:
107.             sys.path.insert(0, crawler_path)
108. 
109.         from crawlers.location.naver_place.crawler import NaverPlaceCrawler
110.         crawler = NaverPlaceCrawler()
111.         result = await crawler.crawl(
112.             query=query, lat=lat, lng=lng, max_items=max_items
113.         )
114.         if result.items:
115.             items = result.items
116.             source = "playwright"
117.     except (ImportError, NotImplementedError, OSError) as e:
118.         logger.info(f"[네이버 검색] Playwright 사용 불가, httpx 폴백: {e}")
119.     except Exception as e:
120.         logger.warning(f"[네이버 검색] Playwright 크롤링 실패, httpx 폴백: {e}")
121. 
122.     # 2차: httpx 직접 API 호출 (Playwright 실패 시)
123.     if not items:
124.         try:
125.             items = await _search_via_httpx(query, lat, lng, max_items)
126.             source = "httpx"
127.         except Exception as e:
128.             logger.error(f"[네이버 검색] httpx 폴백도 실패: {e}")
129. 
130.     return ApiResponse(
131.         success=len(items) > 0,
132.         data={
133.             "items": items,
134.             "count": len(items),
135.             "query": query,
136.             "lat": lat,
137.             "lng": lng,
138.             "source": source,
139.         },
140.         message=f"'{query}' 검색 결과 {len(items)}건" if items else "검색 결과 없음",
141.     )
142.
```

```
1. """
2. 네이버 플레이스 실시간 검색 API — 위치 기반 가게/식당/주유소 정보.
3. 
4. Playwright가 사용 불가능한 환경(Windows asyncio 등)에서는
5. httpx 기반 네이버 API 직접 호출로 대체한다.
6. 
7. 엔드포인트:
8.     GET /api/local/naver-search — 네이버 지도 기반 주변 가게 검색
9. """
10. 
11. import logging
12. from urllib.parse import quote
13. from fastapi import APIRouter, Query
14. from api.schemas.common import ApiResponse
15. 
16. logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
17. 
18. router = APIRouter()
19. 
20. 
21. async def _search_via_httpx(query: str, lat: float, lng: float, max_items: int) -> list[dict]:
22.     """httpx로 네이버 지도 검색 API를 직접 호출하여 가게 목록을 가져온다.
23. 
24.     Playwright가 작동하지 않는 Windows 환경 등에서 사용되는 대체 방식이다.
25.     네이버 지도의 내부 검색 API를 직접 호출하여 JSON 결과를 파싱한다.
26.     """
27.     import httpx
28. 
29.     headers = {
30.         "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36",
31.         "Referer": "https://map.naver.com/",
32.         "Accept": "application/json, text/plain, */*",
33.         "Accept-Language": "ko-KR,ko;q=0.9",
34.     }
35.     encoded_query = quote(query)
36.     # 네이버 지도 내부 검색 API
37.     url = (
38.         f"https://map.naver.com/p/api/search/allSearch"
39.         f"?query={encoded_query}&type=all"
40.         f"&searchCoord={lng};{lat}"
41.         f"&page=1&displayCount={max_items}"
42.     )
43. 
44.     items = []
45.     try:
46.         async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15, follow_redirects=True) as client:
47.             resp = await client.get(url, headers=headers)
48.             resp.raise_for_status()
49.             data = resp.json()
50. 
51.             # 네이버 API 응답에서 장소 목록 추출 (None 안전 체크)
52.             result = data.get("result") or {}
53.             place_data = result.get("place") or {}
54.             place_list = place_data.get("list") or []
55. 
56.             for place in place_list[:max_items]:
57.                 cat = place.get("category", "")
58.                 if isinstance(cat, list):
59.                     cat = cat[0] if cat else ""
60.                 item = {
61.                     "name": place.get("name", ""),
62.                     "category": cat,
63.                     "address": place.get("roadAddress") or place.get("address", ""),
64.                     "tel": place.get("tel", ""),
65.                     "x": place.get("x", ""),
66.                     "y": place.get("y", ""),
67.                     "distance": place.get("distance", ""),
68.                     "url": f"https://map.naver.com/p/entry/place/{place.get('id', '')}" if place.get("id") else "",
69.                     "image_url": place.get("thumUrl", ""),
70.                     "rating": place.get("reviewCount", 0),
71.                     "menu_info": place.get("menuInfo", ""),
72.                 }
73.                 if item["name"]:
74.                     items.append(item)
75.     except httpx.HTTPStatusError as exc:
76.         logger.warning(f"[네이버 검색] API HTTP 오류: {exc.response.status_code}")
77.     except Exception as exc:
78.         logger.warning(f"[네이버 검색] API 호출 실패: {exc}")
79. 
80.     return items
```

```
1. """대기열(Pending Ingestion) API — 크롤 결과 수신, 검토, 승인/거부"""
2. 
3. import json
4. from datetime import datetime
5. from typing import Optional
6. 
7. from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query
8. from pydantic import BaseModel
9. from sqlalchemy import func
10. 
11. from services.base import get_session
12. from storage.models import (
13.     PendingIngestion,
14.     IngestionStatus,
15.     BaselinePrice,
16.     DiscountHistory,
17.     HotdealPrice,
18. )
19. 
20. router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/ingestions", tags=["ingestions"])
21. 
22. 
23. # --- Request 모델 ---
24. 
25. 
26. class IngestionSubmit(BaseModel):
27.     crawler_name: str
28.     crawl_status: str = "success"
29.     items: list[dict] = []
30.     schema_type: str = "DiscountItem"
31.     strategy_used: Optional[str] = None
32.     duration_seconds: Optional[float] = None
33.     errors: list[dict] = []
34.     source_url: Optional[str] = None
35. 
36. 
37. class ReviewRequest(BaseModel):
38.     action: str  # "approve", "reject", "partial"
39.     notes: Optional[str] = None
40.     approved_item_indices: Optional[list[int]] = None
41.     rejected_reason: Optional[str] = None
42. 
43. 
44. # --- 품질 점수 계산 ---
45. 
46. 
47. def _calculate_quality(items: list[dict], schema_type: str) -> tuple[float, dict]:
48.     """크롤 데이터의 품질 점수(0.0~1.0)와 상세 내역 반환."""
49.     if not items:
50.         return 0.0, {"error": "항목 없음"}
51. 
52.     # 필수 필드 검사
53.     if schema_type == "HotdealPost":
54.         required = ["title", "url"]
55.     else:
56.         required = ["name", "sale_price"]
57. 
58.     missing_count = 0
59.     for item in items:
60.         for field in required:
61.             if not item.get(field):
62.                 missing_count += 1
63.                 break
64. 
65.     missing_ratio = missing_count / len(items)
66. 
67.     # 가격 이상치 검사
68.     price_field = "price" if schema_type == "HotdealPost" else "sale_price"
69.     prices = [
70.         item[price_field]
71.         for item in items
72.         if isinstance(item.get(price_field), (int, float)) and item[price_field] > 0
73.     ]
74. 
75.     outlier_count = 0
76.     if len(prices) >= 3:
77.         avg = sum(prices) / len(prices)
78.         for p in prices:
79.             if p > avg * 5 or p < avg * 0.05:
80.                 outlier_count += 1
81. 
82.     outlier_ratio = outlier_count / len(items)
83. 
84.     # 중복 검사
85.     name_field = "title" if schema_type == "HotdealPost" else "name"
86.     seen: set[tuple] = set()
87.     dup_count = 0
88.     for item in items:
89.         key = (item.get(name_field, ""), item.get(price_field))
90.         if key in seen:
91.             dup_count += 1
92.         seen.add(key)
93. 
94.     dup_ratio = dup_count / len(items)
95. 
96.     # 점수 계산
97.     score = 1.0 - (missing_ratio * 0.4) - (outlier_ratio * 0.3) - (dup_ratio * 0.3)
98.     score = max(0.0, min(1.0, round(score, 3)))
99. 
100.     details = {
101.         "total_items": len(items),
102.         "missing_fields": missing_count,
103.         "outliers": outlier_count,
104.         "duplicates": dup_count,
105.         "missing_ratio": round(missing_ratio, 3),
106.         "outlier_ratio": round(outlier_ratio, 3),
107.         "duplicate_ratio": round(dup_ratio, 3),
108.     }
109.     return score, details
110. 
111. 
112. # --- 엔드포인트 ---
113. 
114. 
115. @router.get("/stats")
116. def ingestion_stats():
117.     """대기열 통계 — 상태별 건수, 크롤러별 건수."""
118.     session = get_session()
119.     try:
120.         status_rows = (
121.             session.query(PendingIngestion.status, func.count())
122.             .group_by(PendingIngestion.status)
123.             .all()
124.         )
125.         status_counts: dict[str, int] = {s.value: 0 for s in IngestionStatus}
126.         for status_val, cnt in status_rows:
127.             key = status_val.value if hasattr(status_val, "value") else status_val
128.             status_counts[key] = cnt
129. 
130.         crawler_rows = (
131.             session.query(PendingIngestion.crawler_name, func.count())
132.             .group_by(PendingIngestion.crawler_name)
133.             .all()
134.         )
135.         by_crawler = {name: cnt for name, cnt in crawler_rows}
136. 
137.         return {
138.             "total_pending": status_counts.get("pending", 0),
139.             "total_approved": status_counts.get("approved", 0),
140.             "total_rejected": status_counts.get("rejected", 0),
141.             "total_crawler_approved": status_counts.get("crawler_approved", 0),
142.             "total_partial": status_counts.get("partial", 0),
143.             "by_crawler": by_crawler,
144.         }
145.     finally:
146.         session.close()
147. 
148. 
149. @router.post("", status_code=201)
150. def submit_ingestion(body: IngestionSubmit):
151.     """크롤러가 데이터를 대기열에 제출."""
152.     session = get_session()
153.     try:
154.         quality_score, quality_details = _calculate_quality(
155.             body.items, body.schema_type
156.         )
157.         row = PendingIngestion(
158.             crawler_name=body.crawler_name,
159.             crawl_status=body.crawl_status,
160.             strategy_used=body.strategy_used,
161.             items_count=len(body.items),
162.             items_json=json.dumps(body.items, ensure_ascii=False, default=str),
163.             schema_type=body.schema_type,
164.             quality_score=quality_score,
165.             quality_details=quality_details,
166.             errors_json=(
167.                 json.dumps(body.errors, ensure_ascii=False, default=str)
168.                 if body.errors
169.                 else None
170.             ),
171.             status=IngestionStatus.PENDING,
172.             crawled_at=datetime.utcnow(),
173.             duration_seconds=body.duration_seconds,
174.             source_url=body.source_url,
175.         )
176.         session.add(row)
177.         session.commit()
178.         session.refresh(row)
179.         return {"id": row.id, "status": "pending", "quality_score": quality_score}
180.     finally:
181.         session.close()
182.

185. def list_ingestions(
186.     status: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="상태 필터"),
187.     crawler_name: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="크롤러 필터"),

273. @router.post("/{ingestion_id}/crawler-review")
274. def crawler_review(ingestion_id: int, body: ReviewRequest):
275.     """크롤러 관리자 1차 검토 — 승인/거부."""
276.     session = get_session()
277.     try:
278.         row = session.get(PendingIngestion, ingestion_id)
279.         if not row:
280.             raise HTTPException(404, "대기열 항목을 찾을 수 없습니다")
281.         if row.status != IngestionStatus.PENDING:
282.             raise HTTPException(
283.                 400,
284.                 f"현재 상태({row.status.value})에서는 크롤러 검토가 불가합니다",
285.             )
286. 
287.         if body.action == "approve":
288.             row.status = IngestionStatus.CRAWLER_APPROVED
289.         elif body.action == "reject":
290.             row.status = IngestionStatus.REJECTED
291.             row.rejected_reason = body.rejected_reason or body.notes
292.         else:
293.             raise HTTPException(
294.                 400, f"잘못된 액션: {body.action} (approve 또는 reject)"
295.             )
296. 
297.         row.crawler_reviewer_notes = body.notes
298.         row.crawler_reviewed_at = datetime.utcnow()
299.         session.commit()
300.         return {"id": row.id, "status": row.status.value}
301.     finally:
302.         session.close()
303. 
304. 
305. @router.post("/{ingestion_id}/db-review")
306. def db_review(ingestion_id: int, body: ReviewRequest):
307.     """DB 관리자 최종 검토 — 승인 시 실제 DB 테이블에 삽입."""
308.     session = get_session()
309.     try:
310.         row = session.get(PendingIngestion, ingestion_id)
311.         if not row:
312.             raise HTTPException(404, "대기열 항목을 찾을 수 없습니다")
313.         if row.status != IngestionStatus.CRAWLER_APPROVED:
314.             raise HTTPException(
315.                 400,
316.                 "크롤러 관리자 승인(crawler_approved) 상태에서만 DB 검토가 가능합니다",
317.             )
318. 
319.         items = json.loads(row.items_json) if row.items_json else []
320. 
321.         if body.action == "approve":
322.             saved = _insert_items(session, items, row.schema_type)
323.             row.status = IngestionStatus.APPROVED
324.             row.db_reviewer_notes = body.notes
325.             row.db_reviewed_at = datetime.utcnow()
326.             session.commit()
327.             return {"id": row.id, "status": "approved", "saved": saved}
328. 
329.         elif body.action == "reject":
330.             row.status = IngestionStatus.REJECTED
331.             row.rejected_reason = body.rejected_reason or body.notes
332.             row.db_reviewer_notes = body.notes
333.             row.db_reviewed_at = datetime.utcnow()
334.             session.commit()
335.             return {"id": row.id, "status": "rejected"}
336. 
337.         elif body.action == "partial":
338.             if not body.approved_item_indices:
339.                 raise HTTPException(
340.                     400, "partial 승인 시 approved_item_indices가 필요합니다"
341.                 )
342.             approved = [
343.                 items[i]
344.                 for i in body.approved_item_indices
345.                 if i < len(items)
346.             ]
347.             saved = _insert_items(session, approved, row.schema_type)
348.             row.status = IngestionStatus.PARTIAL
349.             row.approved_items_json = json.dumps(
350.                 approved, ensure_ascii=False, default=str
351.             )
352.             row.db_reviewer_notes = body.notes
353.             row.db_reviewed_at = datetime.utcnow()
354.             session.commit()
355.             return {"id": row.id, "status": "partial", "saved": saved}
356. 
357.         else:
358.             raise HTTPException(400, f"잘못된 액션: {body.action}")
359.     finally:
360.         session.close()
361. 
362. 
363. @router.delete("/{ingestion_id}")
364. def delete_ingestion(ingestion_id: int):
365.     """대기열 항목 삭제."""
366.     session = get_session()
367.     try:
368.         row = session.get(PendingIngestion, ingestion_id)
369.         if not row:
370.             raise HTTPException(404, "대기열 항목을 찾을 수 없습니다")
371.         session.delete(row)
372.         session.commit()
373.         return {"status": "deleted", "id": ingestion_id}
374.     finally:
375.         session.close()
376. 
377. 
378. # --- 내부 헬퍼 ---
379. 
380. 
381. def _insert_items(session, items: list[dict], schema_type: str) -> int:
382.     """승인된 항목을 최종 DB 테이블에 삽입."""
383.     saved = 0
384.     for item in items:
385.         try:
386.             if schema_type == "HotdealPost":
387.                 row = HotdealPrice(
388.                     product_id=item.get("product_id", 1),
389.                     price=float(item.get("price", 0)),
390.                     source=item.get("source_community", "hotdeal"),
391.                     source_url=item.get("url", ""),
392.                     title=item.get("title", ""),
393.                     crawled_at=datetime.utcnow(),
394.                 )
395.             else:
396.                 source = item.get("source", "mart_discount")
397.                 if source in ("government", "mart_regular"):
398.                     row = BaselinePrice(
399.                         product_id=item.get("product_id", 1),
400.                         price=float(
401.                             item.get("sale_price") or item.get("price", 0)
402.                         ),
403.                         source=source,
404.                         unit=item.get("unit", ""),
405.                         recorded_at=datetime.utcnow(),
406.                         region=item.get("region"),
407.                     )
408.                 else:
409.                     row = DiscountHistory(
410.                         product_id=item.get("product_id", 1),
411.                         price=float(
412.                             item.get("sale_price") or item.get("price", 0)
413.                         ),
414.                         original_price=item.get("original_price"),
415.                         discount_rate=item.get("discount_percent"),
416.                         source=source,
417.                         source_url=item.get("detail_url", ""),
418.                         crawled_at=datetime.utcnow(),
419.                     )
420.             session.add(row)
421.             saved += 1
422.         except Exception:
423.             continue
424.     return saved
425.
```

| **keywords.py** | `/keywords` | `/`, `/search`, `/{keyword_id}/count`, `/popular`, `/suggest` | Uses **"/" for root, full paths for others** |
| **ingestion.py** | `/api/ingestions` | `""` (empty string), `/{ingestion_id}`, `/{ingestion_id}/db-review` | **Uses empty string "" for root!** |

### **CategoryCreate Schema** (categories.py, lines 19-25):
```python
class CategoryCreate(BaseModel):
```

```python

def db_review(ingestion_id: int, body: ReviewRequest):
```

```python
class ReviewRequest(BaseModel):
    action: str  # "approve", "reject", "partial"
    notes: Optional[str] = None

    rejected_reason: Optional[str] = None
```

**What db-review expects:**
- Accepts three actions: `"approve"`, `"reject"`, or `"partial"`
- `approved_item_indices` is **required only for "partial" action** (line 338-340)
- On approval: Inserts items into final DB tables (BaselinePrice, DiscountHistory, or HotdealPrice) based on schema_type
- Returns: `{"id": row.id, "status": "approved"|"rejected"|"partial", "saved": int}`

- **ingestion.py** line 184: `@router.get("")` ← **INCONSISTENT!**

```
120. function TreeNode({ node, depth, expanded, toggle, onAdd, onEdit, onDelete }) {
121.   const hasChildren = node.children && node.children.length > 0;
122.   const isOpen = expanded.has(node.id);
123.   const count = node.productCount ?? countProducts(node);
124. 
125.   return (
126.     <div className={s.treeNode}>
127.       <div className={s.nodeRow} style={{ paddingLeft: `${depth * 24 + 12}px` }}>
128.         <button
129.           className={s.expandBtn}
130.           onClick={() => hasChildren && toggle(node.id)}
131.           style={{ visibility: hasChildren ? 'visible' : 'hidden' }}
132.         >
133.           {isOpen ? <ChevronDown size={16} /> : <ChevronRight size={16} />}
134.         </button>
135.         <span className={s.nodeName}>{node.name}</span>
136.         {count > 0 && (
137.           <span className={s.badge}><Package size={11} /> {count}</span>
138.         )}
139.         {node.attributes && (
140.           <div className={s.attrs}>
141.             {node.attributes.origin && <span className={s.attr}>{node.attributes.origin}</span>}
142.             {node.attributes.storage && <span className={s.attr}>{node.attributes.storage}</span>}
143.             {node.attributes.grade && <span className={s.attr}>{node.attributes.grade}</span>}
144.           </div>
145.         )}
146.         <div className={s.nodeActions}>
147.           <button title="하위 추가" onClick={() => onAdd(node.id)}><Plus size={14} /></button>
148.           <button title="수정" onClick={() => onEdit(node)}><Pencil size={14} /></button>
149.           <button title="삭제" onClick={() => onDelete(node.id)}><Trash2 size={14} /></button>
150.         </div>
151.       </div>
152.       {isOpen && hasChildren && (
153.         <div className={s.children}>
154.           {node.children.map(child => (
155.             <TreeNode
156.               key={child.id}
157.               node={child}
158.               depth={depth + 1}
159.               expanded={expanded}
160.               toggle={toggle}
161.               onAdd={onAdd}
162.               onEdit={onEdit}
163.               onDelete={onDelete}
164.             />
165.           ))}
166.         </div>
167.       )}
168.     </div>
169.   );
170. }
171. 
172. function countProducts(node) {
173.   if (node.productCount) return node.productCount;
174.   if (!node.children) return 0;
175.   return node.children.reduce((sum, child) => sum + countProducts(child), 0);
176. }
177.
```

*The `place` key is None and `ncaptcha` is returned. This means Naver is detecting the request as automated and requiring captcha verification. Without Playwright (which doesn't work on Windows asyncio) or a Naver developer API key, we can't get Naver place search results.Let me make the endpoint return a graceful message and use mock data when the API fails. Or better yet, let me see if there's a way to get Playwright working on Windows.Actually, looking at the earlier error:
```
File "...\asyncio\base_events.py", line 539, in _make_subprocess_transport


```

The issue is that Windows defaults to `ProactorEventLoop` while Playwright needs `SelectorEventLoop`, and uvicorn uses `ProactorEventLoop` on Windows. I can work around this by running Playwright's sync API in a thread pool, which creates its own event loop internally instead of relying on the main asyncio loop.

Let me refactor the naver_local.py to try the Playwright sync API in a thread first, fall back to httpx if that fails, and return an empty result gracefully if both approaches don't work. The sync API should handle Windows fine since it spawns its own subprocess rather than fighting with the event loop.*

```
1. """
2. 네이버 플레이스 실시간 검색 API — 위치 기반 가게/식당/주유소 정보.

7. 엔드포인트:
```
